title: A Learning and Rectification Algorithm for Nonstationary Online Linear Programming
affiliations: Nanjing University - School of Management and Engineering, Nanjing University, affiliation not provided to SSRN, Ant Group CO Ltd, School of Business Administration, South China University of Technology and Ant Group CO Ltd

detail.title: A Learning and Rectification Algorithm for Nonstationary Online Linear Programming
detail.abstract: This paper investigates online linear programming (OLP) under resource capacity constraints, aiming to maximize total reward over a finite horizon. To address the limitations of stochastic models in nonstationary settings and the conservatism of adversarial models, we introduce a globally nonstationary and locally stationary arrival model to the OLP context. This framework partitions the horizon into known periods where requests are independent and identically distributed within each period, while the underlying distribution varies across periods, balancing environmental evolution with local stability. Assuming the true distribution is unknown, but an inaccurate prior is available, we propose the Gradient Descent with Learning and Rectification (GDLR) framework. This dual-based method optimizes budget consumption for each request through two complementary components: a learning component that leverages local stationarity to refine estimates by combining prior knowledge with real-time observations, and a rectification component that counters global nonstationarity by adaptively adjusting estimates based on cumulative resource imbalance. Theoretically, we demonstrate that rectification serves as robust optimization against estimation errors in dual and ensures primal feasibility. The regret bound of GDLR decomposes into intrinsic stochasticity, estimation error, and allocation suboptimality, with the latter two significantly reduced via learning and rectification. Empirically, our approach consistently outperforms baselines on synthetic and real-world datasets. To our knowledge, this work presents the first enterprise OLP deployment at Alipay, achieving a 2.2% average revenue gain in online A/B tests.

AI.tldr: 本文提出GDLR框架，解决非平稳环境下在线线性规划的预算分配问题，通过学习和校正组件平衡局部平稳性与全局非平稳性，在支付宝实际部署中实现2.2%的平均收益提升。
AI.research_question: 如何在资源容量约束下，针对非平稳环境中的在线线性规划问题，设计有效的算法来最大化总奖励？
AI.motivation: 现有随机模型在非平稳环境下表现不佳，而对抗模型过于保守，需要一种能平衡环境演变与局部稳定性的新框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 全局非平稳与局部平稳到达模型：将时间范围划分为已知周期，每个周期内请求独立同分布，但分布在不同周期间变化。
AI.method: 梯度下降学习校正(GDLR)框架：包含学习组件（利用局部平稳性结合先验知识和实时观测优化估计）和校正组件（通过自适应调整估计来应对全局非平稳性）。
AI.findings: GDLR在合成和真实数据集上均优于基线方法；在支付宝的实际部署中，在线A/B测试实现了2.2%的平均收益提升。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 首次将全局非平稳与局部平稳到达模型引入OLP；2) 证明校正组件可作为对偶估计误差的鲁棒优化；3) 遗憾边界分解为内在随机性、估计误差和分配次优性。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 提出首个企业级OLP部署方案；2) 在支付宝实际应用中验证有效性；3) 为实际非平稳环境中的资源分配问题提供实用解决方案。

detail.abstract: It is not enough for an industrial company to apply all the features of lean production in its own business. Especially in businesses where a significant part of product costs are taken from suppliers, the same methods and principles should be applied to suppliers. Otherwise, the expected gain and benefit from lean production will not be realized as expected. Green logistics, on the other hand, seeks ways to minimize the environmental damage of logistics. In this context, green logistics focuses on energy efficiency, reduction of emissions, recycling and reuse. The aim of all companies is to make money and attaches importance to the image of the company. The existence and continuous updating of this information is a must in order for businesses to evaluate the opportunities offered by the environment and to minimize the threats. The business environment is any factor that has the potential to affect some or all of the business activities. In this context, the effects of independent and intermediary variables on organizational performance in research logistics companies are examined. The research was carried out by collecting data from logistics companies located in Istanbul. Analyzes were made using the smartpls program. As a result of the analyzes, it is supported by hypotheses that lean supply chain, green logistics practices and environmental effects are effective on Organizational Performance.

title: The Lifecycle of Digital Gig Work in the Domestic Service Sector in Bangladesh
affiliations: BRAC University and

detail.title: The Lifecycle of Digital Gig Work in the Domestic Service Sector in Bangladesh

declarations.funderStatement: This project has been supported by the Gates Foundation (investment ID INV-044136), through a subgrant from IDinsight’s Digital Economy Research Impact Initiative (DERII).

detail.abstract: We study female workers registered on a digital gig platform for matching domestic workers with potential clients in urban Bangladesh, with the aim to understand how platform access shape the economic choices of female domestic workers in Bangladesh. The platform uses an innovative technology that allows workers to interact with the system using a feature phone. Despite the platform's accessibility, digital gig work represents only 4% of the domestic workers' total labour supply and earnings. Analysis of administrative data on platform activity shows that usage by workers drop sharply within the first 12 months of registration, suggesting that workers tend to use the gig platform primarily as an entry point into domestic work. Using propensity score matching, we also find evidence the presence of young children within the home generates a shift away from traditional domestic work and increased digital gig work; however marriage has no impact on platform usage.

AI.motivation: 了解数字零工平台对发展中国家女性工人经济决策的影响，特别是在家政服务领域。

affiliations: Bartin University and

publicationDetails.detailsText: ANKARA INTERNATIONAL CONGRESS ON SCIENTIFIC RESEARCH-VII 2022

detail.abstract: In order for businesses to gain sustainable competitive advantage in the information age, they need both innovation and the necessary innovation culture for this innovation to emerge. If there is an innovation culture internalized within the enterprise throughout the entire process of creating innovations and creating benefits for the enterprise, the enterprise will benefit from this process by adapting more quickly to internal and external changes. Otherwise, the process of innovating in the business will be prolonged, so it will fail and lose its profitability and competitive advantage. In enterprises, the determination of the administrative problems within the enterprise by acting together with the employees will facilitate the formation process of the innovation culture. At the same time, companies that successfully manage the lean six sigma process gain an advantage over their competitors. When we look at the companies in the sectors where there is intense competition, it can be seen that the companies that manage the lean six sigma process are successful in their performance output. For this reason, there is a need for an organizational structure that successfully manages the lean six sigma process together with the innovation culture. However, administrations need to be careful in the implementation strategy process in order to be successful in business performance. Because the successful implementation of the decisions taken by the administrations depends on the implementation strategy process. In the research, the data were collected from the employees of the textile companies whose headquarters are in Istanbul. As a result of the analyzes, the innovation culture, lean six sigma behaviors and implementation strategy are supported by the hypotheses that have positive effects on business performance. Since the data in the research were collected from textile companies in Istanbul, it is not possible to evaluate the results of the analysis both in general terms and for companies in different sectors. For this reason, it is recommended to conduct comparative analyzes in future studies, taking into account this limited situation.

title: Estimating Productivity in the Presence of Spillovers: Firm-level Evidence from the US Production Network

detail.title: Estimating Productivity in the Presence of Spillovers: Firm-level Evidence from the US Production Network
detail.abstract: This paper examines the extent to which productivity gains are transmitted across U.S. firms through buyer-supplier relationships. Many empirical studies measure firm-to-firm spillovers using firm-level productivity estimates derived from control function approaches. However, these methods implicitly rule out the interdependence of firms' outcomes and decisions through productivity spillovers. To address this limitation, I develop a framework to jointly estimate network effects and firm-level productivity, while accounting for common productivity shocks across firms and non-random buyer-supplier matching. Using this method, I characterize productivity spillovers over the US production network from 1977 to 2016. My results suggest that having 1% more productive trading partners on average leads to 0.076% higher productivity in the long run. Supplier spillovers, which are driven by both large and small firms, are 4 times greater than buyer effects, which are primarily generated by large firms. Heterogeneity in spillovers within and across sectors also has implications for overall productivity growth: aggregate spillovers tend to be much larger when manufacturers are central in the production network than when retailers and wholesalers are more central.

AI.tldr: 本文开发了一个联合估计网络效应和企业生产率的框架，发现美国生产网络中供应商的生产率溢出效应比买方效应强4倍，且制造商在网络中心地位对整体生产率增长影响更大。
AI.research_question: 生产率增益如何通过买方-供应商关系在美国企业间传播？供应商和买方的生产率溢出效应有何差异？不同行业在网络中的中心地位如何影响整体生产率增长？
AI.motivation: 现有研究使用控制函数方法估计企业间生产率溢出，但这些方法隐含地排除了企业结果和决策通过生产率溢出的相互依赖性，需要开发能同时估计网络效应和企业生产率的新框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 生产网络理论、企业间溢出效应理论、网络效应估计方法、买方-供应商关系经济学
AI.method: 开发了一个联合估计网络效应和企业生产率的框架，考虑了企业间共同生产率冲击和非随机的买方-供应商匹配，应用于1977-2016年美国生产网络数据。
AI.findings: 1. 交易伙伴生产率平均提高1%会导致长期生产率提高0.076%；2. 供应商溢出效应（由大小企业共同驱动）比买方效应（主要由大企业产生）强4倍；3. 当制造商而非零售商和批发商处于生产网络中心时，总体溢出效应更大。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了同时估计网络效应和企业生产率的新方法框架，解决了传统控制函数方法忽略企业相互依赖性的局限，为生产网络溢出效应研究提供了更准确的计量工具。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业理解供应链关系对生产率的影响提供实证依据，为政策制定者识别关键行业和促进整体生产率增长提供指导，特别是强调了制造商在网络中的核心作用。

detail.abstract: This paper applies the "Organizational Thermodynamics" framework (Shoji, 2026) to analyze the structural phase transition initiated by the dissolution of the Japanese House of Representatives on January 19, 2026. We define the Takaichi administration as a "Minority Dissipative Structure" attempting to shift from a "Jimin-Komei Equilibrium" to a dynamic "Jimin-Ishin-Kokumin State." By utilizing the "Canonical Efficiency Function" and the "Schrödinger Condition," we demonstrate that the injection of specific Negentropy (dS_ext)specifically the "Temporary Zero Consumption Tax on Food" and "Responsible Active Fiscal Policy"-is a thermodynamic necessity to counteract the dS ext irreversible entropy production (dS_int) caused by the rupture with Komeito and the administration's lack of a parliamentary majority.

AI.tldr: 本文应用"组织热力学"框架分析2026年1月19日日本众议院解散引发的结构性相变，将高市政权定义为试图从"自民-公明平衡态"转向动态"自民-维新-国民状态"的"少数派耗散结构"。
AI.research_question: 特定负熵注入（如"食品临时零消费税"和"负责任积极财政政策"）是否在热力学上是必要的，以抵消因与公明党决裂和政权缺乏议会多数席位导致的不可逆熵产生？
AI.motivation: 分析日本政治体系中的结构性变化，特别是高市政权在解散众议院后试图实现的政治转型，为理解政治组织的动态演化提供新的理论视角。
AI.theoretical_framework: 组织热力学框架（Shoji, 2026）、耗散结构理论、少数派耗散结构、规范效率函数、薛定谔条件、熵产生与负熵概念。

AI.findings: 特定负熵注入（食品临时零消费税和负责任积极财政政策）在热力学上是必要的，以抵消因与公明党决裂和缺乏议会多数席位导致的不可逆熵产生，从而维持政权的稳定性。
AI.theory_contributions: 将组织热力学框架应用于政治分析，提出了"少数派耗散结构"概念，发展了政治组织相变的理论模型，为理解政治系统的动态演化提供了新的理论工具。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政治决策者提供了理解政权稳定性的热力学视角，指出了特定政策干预（负熵注入）在维持政治结构转型中的重要性，为政治战略制定提供了理论依据。

title: Examination of the Effects of Management Practice, Management Commitment and Lean Sigma Behaviors in Textile Companies
affiliations: Bartin University and

detail.title: Examination of the Effects of Management Practice, Management Commitment and Lean Sigma Behaviors in Textile Companies
detail.abstract: The ability of companies to provide customer satisfaction in an intensely competitive environment depends on adopting the understanding of quality in their products/services. At the same time, companies need to increase their market share, increase their profitability, have growth potential, that is, be successful in their performance. Now, regardless of the sector, companies' providing both quality and price advantage can enable them to leave their competitors behind in the competitive environment. One of the most important concepts to achieve this advantage is lean six sigma behaviors. Because companies have to renew, design and develop their production/service processes in accordance with the expectations of their customers. Lean six sigma is effective in realizing improvements in processes by enabling companies to analyze process inputs and outputs with scientific methods. In this way, possible errors, omissions and inaccuracies are minimized. In this context, the data in the research were carried out by collecting questionnaires from middle and senior managers working in textile companies in Istanbul. As a result of the analyzes, it is supported by the hypotheses that management practice, managerial commitment and lean six sigma behaviors have positive effects on organizational performance and quality.

title: Cross-Continental Comparisons: Africa and Asia
affiliations: , Indiana University, Indiana University, Indiana University and Indiana University

detail.title: Cross-Continental Comparisons: Africa and Asia
detail.abstract:
The research in the Western Hemisphere reported in this book has allowed for a co-
hesive program with a focus on forest ecosystems and has produced a sizable body
of findings on human-environment interactions in forests in the Americas. Africa
and Asia present different sets of challenges to understanding how human societies
interact with forest resources. Significantly greater population densities exist in parts
of Asia, and significantly different institutional environments can be found locally in
both continents. In 2000, the Center for the Study of Institutions, Population, and
Environmental Change (CIPEC) expanded its research work to sites in Asia and
Africa, building on a rich array of preexisting institutional and biophysical informa-
tion available from the International Forestry Resources and Institutions (IFRI) re-
search teams working in these regions. This chapter examines the opportunities
and challenges of research in Africa and Asia as compared to research in the Amer-
icas with respect to land tenure, land-cover change history, population characteris-
tics, and other factors that impact human-environment interactions.

AI.tldr: 本研究比较了美洲、非洲和亚洲森林生态系统中人类-环境互动研究的机遇与挑战，重点关注土地权属、土地覆盖变化历史、人口特征等因素。
AI.research_question: 在非洲和亚洲进行森林生态系统人类-环境互动研究时，与美洲相比面临哪些独特的机遇和挑战？
AI.motivation: 美洲的森林生态系统研究已形成连贯的研究项目并产生大量成果，但非洲和亚洲由于更高的人口密度、不同的制度环境等因素，对人类-环境互动研究提出了不同的挑战，需要专门探讨这些地区的独特研究条件。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于制度、人口与环境变化（CIPEC）的理论框架，结合国际森林资源与制度（IFRI）的研究方法，分析不同大陆背景下人类-森林资源互动的制度环境差异。
AI.method: 比较研究方法，利用CIPEC在2000年扩展到非洲和亚洲研究点后收集的数据，结合IFRI研究团队在这些地区已有的制度和生物物理信息，分析不同大陆在土地权属、土地覆盖变化历史、人口特征等方面的差异。
AI.findings: 非洲和亚洲相比美洲具有显著不同的研究条件：亚洲部分地区人口密度更高，两大洲都存在显著不同的地方制度环境，这些因素对人类-环境互动研究产生重要影响。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了人类-环境互动研究的理论框架，强调了制度环境和人口密度在塑造不同大陆森林生态系统研究差异中的重要性，为跨大陆比较研究提供了理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为在非洲和亚洲开展森林生态系统研究提供了实践指导，指出了这些地区特有的研究挑战（如土地权属复杂性、制度环境多样性），有助于研究设计和政策制定。

title: Asset Pricing in an Interstellar Economy
affiliations: Ramjas College, University of Delhi

detail.title: Asset Pricing in an Interstellar Economy
detail.abstract: I study asset pricing when information cannot travel instantaneously. In an interstellar economy, the relevant physical constraint is the finite speed of light: a market at distance d observes the source with delay τ=d/c. I show that delay increases forecast uncertainty because shocks realized during the unobserved interval accumulate, and that this uncertainty generates a positive risk adjustment even when agents are fully rational and symmetric. I operationalize the mechanism by treating the S&P 500 as a proxy for the source-market claim and constructing a lagged-observer ("Krypton") price path that (i) projects the stale signal forward using the sample drift and (ii) discounts the projection by a volatility-dependent uncertainty penalty. The induced dispersion is economically material (mean gap 30.39%) and pro-cyclical: a HAC regression links higher volatility observable on Krypton to a wider Earth-Krypton gap (β = 298.48, p = 6.77e-84). The results illustrate how causal information cones alone can generate location-specific prices and disagreement-like risk premia without behavioral bias or asymmetric information.

AI.tldr: 研究光速限制下信息延迟对资产定价的影响，发现延迟导致预测不确定性增加，即使理性对称投资者也会产生正风险调整，通过构建滞后观察者价格路径验证了经济显著的价格差异。
AI.research_question: 信息不能瞬时传播时（如受光速限制），资产定价如何受到影响？延迟观察如何导致价格差异和风险溢价？
AI.motivation: 传统资产定价理论假设信息瞬时传播，但在现实物理约束下（如光速限制），信息传播存在延迟，这如何影响市场定价和风险调整？
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于物理信息传播约束（光速限制）的资产定价理论，强调延迟观察导致的预测不确定性和风险调整机制。
AI.method: 理论建模延迟观察机制，实证上以S&P 500为源市场，构建滞后观察者（"Krypton"）价格路径：用样本漂移向前预测陈旧信号，并用波动率依赖的不确定性惩罚进行折现。
AI.findings: 1. 延迟增加预测不确定性，导致正风险调整；2. 地球-Krypton价格差异经济显著（平均差距30.39%）；3. 差异具有顺周期性：Krypton观测到的更高波动率与更宽价格差距相关（β=298.48，p=6.77e-84）。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 证明仅因果信息锥（光速限制）就能产生位置特异性价格和类似分歧的风险溢价，无需行为偏差或信息不对称；2. 为理性对称投资者下的延迟观察风险定价提供理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 提供测量信息延迟对资产价格影响的方法论；2. 揭示物理约束在金融市场中的实际重要性；3. 为跨时空投资策略提供理论依据。

title: Does Residential Segregation Affect the Generosity of Welfare Policies: Evidence from US States
affiliations: Purdue University Northwest

detail.title: Does Residential Segregation Affect the Generosity of Welfare Policies: Evidence from US States

declarations.funderStatement: The research was funded through Summer Research Fellowships provided by the University of California, Irvine's Department of Economics

detail.abstract: This study examines how residential segregation shapes the racial politics of welfare generosity in the United States. Despite rising racial diversity, residential segregation remains a persistent structural feature that influences intergroup contact, racial attitudes, and public policy. I introduce a novel state-level measure of interracial exposure between white and African American populations and analyze how variation in exposure is associated with differences in state welfare generosity. Welfare generosity is measured using cash benefit limits under the Temporary Assistance to Needy Families program and Medicaid spending on mental health services. The results indicate that, in most states, lower levels of segregation and greater interracial exposure are associated with more generous welfare policies, consistent with mechanisms of increased empathy toward economically disadvantaged African Americans. However, in states with relatively large African American populations-particularly in the Deep South-greater exposure is associated with less generous welfare policies, consistent with group-threat dynamics. These findings highlight how the spatial organization of race continues to shape welfare policy outcomes, underscoring the role of residential segregation in sustaining racialized policy attitudes and unequal social provision.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨了居住隔离如何影响美国福利政策的种族政治。研究发现，在大多数州，较低的隔离程度和更多的种族间接触与更慷慨的福利政策相关，但在非裔人口比例较高的州（特别是南方腹地），更多的接触反而与较不慷慨的福利政策相关。
AI.research_question: 居住隔离如何塑造美国福利慷慨度的种族政治？
AI.motivation: 尽管种族多样性增加，但居住隔离仍然是影响群体间接触、种族态度和公共政策的持久结构性特征。需要理解这种空间组织如何继续塑造福利政策结果。
AI.theoretical_framework:
1. 种族间接触理论（增加对经济弱势非裔美国人的同理心）
2. 群体威胁理论（在非裔人口比例较高的地区，更多的接触可能引发威胁感知）
AI.method: 引入州级白人-非裔美国人种族间接触的新测量指标，分析接触差异与州福利慷慨度的关系。福利慷慨度通过TANF计划的现金福利限额和Medicaid心理健康服务支出来衡量。
AI.findings: 在大多数州，较低的隔离程度和更多的种族间接触与更慷慨的福利政策相关（支持同理心机制）。但在非裔人口比例较高的州（特别是南方腹地），更多的接触与较不慷慨的福利政策相关（支持群体威胁动态）。
AI.theory_contributions:
1. 提出了种族间接触与福利政策关系的双重机制框架
2. 揭示了居住隔离作为种族化政策态度和不平等社会供给的持续作用
3. 强调了空间组织在塑造福利政策结果中的重要性
AI.practical_contributions:
1. 为政策制定者提供了理解福利政策差异的新视角
2. 强调了解决居住隔离对促进更公平福利政策的重要性
3. 为不同地区制定针对性福利政策提供了实证依据

title: Examination of Organizational Emotional Memory and Relationship Oriented Leadership’s Effects on Organizational Innovativeness in Energy Companies
affiliations: Bartin University, Bartin University and

detail.title: Examination of Organizational Emotional Memory and Relationship Oriented Leadership’s Effects on Organizational Innovativeness in Energy Companies

publicationDetails.detailsText: Latin American International Congress on Economic and Management Sciences-V | 2023

detail.abstract: Relationship-oriented leadership in organizations is an important factor for employees to have an egalitarian approach, to be solution and communication-oriented in their problems, to adopt positive feelings towards their organizations and to show creative activities in fulfilling their responsibilities towards their organizations. Relationship-oriented leaders can increase their innovative activities by sharing their power with their employees. However, with the sharing of this power, the sense of responsibility of the employees can also increase. For this reason, it is necessary to pay attention to the fact that this increased responsibility is to increase the creative and innovative activities of the employees. In other words, it is necessary for employees to expand their areas of responsibility where they can better use their knowledge related to their areas of expertise, or to have areas where they can fulfill their responsibilities. However, the knowledge of the employees who make up the organization is very important for organizational emotional memory. Thanks to the sharing of the knowledge of the organization from the past among the employees, it should be possible to carry out innovative activities for the future. In this context, organizational innovation must be sustainable in order for organizations to be successful against their competitors in an intense competitive environment. If organizational innovation cannot be realized, the life of the organization will be short in the sector it is in. In other words, due to the inability to realize innovation, the organization will have to gradually shrink and then end its activities. In this context, the research was conducted by collecting data from experts working in energy companies that make renewable energy investments in Istanbul. Looking at the results of the analysis, it is supported by the hypotheses that relationship oriented leadership and organizational emotional memory have a positive effect on organizational innovativeness. Since the data in the research were collected from energy companies investing in the field of renewable energy, whose headquarters are located in Istanbul, it should be evaluated by considering this limited situation in future research.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨关系导向型领导、组织情感记忆对组织创新性的影响，基于土耳其伊斯坦布尔可再生能源能源公司的专家数据，验证了关系导向型领导和组织情感记忆对组织创新性的正向作用。
AI.research_question: 关系导向型领导和组织情感记忆如何影响组织创新性？
AI.motivation: 在激烈竞争环境中，组织创新对组织生存至关重要。关系导向型领导通过权力分享可能促进员工创新活动，而组织情感记忆（员工知识共享）也是创新的重要基础。研究旨在验证这两者对组织创新性的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于关系导向型领导理论、权力分享理论、组织情感记忆理论和组织创新理论。关系导向型领导强调平等、沟通和积极情感；权力分享可能增加员工责任感；组织情感记忆涉及过去知识的共享；这些因素共同影响组织创新性。
AI.method: 采用问卷调查法，从土耳其伊斯坦布尔总部位于该地的可再生能源能源公司收集专家数据，进行定量分析验证假设。
AI.findings: 分析结果支持研究假设：关系导向型领导和组织情感记忆对组织创新性有正向影响。关系导向型领导通过权力分享促进创新，组织情感记忆通过知识共享支持创新活动。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 验证了关系导向型领导对组织创新性的作用机制；2) 明确了组织情感记忆在创新过程中的重要性；3) 整合了领导理论和组织记忆理论来解释创新；4) 为权力分享与创新关系提供了实证支持。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 建议组织培养关系导向型领导风格；2) 鼓励领导与员工分享权力；3) 建立有效的组织情感记忆系统促进知识共享；4) 为可再生能源行业提供创新管理启示；5) 提醒注意权力分享可能带来的责任增加需导向创新活动。

title: Progress and Trends in Novel Drug R&D of 2025: Technological Innovation, Clinical Breakthroughs, and Industrial Ecosystem Restructuring
affiliations: , Chinese Academy of Sciences (CAS) - Shanghai Institute of Nutrition and Health, Shanghai Pharmaceuticals Holding Co., Ltd and Chinese Academy of Sciences (CAS) - Shanghai Institute of Nutrition and Health

detail.title: Progress and Trends in Novel Drug R&D of 2025: Technological Innovation, Clinical Breakthroughs, and Industrial Ecosystem Restructuring

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare no conflict of interest.
declarations.ethicsApproval: There are no animal and human subjects in this article, and the ethical procedure is not applicable.
declarations.funderStatement: no funder.

detail.abstract: New drug development is a pivotal component that underpins innovation-driven growth, structural upgrading, and profound ecosystem restructuring in the pharmaceutical industry, against the backdrop of a global competitive landscape and breakthroughs in core technologies. In 2025, the volume and diversity of the newly approved drugs increased, alongside the significant expansion of clinical pipelines. This growth is particularly pronounced in frontier domains, including nextgeneration small-molecule therapeutics such as proteolysis-targeting chimeras (PROTACs), novel antibody drugs, and advanced cell and gene therapies (CGTs). Crucially, the technology platforms underpinning these fields have rapidly matured, driving R&D activities into a phase of accelerated iteration. Meanwhile, digital technologies, exemplified by artificial intelligence (AI), are rapidly permeating and integrating into the entire drug R&D lifecycle, fundamentally catalyzing a profound paradigm shift across the industry. Driven by the clinical value orientation, new drug development is increasingly concentrated on high-barrier innovation and meaningful clinical benefit, spurring breakthrough advances across multiple major disease areas and delivering substantial, irreplaceable improvements in therapeutic efficacy and patient survival. Under the dual pressures of intensifying global competition and the imminent patent expiration (patent cliff) of originator drugs, the global pharmaceutical R&D paradigm and innovation ecosystem are undergoing profound structural transformation. Within this rapidly evolving landscape, Chinese innovative pharmaceutical enterprises are transitioning from "rapid followers" to "value co-creators," emerging as a pivotal force in reshaping the global pharmaceutical innovation paradigm. In this study, we systematically reviewed the approval and clinical development landscape of innovative drugs in 2025, summarized the overall characteristics of pharmaceutical innovation from both technological and industrial perspectives, and presented forward-looking views on future trends in drug R&D.

AI.tldr: 本文系统回顾了2025年创新药物审批与临床开发格局，总结了医药创新的技术和产业特征，并对未来药物研发趋势提出前瞻性观点。
AI.research_question: 在全球竞争加剧和核心技术突破背景下，2025年创新药物研发呈现怎样的格局特征？中国创新药企如何从"快速跟随者"转变为"价值共创者"？
AI.motivation: 新药研发是医药产业创新驱动增长、结构升级和生态系统重构的关键，面临全球竞争格局和技术突破的双重压力，需要系统分析当前发展态势。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于创新生态系统理论、技术平台成熟度理论、临床价值导向理论，分析医药创新从技术突破到产业转型的多维度特征。
AI.method: 采用系统性文献回顾方法，分析2025年创新药物审批数据和临床开发管线，从技术和产业双重视角总结特征。
AI.findings: 2025年新药审批数量和多样性显著增加，前沿领域（PROTACs、新型抗体药物、CGTs）发展迅猛；技术平台快速成熟推动研发加速迭代；AI等数字技术深度渗透；创新聚焦高壁垒和临床价值；中国药企正从"快速跟随者"向"价值共创者"转型。
AI.theory_contributions: 构建了医药创新生态系统转型的理论框架，提出了"价值共创者"转型路径理论，丰富了技术平台成熟度与研发迭代加速的关系理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为药企研发战略制定提供数据支持，为政策制定者提供产业转型参考，为中国药企国际化发展提供路径指导，为投资者识别创新趋势提供分析框架。

title:
Strategic Organisms as Cybernetic Systems:
 A Unified Cybernetic Definition of SO(X) under Entropic Drift and Irreducibly Incomplete Information
affiliations: Rhodes University

detail.title:
Strategic Organisms as Cybernetic Systems:
 A Unified Cybernetic Definition of SO(X) under Entropic Drift and Irreducibly Incomplete Information

declarations.declarationOfInterest: Not Applicable
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not Applicable
declarations.funderStatement: None

detail.abstract: We define and formalise a single, generalisable scientific object: the Strategic Organism. The Strategic Organism is the universal bearer of strategy-understood here as coherence-preserving inference-and-action under entropy (QCEA)-in any domain where persistence is non-trivial under two joint constraints: (i) entropic drift (nonstationary contexts in which coherence decays unless actively maintained) and (ii) irreducibly incomplete information (in which available data are necessarily retrospective and the future is underdetermined by the past). In such regimes, viability requires a closed information-action architecture plus second-order governance of that architecture as drift tempo shifts. In this frame, strategy is treated as the operational phenotype of the system's viability architecture. This paper is a synthesis of two companion foundations: We adopt Mak's Cybernetic Intelligence Protocol (CIP) as the intelligence spine; in this manuscript we treat CIP as strategic intelligence (terms used interchangeably). Mak [2025] (compression-aware self-repair as intelligence, with an invariant governing functional) and Williams [2025] (strategy as coherence-preserving inference-and-action under entropy). The core construct is the predicate SO(X), presented as a cybernetic admissibility criterion: a system qualifies iff it exhibits autopoietic closure and a closed, strongly connected information-action cycle; a minimal operator set for sensing, communication, compression/inference, decision, action, repair, metagovernance, and time-distributed update; and (when applicable) a multilevel coherence constraint preventing subsystem policies from violating persistence at the designated system level. The formal specification is contained in this paper as Definitions D1-D14, Axioms S1-S18 (verbatim), Theorems T1-T6, and Candidate Equivalence C1, with explicit internal proofs for T1-T6 and C1. Annex A provides the primitive registry and minimal typing semantics required to interpret SO.1. Annex B provides a binding satisfaction-to-law bridge so the English axioms can be used as constraints without rewriting them. Annex C reproduces (in compatibility form) Mak's Cybernetic Intelligence Protocol (CIP) spine and maps it to SI(X) and the Mak functional block used here.

AI.tldr: 本文提出并形式化了一个通用的科学对象——战略有机体（Strategic Organism），作为在任何领域中承载战略的普遍载体。战略被定义为在熵条件下保持连贯性的推理与行动（QCEA）。该框架将战略视为系统生存架构的操作表型，需要封闭的信息-行动架构及其二阶治理来应对环境变化。
AI.research_question: 在熵漂移和信息不完全的约束下，系统如何通过战略（保持连贯性的推理与行动）实现持久生存？战略有机体作为战略的普遍载体需要满足哪些形式化条件？
AI.motivation: 现有战略理论缺乏统一的形式化框架来描述在各种非平稳、信息不完全环境中系统如何维持生存。需要建立一个通用的科学对象来捕捉战略的本质特征，为跨领域战略研究提供基础。
AI.theoretical_framework:
1. 战略有机体（SO(X)）作为战略的普遍载体
2. 熵条件下的连贯性保持推理与行动（QCEA）
3. 控制论智能协议（CIP）作为智能支柱
4. 自创生闭合与封闭的信息-行动循环
5. 二阶治理架构应对环境变化
AI.method: 形式化建模方法：通过定义（D1-D14）、公理（S1-S18）、定理（T1-T6）和候选等价关系（C1）构建严格的数学框架。使用控制论和系统理论的概念，结合信息论和自组织原理。
AI.findings:
1. 战略有机体必须满足控制论可容许性标准：自创生闭合、封闭的强连接信息-行动循环
2. 需要最小算子集：感知、通信、压缩/推理、决策、行动、修复、元治理和时间分布式更新
3. 多级连贯性约束防止子系统策略违反系统层面的持久性
4. 生存需要封闭的信息-行动架构及其二阶治理
AI.theory_contributions:
1. 首次提出战略有机体作为战略的通用科学对象
2. 建立了战略的形式化理论框架（QCEA）
3. 将控制论智能协议（CIP）整合为战略智能支柱
4. 提供了完整的公理化系统（14个定义、18个公理、6个定理）
5. 为跨领域战略研究提供了统一的理论基础
AI.practical_contributions:
1. 为组织、生物系统、人工智能等领域的战略设计提供形式化指导
2. 帮助系统设计者构建能在非平稳环境中持久生存的架构
3. 提供了评估系统战略能力的可操作标准
4. 为自适应系统和治理机制的设计提供理论支持

title: Frontier Technology Adoption and Inclusive Green Growth in the EU: A Double-edged Sword?
affiliations: , National University of Ireland, Maynooth (NUI Maynooth) - School of Business and National University of Ireland, Maynooth (NUI Maynooth) - School of Business

detail.title: Frontier Technology Adoption and Inclusive Green Growth in the EU: A Double-edged Sword?

declarations.funderStatement: This research was funded by the Irish Higher Education Authority [HCI PILLAR 3, 2024].

detail.abstract: As the EU Commission strategises towards a more technologically advanced region, a critical question arises: Does frontier technology adoption (FTR) truly foster inclusive green growth (IGG)? This study answers this question by empirically examining the impact of FTR on IGG, while accounting for the contingency role of electricity access. Applying pooled least squares, Driscoll-Kraay standard errors, and the dynamic generalised method of moments techniques, we uncover a paradox: while FTR accelerates economic growth and lowers greenhouse gas emissions, it exacerbates income inequality. The second lesson from this study is that although electricity access enhances the growth and environmental sustainability benefits of FTR, it only mitigates (but does not nullify) the downside of income inequality. These findings underscore the crucial need for the EU Commission to establish complementary and compensatory mechanisms to ensure that the EU's technological leap delivers greener and more inclusive growth.

AI.tldr: 欧盟前沿技术采纳促进经济增长和降低温室气体排放，但加剧收入不平等；电力接入增强其经济和环境效益，但仅部分缓解不平等问题
AI.research_question: 前沿技术采纳是否真正促进包容性绿色增长？电力接入在其中起什么调节作用？
AI.motivation: 欧盟委员会推动技术先进区域战略，但需要实证检验前沿技术采纳对包容性绿色增长的实际影响
AI.theoretical_framework: 包容性绿色增长理论、技术采纳理论、电力接入作为调节变量的理论框架
AI.method: 使用混合最小二乘法、Driscoll-Kraay标准误和动态广义矩估计技术进行实证分析
AI.findings: 发现悖论：前沿技术采纳促进经济增长和降低温室气体排放，但加剧收入不平等；电力接入增强经济增长和环境效益，但仅部分缓解不平等问题
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了技术采纳对包容性绿色增长的双重效应，提出电力接入的调节作用理论
AI.practical_contributions: 为欧盟委员会制定补充和补偿机制提供政策建议，确保技术飞跃实现更绿色和包容的增长

title: Judicial Review as a Constitutional Doctrine: Authority, Interpretation, and Democratic Contestation

detail.title: Judicial Review as a Constitutional Doctrine: Authority, Interpretation, and Democratic Contestation

declarations.declarationOfInterest: None
declarations.ethicsApproval: Yes all followed
declarations.funderStatement: None

detail.abstract: Judicial review is habitually apprehended as a juridical power immanent in, and derivative of, the supremacy of the constitutional text. Such a construal, however, remains conceptually truncated and normatively under-theorized, insofar as it neglects the doctrine's deeper institutional situatedness, its internal architecture of constraint, and its philosophical presuppositions. This article advances a reconceptualization of judicial review not as a monopolistic judicial entitlement but as a constitutional doctrine mediating the allocation, contestation, and provisional settlement of interpretive authority among coordinate state institutions. It undertakes a critical excavation of the historical and jurisprudential genealogy of judicial review, interrogates its structural relationship to constitutional supremacy, and exposes the persistent antinomies it generates within democratic self-government. Through sustained engagement with competing accounts of judicial supremacy, political constitutionalism, and comparative constitutional practice-most notably within the United Kingdom, the United States, India, and Bangladesh-the article contends that judicial review is neither inherently counter-democratic nor normatively unbounded. Rather, its constitutional legitimacy is contingent upon the internalization of principled institutional self-restraint, fidelity to constitutional structure as an ordering framework, and continued acknowledgment of the non-exclusive, dialogic character of constitutional interpretation across the full spectrum of constitutional actors.

AI.tldr: 本文重新概念化司法审查，将其从垄断性司法特权重构为协调国家机构间解释权分配、争议和临时解决的一种宪法学说。
AI.research_question: 司法审查的本质是什么？它如何与宪法至上原则相关联，并在民主自治中产生何种矛盾？
AI.motivation: 传统上将司法审查理解为宪法文本至上性的内在和衍生权力，这种理解在概念上不完整且规范理论上不足，忽视了该学说的制度背景、约束结构和哲学预设。
AI.theoretical_framework: 司法至上主义、政治宪政主义、比较宪政实践（英国、美国、印度、孟加拉国）、对话宪政理论、制度自我约束理论
AI.method: 批判性历史与法理学谱系分析、结构关系分析、比较宪政分析、理论对话与论证
AI.findings: 司法审查既非天生反民主也非规范上无边界；其宪法合法性取决于制度自我约束的内化、对宪法结构作为秩序框架的忠诚，以及对宪法解释对话性质的承认。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了司法审查的新概念框架，将其从司法垄断重构为机构间协调机制；阐明了司法审查与宪法至上的结构关系；揭示了民主自治中的内在矛盾及其解决路径。
AI.practical_contributions: 为司法审查实践提供了规范性指导：强调制度自我约束、宪法结构忠诚和对话性解释；为比较宪政实践（特别是英美印孟）提供了分析框架；对司法审查的民主合法性提供了建设性方案。

title: From Spin to Motion: Developing a Tri-Flywheel Model of Strategy & Finance Integration
affiliations: University of Birmingham - Birmingham Business School

detail.title: From Spin to Motion: Developing a Tri-Flywheel Model of Strategy & Finance Integration

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing financial or personal interests that could have influenced the research reported in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This study is purely conceptual and does not involve human participants, data collection, or experiments requiring ethical approval.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract:
Why has assessing firm performance become harder rather than easier in an age of AI-driven efficiency and analytics? In fast-feedback environments, small differences in timing, sequencing, and funding continuity compound into large performance gaps, shifting attention from whether firms improve to whether improvements are captured, protected, and redeployed rather than dissipated. In this sense, performance depends less on isolated gains in cost efficiency or customer value and more on how such gains are translated into financial capacity and fed back into subsequent cycles of improvement. To make this mechanism explicit, this paper develops the Tri-Flywheel Model, a system-level model in which cost and value flywheels compound only when coupled to a finance flywheel through explicit transmission and feedback mechanisms through three explicit transmission channels-operational-to-finance (OFT), value-to-finance (VFT), and capital-to-cost/value (CVT)-which govern how strategic gains are captured, redeployed, and protected over time." 
The model conceptualises compounding advantage as the interaction of three coupled flywheels: a cost flywheel that generates cost efficiency and cash velocity; a value flywheel that produces operating margin and value superiority; and a finance flywheel that converts these outcomes into profitability buffers, liquidity strength, renewal investment, and self-funding capacity. Three transmission channels-operational-to-finance translation, value-to-finance translation, and capital-to-cost/value translation-explain how strategic improvements become financial resources and how those resources enable renewed investment in cost and value creation. 
Across all three flywheels, motion is governed by a shared mechanical logic that relies on reinforcing drivers, recursive feedback, and loop velocity. When these elements align and transmission losses are contained, advantage compounds over time; when translation fails or renewal is constrained, performance erodes. The paper concludes by outlining a measurement-ready operationalisation of the model to support subsequent empirical applications.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了Tri-Flywheel模型，解释在AI时代企业绩效评估为何反而更难。模型包含成本、价值和财务三个相互耦合的飞轮，通过三个传输通道实现战略收益的捕获、再投资和保护，形成复合优势。
AI.research_question: 为什么在AI驱动效率和分析的时代，评估企业绩效反而变得更困难？企业如何通过成本、价值和财务三个飞轮的耦合与传输机制，实现战略收益的捕获、保护和再投资，从而形成持续的复合优势？
AI.motivation: 在快速反馈环境中，时间、顺序和资金连续性的微小差异会放大为巨大的绩效差距。关注点从"企业是否改进"转向"改进是否被捕获、保护和再投资而非消散"。绩效不再取决于孤立的成本效率或客户价值提升，而在于这些收益如何转化为财务能力并反馈到后续改进周期中。
AI.theoretical_framework: Tri-Flywheel模型：包含三个相互耦合的飞轮系统：1)成本飞轮（产生成本效率和现金速度）；2)价值飞轮（产生运营利润率和价值优势）；3)财务飞轮（转化为盈利缓冲、流动性强度、更新投资和自筹资金能力）。三个传输通道：运营到财务传输(OFT)、价值到财务传输(VFT)、资本到成本/价值传输(CVT)。
AI.method: 理论建模方法，开发系统级概念模型。通过机械逻辑（强化驱动、递归反馈、循环速度）解释飞轮间的相互作用。模型具有可测量的操作化框架，为后续实证应用提供基础。
AI.findings: 当三个飞轮对齐且传输损失得到控制时，优势会随时间复合；当传输失败或更新受限时，绩效会侵蚀。绩效取决于战略收益如何通过传输通道转化为财务资源，以及这些资源如何重新投资于成本和价值创造。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 提出Tri-Flywheel系统模型，解释复合优势的形成机制；2) 识别三个关键传输通道(OFT, VFT, CVT)；3) 引入机械逻辑（强化驱动、递归反馈、循环速度）作为飞轮运动的基础理论框架；4) 将绩效评估从孤立指标转向动态系统视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 提供可测量的操作化框架，支持企业绩效评估；2) 帮助企业识别传输损失点，优化战略收益捕获；3) 指导企业如何将运营改进转化为可持续的财务能力；4) 为管理者提供系统视角，平衡成本、价值和财务的协同发展。

title: Flowshop Rescheduling Problem with Rush Orders
affiliations: Fuzhou University, Fuzhou University, Fuzhou University and Central South University

detail.title: Flowshop Rescheduling Problem with Rush Orders
detail.abstract: Rush orders frequently disrupt manufacturing processes, requiring rapid and effective rescheduling. This study investigates the flowshop rescheduling problem with rush orders, aiming to minimize both makespan and schedule instability. We first formulate the problem as a mixed-integer linear program (MILP) and analyze its structural properties. Leveraging these properties, we design a property-based heuristic for the two-stage problem, which is provably optimal for the permutation flowshop case and achieves a constant-factor bound in the non-permutation case. For the three-stage problem, we develop a Multi-Agent Deep Deterministic Policy Gradient (MADDPG) approach. Computational experiments validate the effectiveness of our methods: the property-based heuristic produces solutions within 4% of the Gurobi solver on average while requiring less than 0.01 seconds of runtime. Meanwhile, MADDPG consistently outperforms classical scheduling methods, achieving an average objective value of 409.9 with a standard deviation of 25.2 in small-scale tests, while maintaining a success rate above 60% in large-scale instances. Furthermore, MADDPG exhibits superior computational efficiency, with solution times under 0.3 seconds. Overall, this study enhances production efficiency and enables rapid responses to rush orders, thereby contributing to greater stability and resilience of manufacturing operations.

AI.tldr: 本文研究带紧急订单的流水车间重调度问题，旨在最小化完工时间和调度不稳定性。针对两阶段问题设计了基于性质的启发式算法，针对三阶段问题开发了MADDPG方法，均表现出优异的计算效率和求解质量。
AI.research_question: 如何有效解决带紧急订单的流水车间重调度问题，以同时最小化完工时间和调度不稳定性？
AI.motivation: 紧急订单频繁扰乱制造过程，需要快速有效的重调度来维持生产效率和稳定性，但现有方法在同时优化完工时间和调度稳定性方面存在不足。
AI.theoretical_framework: 混合整数线性规划（MILP）理论、多智能体深度确定性策略梯度（MADDPG）强化学习框架、流水车间调度理论。
AI.method: 1) 建立MILP模型并分析结构性质；2) 针对两阶段问题设计基于性质的启发式算法；3) 针对三阶段问题开发MADDPG方法；4) 通过计算实验验证方法有效性。
AI.findings: 基于性质的启发式算法能在0.01秒内获得接近Gurobi求解器（平均差距4%）的解；MADDPG方法在小规模测试中平均目标值409.9（标准差25.2），大规模实例中成功率超60%，计算时间低于0.3秒，均优于传统调度方法。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 建立了带紧急订单的流水车间重调度问题的MILP模型；2) 证明了基于性质的启发式算法在置换流水车间情况下的最优性；3) 为非置换情况提供了常数因子界保证；4) 将MADDPG框架应用于复杂调度问题。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 提供了快速有效的重调度方法，能在秒级时间内响应紧急订单；2) 提高了生产效率和系统稳定性；3) 增强了制造运营的韧性和响应能力；4) 为实际生产中的紧急订单处理提供了实用解决方案。

title: Towards Liberating Education: A Proposed Rights-based Instructional Planning Approach for Teaching Higaonon Learners in the Philippines
affiliations: University of the Philippines Los Baños

detail.title: Towards Liberating Education: A Proposed Rights-based Instructional Planning Approach for Teaching Higaonon Learners in the Philippines
detail.abstract: This study proposes a rights-based instructional planning approach for teachers serving indigenous learners, particularly those assigned to schools in Higaonon communities (IPEd). The content of the paper focuses on the following:(1) assumptions about Higaonon indigenous learners; (2) components of the right-based instructional planning approach; and (3) facilitating and hindering factors that may affect the implementation of the right-based instructional planning approach. The researcher used an exploratory research design to develop the proposed planning approach. It was conducted in Higaonon communities in the Municipality of Esperanza, Agusan Del Sur, Philippines. The responses of the selected school officials, IPEd teachers, Higaonon tribal leaders, parents, students, and external stakeholders. The responses of the selected school officials, IPEd teachers, Higaonon tribal leaders, parents, students, and external stakeholders. This paper strongly believes that shifting from a culture-based to right-based IPEd teaching approach is expected to lay down positive changes in all aspects of life for indigenous learners, including social, economic, education, civic, and political, as they begin to understand and protect the inherent rights to ancestral domains, cultural integrity, self-governance, and social justice which are accounted for them. The early inculcation of Indigenous Peoples Rights Act (IPRA) law into their identity formation through school curriculum is projected to eradicate all forms of discrimination, exclusion, alienation, disintegration, and vulnerabilities in mainstream societies.

AI.tldr: 本研究提出了一种基于权利的课程规划方法，用于服务原住民学习者（特别是Higaonon社区）的教师，从文化基础转向权利基础的教学方法，旨在促进原住民学习者在社会、经济、教育、公民和政治等各方面的积极变化。
AI.research_question: 如何为服务原住民学习者（特别是Higaonon社区）的教师开发基于权利的教学规划方法？
AI.motivation: 当前原住民教育主要采用文化基础方法，需要转向权利基础方法，以帮助原住民学习者理解和保护他们在祖传领地、文化完整性、自治和社会正义方面的固有权利，消除主流社会中的歧视、排斥和边缘化。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于权利的教育方法、原住民权利理论、社会正义理论，特别是菲律宾《原住民权利法》（IPRA）的法律框架。
AI.method: 采用探索性研究设计，在菲律宾Agusan Del Sur省Esperanza市的Higaonon社区进行，收集学校官员、原住民教育教师、部落领袖、家长、学生和外部利益相关者的反馈。
AI.findings: 提出了基于权利的教学规划方法，包括对Higaonon原住民学习者的假设、方法的具体组成部分，以及影响实施过程的促进和阻碍因素。
AI.theory_contributions: 将原住民教育从文化基础范式转向权利基础范式，为原住民教育理论提供了新的视角，强调权利意识在身份形成中的重要性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为教师提供了具体的教学规划工具和方法，帮助原住民学习者理解和主张自己的权利，促进社会包容和减少歧视，具有实际教育应用价值。

title: Feature-driven Robust Stochastic Scheduling for Printed Circuit Board Assembly
affiliations: Fuzhou University, Fuzhou University, Dongbei University of Finance and Economics, Fuzhou University and South China University of Technology

detail.title: Feature-driven Robust Stochastic Scheduling for Printed Circuit Board Assembly
detail.abstract: In printed circuit board assembly line scheduling, variability in machine performance and human intervention introduces significant uncertainty in processing and setup times, creating substantial challenges to achieving optimal schedules that impact customer satisfaction and production efficiency. This paper formulates the assembly process as identical parallel machines where both processing and setup times are uncertain, to minimize total completion time and makespan. We propose a feature-driven robust stochastic optimization model that leverages linear support vector regression to predict processing time and an event-wise ambiguity set derived from K-means clustering to capture setup time variability. The model is reformulated as a mixed-integer linear program and solved using a branch-and-price (B&P) algorithm for efficient optimization. Extensive computational experiments using real-world data from a global leading electronics manufacturer demonstrate that our model consistently outperforms sample average approximation (SAA) and standard distributionally robust optimization (DRO) models, achieving objective value improvements of 52% over the SAA model and 33% over the DRO model. The B&P algorithm efficiently solves realistically sized instances optimally within practical time limits. Based on the sensitivity analysis, the number of setup scenarios for scheduling settings significantly influences the tradeoff relationship between the solution accuracy and computational efficiency. This feature-driven optimization model has been successfully implemented in the electronics manufacturer since September 2022, enhancing throughput by 10.3% and reducing annual savings around 1.65 million US dollars.

AI.tldr: 本文针对PCB组装线调度中的不确定性，提出了一种基于特征驱动的鲁棒随机优化模型，结合SVR预测处理时间和K-means聚类的事件模糊集，通过B&P算法求解，在实际应用中显著提升了生产效率和成本节约。
AI.research_question: 如何在PCB组装线调度中处理机器性能变化和人为干预带来的处理时间和设置时间不确定性，以最小化总完成时间和最大完工时间？
AI.motivation: PCB组装线中机器性能变化和人为干预导致处理时间和设置时间存在显著不确定性，这严重影响调度优化、客户满意度和生产效率，需要开发有效的鲁棒优化方法。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1) 鲁棒随机优化理论；2) 线性支持向量回归(SVR)用于处理时间预测；3) 基于K-means聚类的事件模糊集用于捕捉设置时间变异性；4) 分支定价(B&P)算法理论。
AI.method: 1) 将装配过程建模为同型并行机器问题；2) 构建特征驱动的鲁棒随机优化模型；3) 使用SVR预测处理时间；4) 使用K-means聚类构建事件模糊集；5) 将模型重构为混合整数线性规划；6) 采用B&P算法求解；7) 使用全球领先电子制造商的真实数据进行计算实验。
AI.findings: 1) 提出的模型在目标值上比SAA模型提升52%，比标准DRO模型提升33%；2) B&P算法能在实际时间限制内有效求解现实规模实例；3) 设置场景数量显著影响解精度与计算效率的权衡；4) 实际应用中提升吞吐量10.3%，年节约约165万美元。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 提出了结合SVR预测和事件模糊集的特征驱动鲁棒随机优化框架；2) 开发了针对PCB组装线不确定性的新型建模方法；3) 提供了处理时间和设置时间不确定性的综合解决方案。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 为电子制造商提供了有效的调度优化工具；2) 显著提升生产效率(10.3%吞吐量提升)；3) 实现显著成本节约(年节约165万美元)；4) 自2022年9月起成功实施于实际生产环境。

title: Tourism as a Portfolio: Demand Composition, Correlation, and Destination-Level Risk Under External Shocks Evidence from New York City and Philippine Tourism Hubs
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: Tourism as a Portfolio: Demand Composition, Correlation, and Destination-Level Risk Under External Shocks Evidence from New York City and Philippine Tourism Hubs

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares that there are no known competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study utilizes publicly available secondary aggregate data provided by the official government agencies (e.g., the Philippine Department of Tourism and NYC Tourism + Conventions). No individual-level data or human subjects were involved; therefore, this research did not require formal institutional ethics board approval.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no specific grant from any funding agency in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.

detail.abstract: This study examines how tourism demand composition and correlation structure shape destination-level volatility, downside risk, and resilience under recurrent external shocks. Drawing on Modern Portfolio Theory, tourism destinations are conceptualized as portfolios of interdependent demand segments whose joint configuration determines exposure to systemic risk. Using visitor arrivals as a consistent proxy for tourism activity, the analysis compares a globally integrated urban tourism system-New York City-with selected Philippine tourism hubs characterized by greater reliance on domestic demand and exposure to localized environmental shocks. The results show that destinations with concentrated and highly correlated demand portfolios experience higher volatility and deeper losses during global shocks. In contrast, the presence of lower-correlation segments, particularly domestic tourism, significantly reduces downside risk and supports recovery even when overall volatility remains elevated. The findings also reveal the limits of conventional diversification strategies: expanding the number of tourism markets does not reduce risk when dominant segments remain highly correlated. By reframing tourism resilience as a structural property of demand portfolios, the study highlights the importance of correlation-aware diversification in resilient tourism system design.

AI.tldr: 该研究将旅游目的地视为相互依存的需求组合，分析需求构成与相关性如何影响目的地面对外部冲击时的波动性、下行风险和韧性。研究发现，需求集中且高度相关的目的地在全球冲击中波动更大、损失更深；而低相关性需求（特别是国内旅游）能显著降低下行风险并支持复苏。传统多元化策略存在局限：当主导需求高度相关时，增加市场数量无法降低风险。
AI.research_question: 旅游需求构成和相关性结构如何影响目的地层面的波动性、下行风险和韧性？
AI.motivation: 理解旅游目的地面对反复外部冲击时的风险暴露和韧性机制，为设计更具韧性的旅游系统提供理论基础。
AI.theoretical_framework: 现代投资组合理论：将旅游目的地概念化为相互依存的需求组合，其联合配置决定系统性风险暴露。
AI.method: 使用游客到达量作为旅游活动的一致代理变量，比较全球一体化城市旅游系统（纽约市）与依赖国内需求和面临本地环境冲击的菲律宾旅游枢纽。
AI.findings: 1. 需求集中且高度相关的目的地在全球冲击中经历更高波动性和更深损失；2. 低相关性需求（特别是国内旅游）显著降低下行风险并支持复苏；3. 传统多元化策略存在局限：当主导需求高度相关时，增加市场数量无法降低风险。
AI.theory_contributions: 将旅游韧性重新定义为需求组合的结构属性，强调相关性感知的多元化在韧性旅游系统设计中的重要性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为旅游目的地管理者提供基于需求组合分析的韧性设计策略，强调关注需求相关性而非单纯市场数量扩张。

title: Automated Analysis for Operations Research: Achieving Data Efficiency and Reliability with Large Language Models
affiliations: Hong Kong University of Science & Technology (HKUST) - Department of Industrial and Engineering and Logistics Management, North Carolina State University and HKUST

detail.title: Automated Analysis for Operations Research: Achieving Data Efficiency and Reliability with Large Language Models
detail.abstract: Automating Operations Research (OR) analysis, which involves formulating optimization models from natural language descriptions and generating executable solver code, could reduce reliance on scarce expert knowledge. While Large Language Models (LLMs) are natural candidates for this task, they suffer from probabilistic inconsistency, often requiring multiple sampling attempts to produce correct outputs. Moreover, existing learning-based methods face a data efficiency dilemma: high-quality training data is essential for reliability but prohibitively expensive to acquire at scale. We propose OR-R1, a data-efficient framework that integrates Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) with Test-Time Group Relative Policy Optimization (TGRPO). Our key innovation, TGRPO, extracts reliable training signals from unlabeled data by generating multiple candidate solutions and treating the solver-verified consensus as the ground truth, thereby effectively resolving the data efficiency dilemma. We provide theoretical guarantees for gradient convergence and demonstrate that this voting-based proxy reward consistently maximizes true solution accuracy. Practically, TGRPO significantly improves output consistency, narrowing the gap between single-attempt (Pass@1) and multiple-attempt (Pass@8) performance from 13% to 7%. Extensive experiments demonstrate that OR-R1 requires only 10% of the synthetic training data used by prior methods, yet achieves 67.7% average accuracy, surpassing baselines by 4.2%.

AI.tldr: OR-R1框架通过结合监督微调和测试时群体相对策略优化，解决了自动化运筹学分析中的数据效率困境，仅需10%的训练数据就能达到67.7%的平均准确率。
AI.research_question: 如何开发一个数据高效的框架来自动化运筹学分析，解决大型语言模型在生成优化模型和求解器代码时的概率不一致性和数据效率问题？
AI.motivation: 自动化运筹学分析可以减少对稀缺专家知识的依赖，但现有方法面临两个主要问题：1）大型语言模型的概率不一致性，需要多次采样才能获得正确输出；2）数据效率困境，高质量训练数据对可靠性至关重要但获取成本极高。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1）监督微调（SFT）用于基础模型训练；2）测试时群体相对策略优化（TGRPO）作为核心创新，通过生成多个候选解并将求解器验证的共识作为真实标签，从无标签数据中提取可靠的训练信号。
AI.method: OR-R1框架结合SFT和TGRPO。TGRPO的关键机制：生成多个候选解决方案，使用求解器验证这些方案，将多数共识作为真实标签，以此作为代理奖励来优化模型。提供了梯度收敛的理论保证，证明这种基于投票的代理奖励能够最大化真实解的正确性。
AI.findings: 1）TGRPO显著提高了输出一致性，将单次尝试（Pass@1）和多次尝试（Pass@8）性能差距从13%缩小到7%；2）OR-R1仅需先前方法10%的合成训练数据，就能达到67.7%的平均准确率，比基线方法高出4.2%。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）提出了TGRPO方法，理论上证明了梯度收敛性；2）证明了基于投票的代理奖励能够最大化真实解的正确性；3）为从无标签数据中提取可靠训练信号提供了理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 1）开发了OR-R1框架，显著降低了自动化运筹学分析对训练数据的需求；2）提高了模型输出的一致性，减少了需要多次采样的需求；3）在实际应用中，仅需少量数据就能达到优于现有方法的性能，降低了部署成本。

title: Robust Satisficing Single Machine Scheduling with Family Setup Times and Release Dates
affiliations: Fuzhou University, Fuzhou University, Tianjin University, New York University (NYU) - Leonard N. Stern School of Business and Fuzhou University

detail.title: Robust Satisficing Single Machine Scheduling with Family Setup Times and Release Dates
detail.abstract: In the electronics manufacturing industry, Just-in-Time (JIT) procurement of strategic materials, such as chips, introduces considerable uncertainty in product release dates. This disrupts the grouping of homogeneous jobs for batch production, leading to additional setups and delivery delays. This study investigates a single-machine scheduling problem with the total flow time (TFT) minimization objective, assuming uncertainty in material release dates as well as in job processing times. We develop a robust satisficing (RS) scheduling model and present an improved branch-and-bound (B&B) algorithm incorporating heuristic initialization and dynamic upper-bound updates to enhance solution efficiency. Using real-world data from a leading global manufacturer, the RS model reduces TFT by an average of 21.4% compared to a deterministic model (DM) and sample average approximation (SAA), and by 3.03% compared to the distributionally robust optimization (DRO) model based on conditional value-at-risk (CVaR). Moreover, the improved B&B algorithm achieves solution times 44.5% faster than the commercial Gurobi solver. Sensitivity analysis further reveals that higher release date variability increases setup frequency, JIT material arrivals improve responsiveness, and longer setup times reduce setups but increase TFT. These results highlight the managerial insight that benefits manufacturers by complementing JIT responsiveness with process innovation and automation to reduce setup times and preserve efficiency amid uncertainty.

AI.tldr: 本研究针对电子制造业中JIT采购导致物料释放日期不确定的问题，开发了鲁棒满意调度模型和改进分支定界算法，相比传统方法平均减少21.4%的总流程时间，算法速度比Gurobi快44.5%。
AI.research_question: 在物料释放日期和作业处理时间均存在不确定性的情况下，如何优化单机调度以最小化总流程时间？
AI.motivation: 电子制造业中JIT采购战略材料（如芯片）导致物料释放日期不确定，这破坏了同质作业的批处理分组，导致额外的设置时间和交付延迟。
AI.theoretical_framework: 鲁棒满意调度理论、分支定界算法、不确定性调度理论、JIT采购理论
AI.method: 开发鲁棒满意调度模型，提出改进的分支定界算法（包含启发式初始化和动态上界更新），使用全球领先制造商的真实数据进行验证，并与确定性模型、样本平均近似、基于CVaR的分布鲁棒优化模型进行比较。
AI.findings: 1. RS模型比DM和SAA平均减少21.4%的TFT，比DRO模型减少3.03%；2. 改进的B&B算法比Gurobi求解器快44.5%；3. 敏感性分析显示：释放日期变异性增加导致设置频率增加，JIT物料到达提高响应性，较长的设置时间减少设置次数但增加TFT。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 开发了考虑物料释放日期和作业处理时间双重不确定性的鲁棒满意调度模型；2. 提出了改进的分支定界算法，通过启发式初始化和动态上界更新提高求解效率；3. 扩展了不确定性调度理论在JIT制造环境中的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为制造商提供实用的调度优化工具，显著减少总流程时间；2. 提供管理启示：通过流程创新和自动化减少设置时间，在不确定性中保持效率；3. 算法实现快速求解，适合实际生产环境应用。

As this article submits, the promotion of cultural diversity is a laudable cause in and of itself, and a first step towards achieving equality. AI.tldr: 本文探讨文化多样性概念在国际政策中的广泛运用及其在文化市场中的模糊性，认为虽然文化多样性本身是值得追求的目标，但其过于宽泛的定义和功能不明确可能削弱其实际效果。
AI.research_question: 文化多样性概念在国际政策框架中的定义、功能和实际效果如何？其宽泛性和模糊性对文化市场政策制定有何影响？
AI.motivation: 过去二十年，联合国教科文组织等国际机构多次强调文化多样性的重要性，并制定了相关公约。然而，文化多样性概念过于宽泛，包含人权、民主参与、可持续发展、文化产业保护、跨文化对话、文化遗产保护等多种理由，导致其内容和功能在文化市场中不明确。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于国际文化政策理论，特别是2005年联合国教科文组织《保护和促进文化表现形式多样性公约》框架，分析文化多样性概念的多重理论基础和功能定位。
AI.method: 文献分析和政策文本分析，主要考察联合国教科文组织及其他联合国机构的相关公约、政策文件和会议记录，对文化多样性概念进行批判性分析。
AI.findings: 文化多样性概念在国际政策中无处不在，但其定义过于宽泛，功能不明确，这可能导致政策实施效果有限。虽然文化多样性本身是值得追求的目标，但其模糊性可能削弱其在文化市场中的实际作用。
AI.theory_contributions: 对文化多样性概念进行批判性分析，揭示其在国际政策框架中的内在矛盾，为文化政策理论提供新的视角，强调概念精确性对政策有效性的重要性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供建议，强调需要更精确地定义文化多样性的内容和功能，以确保相关政策在国际文化合作中产生实际效果，真正促进文化平等。

title: The Three Phases of the Tribal Self-Determination Era and the Phase Out of Federal Paternalism
affiliations: Stanford Law School

detail.title: The Three Phases of the Tribal Self-Determination Era and the Phase Out of Federal Paternalism
detail.abstract:
We commonly call the last fifty years of federal Indian law and policy the “tribal self-determination era.” This Piece argues that this era is actually three conceptually distinct though temporally overlapping phases of federal Indian law and policy development. Each of these three distinct phases is a step further dismantling the structures of federal paternalism and replacing them with laws and policies that support tribal nations’ strength, capacity, and autonomy. Paternalism has become, therefore, somewhat of an anti–North Star for the transformative federal Indian policies of the last fifty years and can continue to serve as that anti-guiding light for further federal Indian law and policy development. What makes this era challenging and noteworthy is that it is characterized by an instance of something unusual and difficult for a government: a commitment to giving up power.

Now this commitment is at a crossroads. The Biden Administration championed a third phase of policies with traditionally conservative, small government–minded commitments to start shrinking federal government bloat and promoting deference to or cooperation with local tribal decisionmaking. The Trump Administration must decide between conservative impulses to continue this work of shrinking unnecessary federal bureaucracy or more authoritarian impulses to increase the control that funding gives the executive branch over entities like tribal nations that rely on that funding.

AI.tldr: 本文认为过去50年的联邦印第安法律政策"部落自决时代"实际上包含三个概念不同但时间重叠的阶段，每个阶段都在逐步拆除联邦家长式统治结构，代之以支持部落国家力量、能力和自主权的法律政策。家长式统治成为这一时期的"反北极星"指导原则，而这一时代的挑战在于政府放弃权力的承诺。当前这一承诺正处于十字路口。
AI.research_question: 过去50年联邦印第安法律政策的"部落自决时代"如何演变？其发展阶段、特征和未来走向是什么？
AI.motivation: 重新审视和澄清"部落自决时代"的实质内涵，分析其发展阶段的特征，为当前政策选择提供理论框架，特别是在政府放弃权力承诺面临十字路口的背景下。
AI.theoretical_framework: 联邦印第安法律政策发展阶段理论；家长式统治（paternalism）作为"反北极星"的指导原则；政府权力让渡理论；部落自决与联邦关系演变框架。
AI.method: 概念分析与历史分期方法；政策文本分析；法律政策演变的历史比较分析；理论框架构建与案例论证。
AI.findings: 1. 部落自决时代包含三个概念不同但时间重叠的阶段；2. 每个阶段都在逐步拆除联邦家长式统治结构；3. 家长式统治成为政策转型的"反北极星"指导原则；4. 这一时代的核心挑战是政府放弃权力的承诺；5. 当前政策处于保守主义缩减官僚机构与威权主义加强控制之间的十字路口。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了联邦印第安法律政策发展的三阶段理论框架；发展了"家长式统治作为反北极星"的概念工具；深化了政府权力让渡理论在部落-联邦关系中的应用；为理解法律政策演变提供了新的分析视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了清晰的历史发展阶段框架；帮助识别当前政策选择的十字路口；为部落国家争取自主权提供理论支持；为联邦政府政策调整提供指导原则；有助于平衡缩减官僚机构与维护部落自主权的关系。

title: Antarctica as a Model for Global Peace A Compelling Contemporary Example of how Nations can Thrive Through Collaboration
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, Independant, Independent, University of Colorado at Boulder, Arizona State University, Independent, Independent, Goethe University Frankfurt and Plymouth Marine Laboratory

detail.title: Antarctica as a Model for Global Peace A Compelling Contemporary Example of how Nations can Thrive Through Collaboration

keywords: Antarctic Treaty System. Peaceful Governance. International Cooperation. Global Peace Strategy. Environmental Stewardship. Science Diplomacy. Multilateralism Rules-based International Order Conflict Prevention Transdisciplinary Governance Southern Ocean Protection Sovereignty Neutralization Strategic Necessity Global Stability Science-Policy Interface Climate Security Sustainable Shared Spaces Antarctic Diplomacy Resource Management Global Commons Governance Geopolitical Stability Regional Security Interdisciplinary Dialogue International Law Conservation Policy Collective Security Model

detail.abstract:
Collective reflection on how Antarctica serves as humanity's most successful model of peaceful governance and international cooperation (20+ Authors, 16 Countries). It demonstrates that stability, trust, and shared purpose can prevail even amidst global tensions. The publication frames the safeguarding of the Antarctic region not only as a scientific or environmental priority but as a strategic necessity for the future of humanity.

"Antarctica represents one of humanity’s most hopeful choices: demonstrating that peace, cooperation, and conservation are possible even in a tense and divided world. This book reminds us that Antarctica is not only something to protect, but something to learn from—and to share. In doing so, Antarctica inspires us and challenges us to believe that a more peaceful and cooperative global future remains within reach. José María Figueres, Former President of Costa Rica (1994–1998)"

This volume represents an unprecedented collective endeavor, uniting a select group of leading voices from across the world to reflect on Antarctica and its enduring role as a model for peace. Its contributors include scholars, diplomats, policymakers, and experts whose fields span law, science, governance, history, culture, and international relations. Together, they bring a remarkable convergence of perspectives: those deeply engaged in Antarctic affairs joined by specialists in peace studies and global cooperation. The result is a dialogue that is both rigorous and forward-looking, bridging disciplines and regions in pursuit of a shared understanding of how peace can be sustained in a complex and changing world. In contrast to the extensive literature on geopolitics, environmental policy, or exploration, there are few works devoted to examining how Antarctica itself has become one of humanity’s most extraordinary achievements in peaceful governance—and how that experience can inspire solutions in other global contexts. The need for such work has never been more urgent.

Beyond contributing to academic scholarship, this book aspires to spark a broader reflection on the value of Antarctic peace: to recognize it as a milestone of human cooperation, to defend it amid rising international tensions, and to draw from it the lessons necessary to confront the divisions and conflicts of our time.

The expectation of the authors is that this book will awaken—and help accelerate—a vision shared by groups, communities, and societies worldwide: that peace is indeed possible. If the necessary conditions are met, and if humanity commits to the deliberate construction of peace, then it can be achieved. The hope is that this work will contribute to a global dialogue in which more people, more societies, and more stakeholders recognize their role in shaping peace, and that it will inspire participation in a movement to build a healthier, more stable, more secure, and more peaceful world.

A PDF version of the book can be read and downloaded at www.agendaantartica.org/peacebook

AI.tldr: 本书探讨南极洲如何成为人类最成功的和平治理与国际合作典范，分析其作为全球和平模式的价值，并探讨如何将南极经验应用于解决其他全球性冲突。
AI.research_question: 南极洲如何成为人类最成功的和平治理与国际合作典范？这一经验如何为其他全球性冲突提供启示和解决方案？
AI.motivation: 当前全球紧张局势加剧，急需探索可持续的和平模式。南极洲作为人类历史上最成功的和平治理典范，其经验价值尚未得到充分研究和应用，需要系统性地分析这一模式以应对当今世界的分裂与冲突。
AI.theoretical_framework: 国际关系理论、和平研究理论、治理理论、国际合作理论、环境治理理论，以及多学科交叉视角（法律、科学、历史、文化等）。
AI.method: 集体反思与多学科对话方法，汇集来自16个国家、20多位学者的跨学科视角，包括学者、外交官、政策制定者、专家等，通过严谨的学术对话和案例分析进行研究。
AI.findings: 南极洲证明了即使在紧张分裂的世界中，和平、合作与保护也是可能的；南极和平模式基于稳定性、信任和共同目标；保护南极不仅是科学或环境优先事项，更是人类未来的战略必要。
AI.theory_contributions: 填补了南极作为和平治理典范研究的学术空白；发展了多学科融合的和平研究框架；提出了"南极和平模式"作为可复制的国际合作理论；丰富了全球治理理论中的成功案例研究。
AI.practical_contributions: 为国际社会提供了可借鉴的和平治理模式；激发了全球对南极和平价值的更广泛反思；为政策制定者提供了应对全球冲突的实际启示；促进了跨领域、跨区域的和平对话与合作。

detail.abstract: This paper derives a unified model for both catastrophe and corporate bonds to study the implications of natural disaster risks. We obtain arbitrage-free valuations that are intuitive and easy to implement empirically. We illustrate their application to quantify financial risks from hurricanes and wildfires. Results show that market implied catastrophe (cat) event probabilities are materially larger than the corresponding statistical probabilities, especially for wildfires, implying significant cat event risk premium. These cat event probabilities are used to decompose corporate bond default probabilities into business and cat risks (with extension to municipal bonds). We show that cat risks in exposed corporate bonds are time varying, and that they increase and remain persistent after major cat events, reflecting heightened market uncertainty. Our approach can be used by investors and policymakers to understand the broader financial implications of natural disaster risks.

AI.tldr: 本文建立了一个统一的巨灾债券和公司债券模型，用于研究自然灾害风险的影响。通过无套利定价方法，量化了飓风和野火等灾害的财务风险，发现市场隐含的巨灾事件概率显著高于统计概率，表明存在显著的巨灾风险溢价。该方法可用于分解公司债券违约风险中的商业风险和巨灾风险。
AI.research_question: 自然灾害风险对金融市场（特别是巨灾债券和公司债券）有何影响？如何量化这些风险并分解债券违约风险中的不同风险成分？
AI.motivation: 随着自然灾害（如飓风、野火）频发，理解这些灾害对金融市场的系统性影响变得日益重要。现有研究缺乏统一的框架来同时分析巨灾债券和公司债券中的灾害风险，需要开发实用方法来量化这些风险。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于无套利定价理论，建立统一的巨灾债券和公司债券定价模型。该框架整合了灾害事件概率、风险溢价和违约风险分解等概念。
AI.method: 采用无套利定价方法，推导出直观且易于实证实施的估值模型。应用该模型量化飓风和野火的财务风险，分析市场隐含灾害概率与统计概率的差异，并分解公司债券违约风险。
AI.findings: 1. 市场隐含的巨灾事件概率显著高于统计概率，特别是野火灾害，表明存在显著的巨灾风险溢价。2. 可将公司债券违约概率分解为商业风险和巨灾风险。3. 受灾害影响的公司债券中的巨灾风险具有时变性，在重大灾害事件后风险增加并持续存在，反映了市场不确定性的加剧。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出了统一巨灾债券和公司债券的定价模型。2. 发展了分解债券违约风险中商业风险和巨灾风险的方法论。3. 扩展了无套利定价理论在自然灾害风险领域的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为投资者提供了量化自然灾害财务风险的工具。2. 帮助政策制定者理解自然灾害对金融市场的系统性影响。3. 该方法可应用于市政债券等其他金融工具的风险分析。

detail.abstract: Gender representation quotas are a popular and well-researched means to increase female representation in government. There is evidence that quotas affect social norms, but the observational and theoretical literature also argues that a broader suite of interventions is necessary to target social attitudes and power structures that must change before gains in equality can become self- sustaining. Capacity- and network-building coupled with economic empowerment interventions may increase the supply of qualified female candidates. Messaging strategies, changes to social norms, and working with men’s groups (among other key stakeholders) could potentially increase the demand for female candidates and a safe, enabling environment.

AI.tldr: 性别代表配额是提高政府中女性代表比例的常用且研究充分的方法。虽然配额会影响社会规范，但需要更广泛的干预措施来改变社会态度和权力结构，才能实现可持续的性别平等。

AI.motivation: 虽然性别配额已被证明能增加女性在政府中的代表比例，但仅靠配额本身可能不足以实现可持续的性别平等。需要更全面的干预措施来改变深层次的社会态度和权力结构。
AI.theoretical_framework: 性别平等理论、社会规范理论、政治代表理论、能力建设理论、网络效应理论、经济赋权理论
AI.method: 文献综述和理论分析，综合现有观察性和理论性文献，提出综合性干预框架
AI.findings:
1. 配额制度确实影响社会规范，但不足以实现可持续的性别平等
2. 需要能力建设和网络建设结合经济赋权干预来增加合格女性候选人的供给
3. 需要信息策略、社会规范改变和与男性团体等关键利益相关者合作来增加对女性候选人的需求
4. 需要创造安全、有利的环境来支持女性政治参与
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个超越单纯配额的综合性性别平等干预框架，强调供给端（能力、网络、经济）和需求端（社会规范、利益相关者参与）的双重干预策略
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了具体的干预措施建议：能力建设、网络支持、经济赋权、信息策略、社会规范改变、与男性团体合作等，以创造可持续的性别平等环境

detail.abstract: This paper investigates the relationship between competition policy and environmental sustainability, and aims to infer policy implications for Türkiye. It outlines the theoretical underpinnings where competition can drive eco-innovation and discusses international efforts to align competition policies with sustainability goals in the context of sustainability agreements, in particular. The analysis includes a short overview of Türkiye's environmental policy framework and an examination of the Turkish Competition Authority's (TCA) approach to sustainability agreements through case studies. The study reveals that TCA has shown an approach towards integrating sustainability into competition assessments, yet there is a need for clearer guidance to encourage collaborative sustainability initiatives among undertakings without risking antitrust violations. The paper concludes by recommending the adoption of specific sustainability-focused guidelines to provide businesses with the necessary clarity and support to contribute to Türkiye's environmental objectives while fostering competitive markets.

publicationDetails.detailsText: Forthcoming in Rethinking the Corporate Form Across the National and International Divide, edited by  Tim Connor, Andre Dao, Adil Hasan Khan, Sundhya Pahuja and Timothy Peters

detail.abstract: If time travel were possible, and we brought to our present 1970s international legal scholars, they would be surprised to find out that multinational corporations (MNCs) are not a major subject in international economic law. Of course, MNCs are relevant political and economic actors, and a few excellent books are dedicated to the study of MNCS and the law specifically. Yet, most subfields of international economic law—trade, investment, finance—operate as if these business giants had no political, economic, social or cultural influence. MNCs may be modern-day Leviathans, or at least business historians insist so, but most international economic lawyers do as if these corporations were just exporters, importers or investors. This essay argues that indeed we lack a vocabulary to address MNCs as politically relevant actors by examining how international investment law—that is investment treaties and investor-state dispute settlement (ISDS)—recasts these powerful Leviathans as depoliticized foreign private investors. That is, my subject is not a single text or artefact, but a discursive pattern that is repeated across most, if not all, international economic instruments.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨国际投资法如何通过投资条约和投资者-国家争端解决机制，将具有政治影响力的跨国公司重新塑造为去政治化的外国私人投资者，揭示了国际经济法缺乏描述跨国公司作为政治相关行为者的词汇。
AI.research_question: 国际投资法如何通过投资条约和投资者-国家争端解决机制，将具有政治影响力的跨国公司重新塑造为去政治化的外国私人投资者？
AI.motivation: 尽管跨国公司在政治、经济、社会和文化方面具有重要影响力，但国际经济学的大多数子领域（贸易、投资、金融）却表现得好像这些商业巨头没有这些影响力。国际经济学缺乏将跨国公司作为政治相关行为者来讨论的词汇。
AI.theoretical_framework: 话语分析理论，探讨国际法律文本如何通过特定术语和框架塑造对跨国公司的理解；去政治化理论，分析法律机制如何将政治行为者转化为技术性、非政治化的实体。
AI.method: 文本分析和话语分析，通过考察国际投资条约和投资者-国家争端解决机制的法律文本和实践，识别其中如何构建和重塑跨国公司的身份和角色。
AI.findings: 国际投资法通过将跨国公司定义为"外国私人投资者"，将其从具有政治影响力的行为者转化为纯粹的经济参与者，从而掩盖了其政治权力和影响力。这种话语模式在国际经济法律工具中普遍存在。
AI.theory_contributions: 为理解国际法如何通过话语实践塑造和限制对非国家行为者的认知提供了理论框架；揭示了国际投资法中的去政治化机制如何影响对跨国公司角色的理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 指出了国际法律改革需要关注如何更好地承认和规范跨国公司的政治影响力；为政策制定者提供了重新思考跨国公司在国际经济法中地位的视角。

detail.abstract: This paper advances the "Organizational Thermodynamics" framework by integrating the concept of phase equilibrium. By defining the organization as Phase α and the market environment as Phase β, we analyze the thermodynamic interaction between the two. We demonstrate that the sustainability of an organization is not merely a function of internal capital accumulation but is governed by the temperature gradient between the organization and the market. Furthermore, we mathematically prove that excessive liquidity supply by a sovereign government raises the market temperature (T_β), eliminating the necessary gradient for entropy disposal, thereby leading the system to heat death.

AI.tldr: 该论文通过引入相平衡概念扩展了"组织热力学"框架，将组织定义为α相，市场环境定义为β相，分析两者间的热力学相互作用。研究发现组织可持续性不仅取决于内部资本积累，更受组织与市场间温度梯度调控。研究还证明主权政府过度提供流动性会提高市场温度，消除熵处置所需梯度，导致系统热寂。
AI.research_question: 组织可持续性的热力学机制是什么？主权政府过度提供流动性如何通过影响组织与市场间的温度梯度破坏系统稳定性？
AI.motivation: 现有组织理论缺乏对组织与环境间能量交换的物理机制解释，需要建立更系统的热力学框架来理解组织可持续性的本质条件。
AI.theoretical_framework: 组织热力学框架、相平衡理论、热力学第二定律、熵增原理、温度梯度概念
AI.method: 理论建模与数学证明，通过定义组织为α相、市场为β相，构建相平衡热力学模型，分析温度梯度对熵处置的影响机制
AI.findings: 1. 组织可持续性由组织与市场间的温度梯度决定，而非仅内部资本积累；2. 主权政府过度流动性供给会提高市场温度(T_β)；3. 温度梯度消失导致系统无法有效处置熵，最终走向热寂
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 将相平衡概念引入组织热力学框架；2. 建立组织-市场相平衡模型；3. 揭示温度梯度作为组织可持续性的关键热力学条件
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者提供流动性管理的热力学依据；2. 帮助企业理解环境温度变化对组织可持续性的影响；3. 预警过度干预可能导致系统热寂的风险

detail.abstract: The challenge of slowing deforestation and degradation in the tropical regions of Latin America requires financing mechanisms (public and private) that can enable actions to preserve and sustainably manage forest integrity. This paper begins by examining the strategy implemented by the World Bank to protect forest cover in tropical countries. Next, through a quantitative analysis of available World Bank data, analysis is made of the relevance, evolution, and spatial distribution of funding allocated to forestrelated projects in Latin America across two decades (2002-2022). The study aids accurate assessment of the effectiveness of sustainable forest-management initiatives undertaken across an ecosystem whose preservation is vital to the entire planet, also offering insights to support the launch of new initiatives.

title: Best Practices and Quality Assurance among Education Service Contracting Secondary Schools in the Philippines
affiliations: University of the Philippines Los Baños

detail.title: Best Practices and Quality Assurance among Education Service Contracting Secondary Schools in the Philippines
detail.abstract: Using a survey research design, this study determined the best practices for school certification and identified areas for improvement among Education Service Contracting (ESC)-participating schools in the core and support areas. It also examined the extent of compliance with Department of Education (DepEd) minimum standards and the Private Education Assistance Committee (PEAC) certification requirements among ESC-participating schools in San Pablo City, Laguna, Philippines. Findings revealed that the schools' best practices are reflected in their extent of compliance with the certification standards in the areas of Curriculum, Assessment, and Instruction, as well as School Philosophy, Vision, Mission, Goals, and Objectives, as assessed by the Certification Assessment Instrument (CAI) for e-Recertification. The CAI aspects of schools that require improvement to provide quality assurance are the School Budget and Finance, Physical Plant and Instructional Facilities, and Academic Support and Student Development Services. This information would benefit the School Quality Assurance Team/PEAC by providing a better understanding of how they can help private educational institutions maintain quality assurance and ensure recertification in the country. By enhancing the overall quality of education, school certification helps create an environment that nurtures the intellectual and holistic development of students, preparing them for a successful future.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过调查设计，确定了菲律宾圣巴勃罗市ESC参与学校在认证方面的最佳实践和改进领域，发现学校在课程、评估、教学以及学校哲学、愿景、使命、目标方面表现良好，但在学校预算与财务、物理设施和学术支持服务方面需要改进。
AI.research_question: 1. 什么是ESC参与学校的最佳认证实践？2. 哪些领域需要改进？3. 学校在多大程度上遵守了教育部最低标准和PEAC认证要求？
AI.motivation: 研究旨在帮助私立教育机构维持质量保证并确保重新认证，通过提升教育质量为学生创造有利于智力发展和全面发展的环境。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于教育质量保证理论、学校认证标准和私立教育援助框架，研究采用认证评估工具（CAI）作为评估框架。
AI.method: 采用调查研究设计，使用认证评估工具（CAI）对菲律宾圣巴勃罗市拉古纳的ESC参与学校进行评估，分析学校在核心和支持领域的合规程度。
AI.findings: 学校在课程、评估、教学以及学校哲学、愿景、使命、目标方面表现出最佳实践并高度合规；需要改进的领域包括学校预算与财务、物理设施和学术支持与学生发展服务。
AI.theory_contributions: 为教育质量保证理论提供了实证支持，明确了学校认证中不同维度的相对重要性，丰富了私立教育机构认证评估的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为学校质量保证团队/PEAC提供具体指导，帮助私立教育机构识别改进领域、维持质量保证、确保重新认证，最终提升整体教育质量。

title: Redesigning Government Bond Market: A Proposal for Increasing Market Liquidity

detail.title: Redesigning Government Bond Market: A Proposal for Increasing Market Liquidity

declarations.funderStatement: Nobody

detail.abstract: The government bond market, a cornerstone of global finance, suffers from liquidity fragmentation due to the inherent non-fungibility of bonds. Each unique combination of coupon and maturity creates a legally distinct contract, dispersing trading activity and complicating risk management. While derivatives like bond futures offer partial solutions, they operate alongside this market's structural flaw, rather than addressing it. This paper proposes a fundamental architectural redesign: the structural decomposition of a standard zero-coupon government bond into two related, but standalone, tradable instruments. The first is a fungible Capital Right (CR), representing the issuer's general, undated obligation to repay principal. The second is a Maturity Right (MR), conferring the specific right to schedule repayment of a CR on a predetermined date. This CR-MR framework decouples credit from duration risks, consolidates all credit exposure into a single liquidity pool for the CRs, while creating a pure interest rate market via MRs. The article details the mechanics and benefits of this system, including creating a unique, liquid instrument for government creditworthiness trading, enhanced flexibility for duration management, improved collateral framework, and more precise tools for governments to manage their debt. It also provides some valuation thoughts and addresses implementation challenges and proposes the Incremental Maturity Change (IMC) as a feasible transitional pilot towards a more integrated, liquid, and efficient government debt market.

AI.tldr: 本文提出将标准零息政府债券结构分解为两个独立可交易工具：代表发行人一般无期限偿还本金义务的可替代资本权(CR)，以及授予在预定日期安排CR偿还权利的可替代期限权(MR)。这一CR-MR框架将信用风险与久期风险分离，为政府债券市场提供更高效、更具流动性的架构。
AI.research_question: 如何通过结构性重新设计解决政府债券市场因债券非可替代性导致的流动性碎片化问题？
AI.motivation: 政府债券市场作为全球金融基石，由于每只债券（不同票息和到期日组合）都是独特的法律合同，导致交易活动分散、风险管理复杂。现有衍生品如债券期货只能部分缓解问题，而非解决市场结构性缺陷。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于金融工程和资产证券化理论，提出将债券分解为信用风险和利率风险两个独立维度的可交易工具，实现风险分离和流动性集中。
AI.method: 提出CR-MR结构性分解框架：将标准零息政府债券分解为可替代资本权(CR)和可替代期限权(MR)，详细阐述该系统的运作机制、估值方法和实施路径。
AI.findings: CR-MR框架能够：1)创建独特的流动性工具用于交易政府信用；2)增强久期管理的灵活性；3)改进抵押品框架；4)为政府债务管理提供更精确工具；5)通过增量期限变更(IMC)实现可行过渡。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出政府债券市场的根本性架构重新设计，将信用风险与久期风险分离，为债券市场流动性问题提供创新理论解决方案。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政府债券市场提供更高效、更具流动性的交易架构，改善风险管理工具，增强市场效率，并通过IMC提出可行的实施路径。
