detail.title: Grand Challenges: The Role of Management, Organizations, and Institutions

publicationDetails.detailsText: Scheve, Clara , Cope, Amando , Burnett, Lauryn , & Gehman, Joel (2026). Grand Challenges: The Role of Management, Organizations, and Institutions. obo in Management. doi: 10.1093/obo/9780199846740-0245

detail.abstract: Research on grand challenges has evolved over time, moving from the analysis of specific social problems to the recognition of complex, large-scale issues that demand collective and interdisciplinary approaches. This shift is evident in the progression of theoretical perspectives, highlighting how researchers have increasingly focused on the social construction, collaboration, and contextual sensitivity required to address grand challenges. In this article, we provide an overview of theoretical and empirical contributions that deepen our understanding of how management, organizations, and institutions engage with and respond to grand challenges. The selected works engage with frameworks such as robust action, paradox theory, and institutional theory to examine how complex, persistent problems are addressed across multiple levels of analysis. We also highlight selected research topics which received particular attention—including global health and microfinance—alongside methodological reflections.

AI.tldr: 这篇论文回顾了关于"重大挑战"研究的发展历程，从分析特定社会问题转向认识需要集体和跨学科方法的复杂大规模问题，并总结了管理、组织和制度如何应对这些挑战的理论与实证贡献。
AI.research_question: 管理、组织和制度如何参与和应对重大挑战？重大挑战研究如何从特定社会问题分析演变为需要集体和跨学科方法的复杂大规模问题？
AI.motivation: 重大挑战研究经历了重要演变，需要系统梳理其理论发展脉络，理解管理、组织和制度在应对这些复杂问题中的作用，为未来研究提供方向。
AI.theoretical_framework: 稳健行动理论、悖论理论、制度理论，以及社会建构、协作和情境敏感性等视角。
AI.method: 文献综述与理论分析，结合对选定研究主题（如全球健康、小额信贷）的考察和方法论反思。
AI.findings: 重大挑战研究已从特定社会问题分析转向需要集体和跨学科方法的复杂大规模问题；管理、组织和制度通过多种理论框架在不同分析层面上应对这些挑战；全球健康和小额信贷是受到特别关注的研究领域。
AI.theory_contributions: 系统梳理了重大挑战研究的理论演进，整合了稳健行动、悖论理论和制度理论等框架，为理解复杂社会问题的应对机制提供了多层次分析视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为管理者和组织提供了应对重大挑战的理论指导，强调了协作、跨学科方法和情境敏感性的重要性，特别在全球健康和小额信贷等实践领域具有应用价值。

title: Empirical Insights into Systemic Risk: From Housing Boom to Global Financial Crisis
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: Empirical Insights into Systemic Risk: From Housing Boom to Global Financial Crisis
detail.abstract:
Provides an empirical, econometric analysis of the 2007–08 Global Financial Crisis, examining the roles of monetary policy, global savings imbalances, financial innovation, and housing market dynamics in the buildup and collapse of systemic risk.

Applies time-series and multivariate econometric techniques—including regression analysis, stationarity testing, cointegration, and Granger causality—to identify statistically significant drivers of housing price inflation and bubble formation across pre-bubble, bubble, and post-bubble periods

AI.tldr: 该论文对2007-08年全球金融危机进行实证计量分析，研究货币政策、全球储蓄失衡、金融创新和房地产市场动态在系统性风险积累和崩溃中的作用。
AI.research_question: 货币政策、全球储蓄失衡、金融创新和房地产市场动态如何影响系统性风险的积累和崩溃？
AI.motivation: 理解全球金融危机的根本原因，特别是系统性风险如何在不同因素作用下积累并最终崩溃。
AI.theoretical_framework: 系统性风险理论、金融泡沫理论、货币政策传导机制、全球储蓄失衡理论、金融创新理论。
AI.method: 时间序列和多元计量经济分析，包括回归分析、平稳性检验、协整分析和格兰杰因果检验，分析泡沫前、泡沫期和泡沫后三个时期的数据。
AI.findings: 识别了房价通胀和泡沫形成的统计显著驱动因素，揭示了货币政策、全球储蓄失衡、金融创新和房地产市场动态在系统性风险积累中的具体作用机制。
AI.theory_contributions: 为系统性风险理论提供实证支持，深化对金融泡沫形成机制的理解，完善货币政策与金融稳定关系的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供识别和防范系统性风险的实证依据，帮助监管机构更好地监测金融稳定，为金融机构风险管理提供参考。

title: Reports as Risk Signals: A Text-as-Data Topic-Model Measure of Power-Market Narratives
affiliations: University of Technology Sydney

detail.title: Reports as Risk Signals: A Text-as-Data Topic-Model Measure of Power-Market Narratives
detail.abstract: Under pressure, power-market institutions act quickly and publish public accounts that frame risk, responsibility, and reform, yet this institutional record is rarely analysed quantitatively. We assemble more than two decades of institutional reporting from Australia’s National Electricity Market and convert the publication stream into measurable narrative signals using text-as-data topic models. We show that five themes capture about 54% of narrative attention, led by the persistent dominance of gas supply and security, followed by emissions policy, retail pricing, reliability, and renewables integration. These narrative shifts are not random. Topic attention moves in step with major policy cycles, reform waves, and stress events. About 45% of topic–outcome pairs show a peak correlation when the narrative leads the outcome. Importantly, system-security themes often rise ahead of market volatility and capacity shortfalls. This supports narrative indicators as early warning tools for emerging stress, standardising reporting themes across agencies, and embedding fuel-risk triggers in reliability assessments.

AI.tldr: 该研究分析了澳大利亚国家电力市场20多年的机构报告，使用文本主题模型将报告转化为可测量的叙事信号。研究发现五个主题占据了约54%的叙事关注度，其中天然气供应与安全占据主导地位，其次是排放政策、零售定价、可靠性和可再生能源整合。叙事变化与政策周期、改革浪潮和压力事件同步，约45%的主题-结果对显示叙事领先于实际结果，表明叙事指标可作为早期预警工具。
AI.research_question: 电力市场机构在压力下发布的公共报告如何反映风险、责任和改革的叙事变化？这些叙事信号能否作为市场压力和系统风险的早期预警指标？
AI.motivation: 电力市场机构在压力下会迅速发布公共报告来构建风险、责任和改革的叙事，但这些机构记录很少被定量分析。研究者希望了解这些叙事如何随时间变化，以及它们是否能预测市场结果。
AI.theoretical_framework: 制度叙事理论、文本即数据方法、主题建模、机构报告分析框架、叙事与政策周期关系理论
AI.method: 收集澳大利亚国家电力市场20多年的机构报告，使用文本即数据主题模型将报告流转化为可测量的叙事信号，分析主题关注度的变化模式，检验叙事信号与市场结果（如波动性、容量短缺）的时间相关性。
AI.findings: 1. 五个主题占据约54%的叙事关注度：天然气供应与安全（主导）、排放政策、零售定价、可靠性、可再生能源整合；2. 叙事变化不是随机的，而是与主要政策周期、改革浪潮和压力事件同步；3. 约45%的主题-结果对显示叙事领先于实际结果；4. 系统安全主题通常在市场波动和容量短缺之前上升，支持叙事指标作为早期预警工具。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 将制度叙事理论应用于电力市场分析；2. 开发了机构报告文本的定量分析方法；3. 验证了叙事信号作为政策周期和市场压力的领先指标；4. 建立了叙事变化与制度变革之间的理论联系。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 叙事指标可作为电力市场压力的早期预警工具；2. 支持跨机构报告主题的标准化；3. 建议在可靠性评估中嵌入燃料风险触发机制；4. 为政策制定者和市场监管者提供基于数据的决策支持。

title: Understanding The 2007-08 Financial Crisis, The Story Of The Housing Bubble And Bust: An Empirical Analysis
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: Understanding The 2007-08 Financial Crisis, The Story Of The Housing Bubble And Bust: An Empirical Analysis
detail.abstract:
The 2007-08 financial crisis has been claimed to be the most severe one in modern history and possibly the worst one in the post-World War II period. Several factors have been criticized that led to this financial debacle including easy monetary policy pursued by the Greenspan Federal Reserve post 2000, global financial imbalances, Fannie, Freddie and subprime lenders inflating the housing bubble, securitized debt obligations receiving AAA ratings and the utter recklessness of some of the top banking houses. What followed were forceful responses by central banks around the world in a frantic attempt to avoid the utter collapse of the global financial system and save the world from entering into a deep global recession.

In light of the severity of this crisis and being regarded as the most virulent global financial crisis ever, this paper seeks to understand what were the underlying causes of the financial crisis and the many lessons that need to be learned to prevent such a crisis from happening again.

AI.tldr: 本文分析2007-08年全球金融危机的根本原因，探讨如何防止类似危机再次发生。
AI.research_question: 2007-08年金融危机的根本原因是什么？我们需要从这次危机中吸取哪些教训来防止类似危机再次发生？
AI.motivation: 2007-08年金融危机被认为是现代史上最严重、二战后最严重的金融危机，对全球金融体系造成巨大冲击，需要深入理解其根本原因并吸取教训。
AI.theoretical_framework: 金融危机的理论框架，包括货币政策、全球金融失衡、住房泡沫、证券化债务评级、金融机构风险管理等理论。
AI.method: 基于文献综述和案例分析的方法，分析金融危机的原因和应对措施。
AI.findings: 金融危机由多种因素共同导致：格林斯潘时期的美联储宽松货币政策、全球金融失衡、房利美和房地美及次级贷款机构推高住房泡沫、证券化债务获得AAA评级、主要银行的鲁莽行为等。
AI.theory_contributions: 为金融危机理论提供了实证支持，揭示了多重因素相互作用导致系统性风险的机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者、监管机构和金融机构提供了防止类似危机再次发生的具体教训和改革建议。

title: The Legal Protection of Performers and Folklore in Nigeria: Doctrinal Gaps and Cultural Realities
affiliations: Elizade University Faculty of Law

detail.title: The Legal Protection of Performers and Folklore in Nigeria: Doctrinal Gaps and Cultural Realities
detail.abstract: This paper interrogates the protection of performers' rights and the expression of folklore under Nigerian copyright law, arguing that the existing legal framework privileges formal ownership over cultural justice. While the Copyright Act 2022 represents a landmark departure from earlier legislation by recognising performers' economic and moral rights and prohibiting the unauthorized exploitation of folklore, this work argues that these advances are fundamentally undermined by a state-centric custodianship regime that excludes performers and indigenous communities from effective reward. The work analyses the performative nature of folklore within the Nigerian cultural ecosystem, and demonstrates the integral roles of performers as not passive transmitters of traditions but active creative agents whose labour sustains the nation's cultural heritage. The paper concludes that Nigeria's copyright regime, as currently structured offers an illusionary protection and recognition that gives no empowerment nor redistribution. It ultimately calls for a reimagining of folklore protection grounded in community autonomy and cultural fairness.

AI.tldr: 尼日利亚版权法在保护表演者权利和民间传说表达方面存在缺陷，虽然2022年《版权法》承认了表演者的经济和精神权利，并禁止未经授权利用民间传说，但国家中心的监管制度排除了表演者和土著社区的有效回报，导致保护成为虚幻。
AI.research_question: 尼日利亚版权法如何保护表演者权利和民间传说表达？现有法律框架是否真正实现了文化正义？
AI.motivation: 现有尼日利亚版权法框架偏向形式所有权而非文化正义，2022年《版权法》虽有进步但存在根本性缺陷，需要重新思考民间传说保护模式。
AI.theoretical_framework: 文化正义理论、表演者权利理论、民间传说保护理论、知识产权与文化遗产关系理论。
AI.method: 法律文本分析、理论分析、文化生态系统分析、表演性质分析。
AI.findings: 1. 2022年《版权法》承认表演者经济和精神权利，禁止未经授权利用民间传说；2. 但国家中心监管制度排除了表演者和土著社区的有效回报；3. 表演者在尼日利亚文化生态系统中是积极的创造性主体而非被动传统传播者；4. 现有版权制度提供的是虚幻的保护和认可，没有赋予权力也没有重新分配。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 批判了形式所有权优先于文化正义的法律框架；2. 提出了表演者作为积极创造性主体的理论视角；3. 揭示了国家中心监管制度的局限性；4. 为基于社区自治和文化公平的民间传说保护提供了理论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 指出尼日利亚版权法的实际缺陷；2. 呼吁重新构想基于社区自治和文化公平的民间传说保护模式；3. 为政策制定者提供改革方向；4. 为表演者和土著社区争取权益提供理论支持。

title: Real Costs, Real Impacts: A Path to Social Services Sustainability - The Case Studies
affiliations: The University of Western Australia - UWA Business School and University of Western Australia

detail.title: Real Costs, Real Impacts: A Path to Social Services Sustainability - The Case Studies

declarations.ethicsApproval: This research was approved by the University of Western Australia Human Research Ethics Committee.
declarations.funderStatement: This research was funded by Catholic Social Services Australia

detail.abstract: Real Costs, Real Impacts: A Path to Social Services Sustainability presents the findings of a mixed methods case analysis of seven large not-for-profit social service organisations across Australia. The study, conducted by the Centre for Public Value UWA, provides case evidence of the financial pressures faced by service providers during the cost-of-living crisis and high inflation period and the implications for service sustainability, funding policy, and community wellbeing.

AI.tldr: 对澳大利亚七家大型非营利社会服务组织的混合方法案例分析，揭示了在生活成本危机和高通胀时期服务提供者面临的财务压力，以及对服务可持续性、资助政策和社区福祉的影响。
AI.research_question: 在生活成本危机和高通胀时期，非营利社会服务组织面临哪些财务压力？这些压力如何影响服务可持续性、资助政策和社区福祉？
AI.motivation: 当前生活成本危机和高通胀环境下，社会服务组织面临前所未有的财务压力，需要了解这些压力对服务提供和社区福祉的实际影响，以制定有效的资助政策和确保服务可持续性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 社会服务可持续性理论、非营利组织财务管理理论、公共价值理论、资源依赖理论
AI.method: 混合方法案例研究，对澳大利亚七家大型非营利社会服务组织进行深入分析
AI.findings: 揭示了社会服务组织在生活成本危机和高通胀时期面临的具体财务压力，这些压力对服务提供能力、组织可持续性和社区福祉产生了显著负面影响
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了社会服务可持续性理论在高通胀环境下的应用，丰富了非营利组织财务压力与公共价值创造之间关系的理论理解
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供实证依据，帮助设计更有效的社会服务资助模式；为服务提供者提供应对财务压力的策略建议；促进社区福祉的可持续保障

title: Sudan's Totalitarianism, Economy and Corruption: A Theoretical and Empirical Analysis
affiliations: Al-Neelain University - Department of Economics  and Al-Neelain University - Department of Economics

detail.title: Sudan's Totalitarianism, Economy and Corruption: A Theoretical and Empirical Analysis
detail.abstract: This paper examines the nexus between totalitarian governance, institutional corruption, and economic development through both theoretical modeling and empirical analysis. Corruption represents not merely a moral transgression but an endemic phenomenon that systematically undermines economic performance under authoritarian regimes. We develop a formal mathematical model demonstrating how corruption increases macroeconomic volatility while simultaneously reducing long-term growth trajectories. Using comparative institutional analysis and game-theoretic frameworks, we show that totalitarian structures create endogenous incentives for rent-seeking behavior, resource misallocation, and systematic expropriation. Empirical evidence from Middle Eastern and North African economies reveals that corruption reduces investment efficiency, distorts government expenditure composition, and increases business cycle inconsistencies. The model proves that under totalitarian governance, corrupt officials optimally allocate resources to low-productivity, high-volatility projects that generate private rents while imposing negative social returns. We further demonstrate that the absence of rule of law creates moral hazard conditions where "bad firms" with negative expected social returns can survive through bribery, crowding out productive enterprises. Policy implications emphasize the critical importance of institutional quality, democratic governance structures, and effective legal frameworks for sustainable economic development. The analysis contributes to the theoretical literature on political economy, institutional economics, and development theory while providing actionable insights for anticorruption policy design.

AI.tldr: 本文通过理论建模和实证分析，探讨了极权治理、制度腐败与经济发展之间的关系。研究发现腐败不仅是道德问题，更是在威权体制下系统性破坏经济表现的普遍现象。腐败会增加宏观经济波动，同时降低长期增长轨迹。
AI.research_question: 极权治理下的制度腐败如何影响经济发展？腐败在威权体制下如何通过特定机制破坏经济表现？
AI.motivation: 腐败通常被视为道德问题，但在极权体制下，它已成为系统性破坏经济发展的普遍现象。需要深入理解腐败在威权治理结构下的运行机制及其对经济的具体影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 比较制度分析、博弈论框架、政治经济学、制度经济学、发展理论。采用形式化数学模型分析腐败对宏观经济波动和长期增长的影响。
AI.method: 1. 建立形式化数学模型，分析腐败如何增加宏观经济波动并降低长期增长；2. 使用比较制度分析和博弈论框架；3. 对中东和北非经济体进行实证分析，考察腐败对投资效率、政府支出结构和商业周期一致性的影响。
AI.findings: 1. 腐败增加宏观经济波动，降低长期增长轨迹；2. 极权结构内生性地激励寻租行为、资源错配和系统性征用；3. 腐败降低投资效率，扭曲政府支出结构，增加商业周期不一致性；4. 腐败官员倾向于将资源配置到低生产率、高波动性的项目中以获取私人租金；5. 缺乏法治导致道德风险，使具有负社会回报的"坏企业"通过贿赂生存，挤出生产性企业。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 发展了腐败在威权体制下影响经济发展的理论模型；2. 丰富了政治经济学、制度经济学和发展理论文献；3. 揭示了极权治理与腐败之间的内生关系；4. 提供了腐败影响宏观经济波动和长期增长的机制分析。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 强调制度质量、民主治理结构和有效法律框架对可持续发展的关键重要性；2. 为反腐败政策设计提供可操作的见解；3. 指出需要改革治理结构以减少腐败对经济的负面影响；4. 为政策制定者提供了具体的干预方向。

title: It's All Relative: Brazil's Copernican Household Finance Innovations Transform Micro and Macro Finance
affiliations: Georgetown University - McDonough School of Business

detail.title: It's All Relative: Brazil's Copernican Household Finance Innovations Transform Micro and Macro Finance
detail.abstract: Brazil's 2023 introduction of two novel household finance instruments-RendA+ (a retirement income bond) and Educa+ (an education income bond)-represents a meaningful shift in how micro and macro finance theory and practice should approach investments and policy design. Rather than framing financial decision-making around abstract notions of "expected utility of wealth", these instruments are explicitly designed around household finance's cash-flow (also called "goals"). In doing so, Brazil has operationalized a goals-based approach to finance that has implications well beyond household investing, extending to asset pricing, financial inclusion, monetary policy, and sovereign debt management. It also unintentionally allowed for a robust, Islamic Finance-centric, sharia-compliant micro and macro finance theory.

AI.tldr: 巴西2023年推出的RendA+（退休收入债券）和Educa+（教育收入债券）代表了家庭金融理论和实践的重大转变，从传统的"财富预期效用"框架转向以现金流/目标为基础的设计，对资产定价、金融包容性、货币政策等领域有广泛影响。
AI.research_question: 巴西新推出的目标导向型金融工具（RendA+和Educa+）如何改变家庭金融理论和实践，并对更广泛的金融体系产生什么影响？
AI.motivation: 传统金融理论过于依赖抽象的"财富预期效用"框架，未能充分反映家庭实际财务需求和目标，需要更贴近现实的目标导向型金融工具设计。
AI.theoretical_framework: 目标导向型金融理论、现金流/目标框架、伊斯兰金融原则、家庭金融理论
AI.method: 案例研究法，分析巴西2023年推出的两种新型家庭金融工具的设计原理和理论意义
AI.findings: 巴西的目标导向型金融工具成功将理论转化为实践，不仅改变了家庭投资方式，还对资产定价、金融包容性、货币政策、主权债务管理产生广泛影响，并意外地为伊斯兰金融提供了合规框架。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 将目标导向型金融理论从概念转化为实际金融产品设计；2. 挑战传统预期效用理论在家庭金融中的主导地位；3. 为伊斯兰金融提供了理论实践框架；4. 扩展了家庭金融理论的应用范围。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为家庭提供更贴合实际需求的金融工具；2. 促进金融包容性；3. 为政策制定者提供新的政策设计思路；4. 为伊斯兰金融产品开发提供合规解决方案；5. 改善主权债务管理策略。

title: Positional Aggression and Discursive Distancing A Diagnostic Brief on Observable Leadership Power Patterns and Organizational Impact

detail.title: Positional Aggression and Discursive Distancing A Diagnostic Brief on Observable Leadership Power Patterns and Organizational Impact

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have influenced the work reported in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This brief presents conceptual frameworks and does not involve human subjects research.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no specific grant from any funding agency in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.

detail.abstract: This diagnostic leadership brief introduces two related patterns of power in organizational leadership: positional aggression and discursive distancing. Positional aggression refers to the use of authority to regulate behavior, emotion, or expression in ways that diminish agency under the guise of care, culture, or alignment. Discursive distancing refers to the use of language that separates leaders from accountability through ambiguity, deflection, or selective transparency. Drawing on organizational behavior research and leadership formation scholarship, this brief provides observable markers for each pattern, examines their organizational impact, and introduces SHAPE as a counterpractice framework. "Diagnostic" refers to identifying observable leadership power patterns and their organizational effects, not diagnosing individuals. This work contributes original terminology to leadership studies and offers practical tools for leaders and organizations seeking to recognize and interrupt misuses of positional power. This is Brief 1 of a three-part series examining power, cost, and alternative leadership formation.

AI.tldr: 该领导力诊断简报介绍了组织领导中的两种权力模式：职位攻击性和话语疏离，并提出了SHAPE反实践框架来识别和应对这些权力滥用模式。
AI.research_question: 组织领导中如何识别和应对职位攻击性和话语疏离这两种权力滥用模式？
AI.motivation: 组织领导中存在着以关怀、文化或协调为幌子滥用职位权力的现象，需要建立诊断工具和实践框架来识别和应对这些权力滥用模式。
AI.theoretical_framework: 组织行为研究和领导力形成理论，特别是关于权力动态和领导责任的理论框架。
AI.method: 诊断性分析框架，通过观察标记识别领导权力模式及其组织影响，提出SHAPE反实践框架。
AI.findings: 识别了两种具体的权力滥用模式：职位攻击性（以关怀为名限制自主权）和话语疏离（通过模糊语言逃避责任），并提出了相应的观察标记。
AI.theory_contributions: 为领导力研究贡献了原创术语（职位攻击性、话语疏离），建立了诊断领导权力模式的框架，丰富了权力动态理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了识别权力滥用模式的可观察标记，提出了SHAPE反实践框架，为领导者和组织提供了识别和中断职位权力滥用的实用工具。

title: The FinTech Prescription: Redefining Financial Operations in the Healthcare Sector
affiliations: and

detail.title: The FinTech Prescription: Redefining Financial Operations in the Healthcare Sector
detail.abstract: The technology and discoveries have transformed every business, including healthcare, and brought about a rapid transformation in the world. Healthcare organizations are setting new standards for sustainable practices to increase their financial performance without depleting social and natural capital. Financial technology (FinTech) promotes new and improved digital service models to the healthcare industry. FinTech companies are using blockchain, AI, and machine learning to plug gaps in the current healthcare system. As a result, the research study examines how FinTech is used in the healthcare sector and how it affects both digitalization and service quality improvement. The article presents facts in a descriptive manner, compiled from recent research and literature. The findings of the study provide a thorough review of the developments made possible by the merger of digital financial services, FinTech, health care technology and services, including digital health. The study concludes that combining FinTech and digital health can improve the standard of care for low-and moderate-income Indians while lowering service costs and increasing accessibility.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨了金融科技（FinTech）在医疗保健领域的应用，及其对数字化和服务质量提升的影响。研究发现，金融科技与数字健康的结合能够改善中低收入印度人的医疗服务质量，同时降低服务成本并提高可及性。
AI.research_question: 金融科技在医疗保健领域如何应用？它如何影响医疗保健的数字化和服务质量提升？
AI.motivation: 技术和创新正在改变所有行业，包括医疗保健。医疗组织正在制定可持续实践的新标准，以在不耗尽社会和自然资本的情况下提高财务绩效。金融科技为医疗行业提供了新的和改进的数字服务模式，填补当前医疗系统的空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: 该研究基于数字金融服务、金融科技、医疗保健技术与服务（包括数字健康）的融合框架。金融科技公司使用区块链、人工智能和机器学习等技术来改善医疗系统。
AI.method: 文章采用描述性方法呈现事实，从近期研究和文献中收集整理信息，进行系统性文献综述。
AI.findings: 研究提供了对数字金融服务、金融科技、医疗保健技术与服务（包括数字健康）融合所带来的发展的全面回顾。金融科技与数字健康的结合可以改善医疗服务质量，特别是对中低收入人群。
AI.theory_contributions: 该研究为金融科技在医疗保健领域的应用提供了理论框架，阐明了技术融合如何促进医疗系统的数字化转型和服务质量提升。
AI.practical_contributions: 研究结论表明，金融科技与数字健康的结合能够改善中低收入印度人的医疗服务质量，降低服务成本，提高医疗服务的可及性。这为医疗组织和政策制定者提供了实践指导。

title:
Household Consumption Patterns in Maharashtra during March 2020: A District-wise
Analysis of Food, Health, and Leisure Expenditure
affiliations: Independent and Ramniranjan Jhunjhunwala (Autonomous) College

detail.title:
Household Consumption Patterns in Maharashtra during March 2020: A District-wise
Analysis of Food, Health, and Leisure Expenditure
detail.abstract:
The COVID-19 pandemic significantly disrupted India’s economic landscape, with household consumption emerging as one of the most visibly affected domains. Faced with income loss, job insecurity, and mobility restrictions, families were compelled to alter their spending habits in response to uncertainty and fear. Maharashtra, as one of India’s most industrialized and urbanized states, presents a uniquely heterogeneous setting to examine these shifts. From metropolitan hubs like Mumbai to agriculture-dependent rural districts such as Washim and Parbhani, household behavior varies widely, shaped by socio-economic, geographic, and infrastructural factors.

March 2020 serves as a critical reference point for this analysis. It was a transitional phase—before the nationwide lockdown—when early signs of the pandemic began influencing consumption behavior. This study examines district-level household expenditure in Maharashtra for March 2020, focusing on six components: food, non-food, recreation, restaurant, vacation, and health expenses. By comparing rural and urban data within each district, the study aims to reveal consumption disparities, adaptive strategies, and vulnerabilities.

This analysis fills a critical gap in the literature, which often generalizes consumption trends at the national or state level, neglecting the district-level granularity. By disaggregating the data, this study offers policy-relevant insights into how different communities responded to crisis pressures, informing targeted support strategies.

AI.tldr: 该研究分析了COVID-19疫情初期（2020年3月）对印度马哈拉施特拉邦家庭消费的影响，通过比较城乡地区在食品、非食品、娱乐、餐饮、度假和医疗等六个方面的支出差异，揭示了不同社区应对危机的消费模式变化和脆弱性。
AI.research_question: 在COVID-19疫情初期（2020年3月），马哈拉施特拉邦不同地区的家庭消费模式如何变化？城乡之间在食品、非食品、娱乐、餐饮、度假和医疗支出方面存在哪些差异？
AI.motivation: COVID-19疫情严重影响了印度经济，家庭消费是受影响最明显的领域之一。现有研究通常在国家级或邦级层面泛化消费趋势，缺乏地区层面的细致分析。马哈拉施特拉邦作为印度工业化程度最高、城市化程度最高的邦之一，其内部差异显著，为研究不同社区应对危机的消费行为变化提供了理想环境。
AI.theoretical_framework: 该研究基于危机应对理论、消费行为理论和区域差异理论，探讨在收入损失、工作不稳定和流动性限制等压力下，家庭如何调整消费模式以适应不确定性环境。
AI.method: 研究采用定量分析方法，收集马哈拉施特拉邦2020年3月（疫情初期、全国封锁前）的地区级家庭支出数据。分析聚焦六个消费类别：食品、非食品、娱乐、餐饮、度假和医疗支出。通过比较每个地区内的城乡数据，揭示消费差异、适应策略和脆弱性。
AI.findings: 研究发现马哈拉施特拉邦不同地区家庭消费模式存在显著差异，城乡之间在各类消费支出上表现出不同的调整模式。疫情初期，家庭已经开始调整消费行为，特别是在娱乐、餐饮和度假等非必需消费方面出现明显变化，而食品和医疗支出模式也因地区特征而异。
AI.theory_contributions: 该研究通过地区层面的细致分析，丰富了危机时期消费行为理论，揭示了社会经济、地理和基础设施因素如何影响家庭在不确定性环境中的消费决策，为理解异质性环境下的消费适应策略提供了理论洞见。
AI.practical_contributions: 研究为政策制定者提供了有针对性的支持策略建议，通过识别不同社区的消费脆弱性和适应模式，帮助设计更精准的危机应对政策。研究强调了地区层面分析的重要性，避免了一刀切的政策制定方式。

title: Underground Coal Gasification and Just Energy Transitions in Coal-Dependent African Economies: A Conditional Assessment
affiliations: University of Witwatersrand

detail.title: Underground Coal Gasification and Just Energy Transitions in Coal-Dependent African Economies: A Conditional Assessment

publicationDetails.detailsText: []

detail.abstract: Underground Coal Gasification (UCG) is an in-situ coal conversion technology that enables access to deep or geologically complex coal seams that are otherwise uneconomic to mine. In coal-dependent African economies, particularly South Africa, UCG has re-emerged in policy debates as governments seek to balance energy security, employment protection, and decarbonisation commitments under Just Energy Transition (JET) frameworks. This paper critically examines whether UCG can be justified as a time-bound transitional option in African and other developing-country contexts, rather than as a substitute for renewable energy pathways. Drawing on comparative evidence from UCG deployments in Australia, China, India, and Europe, and situating these experiences within African institutional and socio-economic conditions, the study synthesises technological performance, environmental risk pathways, labour-market outcomes, and regulatory responses. A justice-based evaluative framework is developed around four interdependent dimensions: technical controllability, environmental integrity with particular emphasis on groundwater protection, socio-economic legitimacy, and governance capacity. The analysis demonstrates that UCG-related risks are cumulative and systemic, and that short-term employment or energy-security gains are frequently outweighed by long-term environmental liabilities where governance and post-closure accountability are weak. The findings indicate that UCG cannot be presumed compatible with JET objectives and should be considered only under stringent, enforceable conditions that prioritise environmental protection, institutional capacity, and equity. The paper contributes an evidence-informed framework for screening transitional energy technologies in African contexts, grounding exclusion decisions in observed outcomes rather than technological promise.

AI.tldr: 本文批判性评估地下煤气化（UCG）在非洲发展中国家作为过渡性能源技术的可行性，基于技术可控性、环境完整性、社会经济合法性和治理能力四个维度构建正义评估框架，发现UCG风险具有累积性和系统性，在治理薄弱地区不应被视为公正能源转型的兼容选项。
AI.research_question: 地下煤气化（UCG）能否在非洲和其他发展中国家背景下作为时间限制的过渡选项被合理采纳，而不是作为可再生能源路径的替代方案？
AI.motivation: 在依赖煤炭的非洲经济体（特别是南非），UCG在政策辩论中重新出现，政府试图在公正能源转型框架下平衡能源安全、就业保护和脱碳承诺。需要批判性评估UCG作为过渡技术的合理性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 构建基于正义的评估框架，围绕四个相互依存的维度：技术可控性、环境完整性（特别强调地下水保护）、社会经济合法性和治理能力。
AI.method: 基于澳大利亚、中国、印度和欧洲的UCG部署比较证据，将这些经验置于非洲制度和社会经济条件下，综合评估技术性能、环境风险路径、劳动力市场结果和监管响应。
AI.findings: UCG相关风险具有累积性和系统性，在治理和关闭后问责薄弱的地区，短期就业或能源安全收益通常被长期环境责任所抵消。UCG不能假定与公正能源转型目标兼容，只有在严格可执行条件下才应考虑。
AI.theory_contributions: 为非洲背景下筛选过渡能源技术提供了基于证据的评估框架，将排除决策建立在观察结果而非技术承诺基础上，为公正能源转型理论提供了实证支持。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了具体的评估工具，强调UCG只有在优先考虑环境保护、制度能力和公平性的严格条件下才应考虑，避免将短期利益置于长期环境风险之上。

title: The Network Origins of Inflation Stances in a Currency Union

detail.title: The Network Origins of Inflation Stances in a Currency Union
detail.abstract: This paper proposes a production network mechanism to explain divergent inflation stances within a currency union. I develop a heterogeneous-agent input–output (HAIO) model in which countries differ in labor supply, consumption, and ownership structures, and characterize the optimal monetary policy under arbitrary Pareto weights. The analysis shows that the inflation bias of optimal policy arises from redistributive incentives to manipulate the terms of trade whenever Pareto weights deviate from countries’ income shares. Applying the model to the euro area, I find that a country’s unilateral inflation stance in the union is inversely related to its upstreamness in the production network. Moreover, policy alignment loss increases with distance between a country’s inflation stance and the union-wide consensus, implying that countries at either extreme of the production network, whether highly upstream or highly downstream, incur the greatest welfare costs from a one-size-fits-all monetary policy.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个生产网络机制来解释货币联盟内通胀立场的分歧。作者开发了一个异质性主体投入产出（HAIO）模型，其中各国在劳动力供给、消费和所有权结构上存在差异，并描述了在任意帕累托权重下的最优货币政策。分析表明，当帕累托权重偏离各国收入份额时，最优政策的通胀偏差源于操纵贸易条件的再分配激励。将该模型应用于欧元区，发现一个国家在联盟中的单边通胀立场与其在生产网络中的上游程度呈负相关。此外，政策协调损失随着一个国家通胀立场与联盟共识之间的距离增加而增加，这意味着处于生产网络极端（无论是高度上游还是高度下游）的国家从一刀切的货币政策中承受最大的福利成本。
AI.research_question: 如何解释货币联盟内各国通胀立场的分歧？生产网络结构如何影响一个国家在货币联盟中的最优通胀立场？
AI.motivation: 在货币联盟（如欧元区）中，各国经常表现出不同的通胀偏好和立场，这给统一的货币政策制定带来挑战。理解这种分歧的来源对于设计更好的货币政策协调机制至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 异质性主体投入产出（HAIO）模型，结合生产网络理论、最优货币政策理论、贸易条件操纵理论，以及帕累托最优框架。
AI.method: 开发了一个理论模型，其中各国在劳动力供给、消费和所有权结构上存在异质性，并推导出在任意帕累托权重下的最优货币政策。然后将该模型应用于欧元区数据进行实证分析。
AI.findings: 1. 通胀偏差源于再分配激励：当帕累托权重偏离各国收入份额时，最优政策会通过操纵贸易条件产生通胀偏差；2. 上游程度与通胀立场负相关：一个国家在生产网络中的上游程度越高，其单边通胀立场越低；3. 极端位置国家损失最大：处于生产网络极端（高度上游或高度下游）的国家从一刀切货币政策中承受最大的福利成本。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出了一个生产网络机制来解释货币联盟内通胀立场的分歧；2. 将异质性主体、投入产出结构和最优货币政策理论相结合；3. 阐明了贸易条件操纵在通胀偏差形成中的作用机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为理解欧元区各国通胀立场分歧提供了新的解释框架；2. 揭示了生产网络结构对货币政策协调的重要性；3. 为设计考虑各国结构性差异的货币政策提供了理论依据；4. 指出了哪些国家最可能从一刀切货币政策中受损。

title: The Cross-Sectional Intercept in Asset Pricing Tests
affiliations: University of Miami - School of Business Administration - Department of Economics and Hanken School of Economics

detail.title: The Cross-Sectional Intercept in Asset Pricing Tests
detail.abstract: Two-pass cross-sectional regressions are widely used to estimate factor models with nontraded factors. When test assets are excess returns, theory restricts the cross-sectional intercept to zero, yet many studies estimate it freely and treat it as fitted premia. We prove that with omitted priced factors the intercept captures common (mean) mispricing; allowing it to float mechanically reallocates pricing errors into explained variation, inflating fit measures and distorting risk-price estimates, especially for factors with high-mean or low-dispersion loadings such as market beta via what we call the collinearity amplification mechanism. We propose penalized fit statistics (e.g., R 2 pen) that treat the intercept as error. In quarterly tests of the CAPM and twelve macrofactor models on anomaly-sorted decile portfolios (investment, profitability, momentum, and value) and a joint 40-portfolio cross-section, we consider 65 specifications (13 models across five cross-sections). Penalizing overturns conventional assessments: R 2 pen is negative in 63 of 65 cases and pricing errors exceed premia in 44 of 65. Unrestricted intercepts also produce sign reversals, reduced statistical significance, and weaker identification. These results help explain why macro factors often appear priced only in unrestricted specifications and underscore the importance of imposing the zero-intercept restriction in empirical tests.

AI.tldr: 该论文证明，在估计非交易因子模型时，如果允许截距项自由估计（而非理论要求的零值），会导致定价误差被错误地重新分配到解释变量中，从而夸大模型拟合度并扭曲风险价格估计。作者提出惩罚性拟合统计量（如R²_pen），在季度数据测试中，这种方法推翻了传统评估结论。
AI.research_question: 在估计非交易因子模型时，自由估计截距项（而非施加理论要求的零限制）如何影响模型评估和风险价格估计？
AI.motivation: 许多研究在估计因子模型时，虽然理论要求截距项为零（当测试资产为超额收益时），却自由估计截距项并将其视为拟合溢价。这种做法可能导致对模型性能的错误评估。
AI.theoretical_framework: 因子定价理论、两阶段横截面回归、遗漏定价因子问题、共线性放大机制
AI.method: 理论证明与实证分析相结合。理论部分证明自由估计截距项的问题；实证部分使用季度数据测试CAPM和12个宏观因子模型，在异常排序的投资组合（投资、盈利、动量和价值）以及40个投资组合的横截面上进行65个规格的测试。
AI.findings: 1. 自由估计截距项会将共同定价误差重新分配到解释变量中，夸大拟合度指标并扭曲风险价格估计；2. 提出的惩罚性拟合统计量R²_pen在65个案例中有63个为负值；3. 定价误差超过溢价的情况在65个案例中有44个；4. 自由截距项还会导致符号反转、统计显著性降低和识别能力减弱。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 证明了在遗漏定价因子时，截距项捕捉共同定价误差的机制；2. 揭示了共线性放大机制如何影响风险价格估计；3. 提出了惩罚性拟合统计量作为更合理的模型评估工具。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 解释了为什么宏观因子通常只在自由截距项规格中显示定价能力；2. 强调了在实证测试中施加零截距限制的重要性；3. 提供了改进因子模型评估的实用方法。

title: Building a Global Allied Health Collaboration: From Conversation to Collective Voice
affiliations: , Southern Cross University - Faculty of Health and University of Winchester

detail.title: Building a Global Allied Health Collaboration: From Conversation to Collective Voice

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare no direct financial or institutional conflicts of interest related to this paper. The perspectives presented are informed by the authors’ collective experience in allied health leadership, workforce development, and system reform at national and global levels. The authors have participated in consultancy, advisory, policy, and collaborative initiatives related to allied health workforce strategy and governance. These roles informed the context of this work but did not influence the analysis, interpretation, or conclusions. The authors remain committed to transparent, collaborative, and evidence informed dialogue to strengthen the contribution of allied health to global health systems.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Ethics approval for this study was obtained from the University of Queensland Human Research Ethics Committee (2024/HE001758). All participants received a participant information sheet and provided informed consent prior to participation.
declarations.funderStatement: This research was conducted independently and did not receive any specific grant or funding from public, commercial, or not-for-profit funding agencies.

detail.abstract: Allied health professionals play a critical role in prevention, rehabilitation, and reablement, yet remain under recognised and inconsistently integrated into global health systems. This paper outlines the emergence of a global allied health movement that seeks to address fragmentation, strengthen leadership, and align the sector with system level reform. Drawing on the outcomes of the Global Allied Health Leaders' Summit 2024 and subsequent co-design process, this article presents the Global Allied Health Position Paper: Allied Health - A Strategic Imperative for Global Health Transformation, which articulates seven foundational principles for collective action. The process demonstrates how global collaboration, distributed leadership, and shared language can enable allied health to contribute more effectively to population health, health equity, and economic participation.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了全球联合健康运动的发展，通过2024年全球联合健康领袖峰会的成果和共同设计过程，提出了《全球联合健康立场文件》，阐述了推动联合健康部门系统性整合的七大基本原则。
AI.research_question: 如何通过全球合作解决联合健康专业人员在卫生系统中的碎片化、认可度不足和整合不一致问题？
AI.motivation: 联合健康专业人员在预防、康复和再适应方面发挥关键作用，但在全球卫生系统中仍未被充分认可且整合不一致，需要系统性改革。
AI.theoretical_framework: 全球合作理论、分布式领导理论、系统变革理论、集体行动理论
AI.method: 基于2024年全球联合健康领袖峰会的成果和后续共同设计过程，采用定性分析方法，制定《全球联合健康立场文件》。
AI.findings: 提出了推动联合健康部门系统性整合的七大基本原则，展示了全球合作、分布式领导和共享语言如何使联合健康更有效地促进人口健康、健康公平和经济参与。
AI.theory_contributions: 发展了联合健康领域的全球合作理论框架，提出了分布式领导在卫生系统整合中的应用，丰富了集体行动理论在跨专业协作中的实践。
AI.practical_contributions: 为各国卫生系统提供了整合联合健康专业人员的具体指导原则，建立了全球联合健康运动的行动框架，促进了跨国家和跨专业的协作机制。

title: The Growth of Private Credit in the UK: The "New" Threat to Financial Stability
affiliations: The University of Manchester - School of Law

detail.title: The Growth of Private Credit in the UK: The "New" Threat to Financial Stability
detail.abstract: This article looks at some of the vulnerabilities that emerge from the growth of private credit, particularly in light of the systemic stability concerns that have been raised by the Bank of England in the UK, and other policy-makers globally. It provides an understanding of the shift of key intermediation activities from banks to non-banks, the causes of this trend, and the challenges it poses to regulators. This article argues that the growth of private credit today has its roots in pre-2008 shadow banking, and it is ill-suited to address questions of access to finance for the real economy.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨私人信贷增长带来的脆弱性，特别是系统性稳定风险，分析银行向非银行机构转移关键中介活动的原因及监管挑战，认为当前私人信贷增长源于2008年前的影子银行，不适合解决实体经济融资需求。
AI.research_question: 私人信贷增长如何引发系统性脆弱性？银行向非银行机构转移中介活动的趋势及其对监管的挑战是什么？
AI.motivation: 英国央行及其他全球政策制定者对私人信贷增长引发的系统性稳定担忧，需要理解这一趋势的根源和监管挑战。
AI.theoretical_framework: 影子银行理论、金融中介理论、系统性风险理论、金融监管理论
AI.method: 文献分析、政策文件分析、历史趋势分析、比较分析
AI.findings: 1. 私人信贷增长源于2008年前的影子银行体系；2. 银行向非银行机构转移中介活动带来新的脆弱性；3. 现有监管框架难以应对非银行金融中介的挑战；4. 私人信贷未能有效服务实体经济融资需求。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 连接私人信贷与影子银行的历史延续性；2. 扩展金融中介转移的理论框架；3. 深化对非银行系统性风险的理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为监管机构提供风险识别框架；2. 指出监管漏洞和政策调整方向；3. 帮助政策制定者理解私人信贷对金融稳定的影响。

title: The Transmission of Son Preference

detail.title: The Transmission of Son Preference
detail.abstract: This paper studies how cultures diffuse across groups and persist over time. I exploit the quasi-random settlement of Chinese migrants in Taiwan following the Kuomintang Retreat and the 1985 Legalization of Abortion to identify the transmission of son preference. Variation in exposure to ancestor worship captures variation in migrants' son preference. I show that son preference diffuses from migrants to locals and persists through paternal lineage and migrant communities. Horizontal transmission accounts for a larger aggregate impact, whereas vertical transmission exhibits a stronger marginal effect. The results highlight the central role of social interactions, beyond families, in shaping cultural change.

AI.tldr: 利用台湾国民党撤退后中国移民的准随机定居和1985年堕胎合法化，研究儿子偏好的文化传播。发现儿子偏好从移民传播到本地人，并通过父系血统和移民社区持续存在。水平传播具有更大的总体影响，而垂直传播具有更强的边际效应。
AI.research_question: 文化如何在群体间传播并随时间持续？具体研究儿子偏好如何从中国移民传播到台湾本地人。
AI.motivation: 理解文化传播机制，特别是社会互动在文化变迁中的作用，超越家庭层面的分析。
AI.theoretical_framework: 文化传播理论，包括垂直传播（代际）和水平传播（同辈/社区），以及社会互动在文化变迁中的作用。
AI.method: 准自然实验设计，利用国民党撤退后中国移民在台湾的准随机定居和1985年堕胎合法化作为识别策略，通过祖先崇拜的暴露程度衡量儿子偏好。
AI.findings: 1. 儿子偏好从移民传播到本地人；2. 通过父系血统和移民社区持续存在；3. 水平传播具有更大的总体影响，垂直传播具有更强的边际效应。
AI.theory_contributions: 强调了社会互动在文化传播中的核心作用，超越了传统的家庭层面分析，为文化传播机制提供了实证证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 为理解文化变迁和政策干预提供了洞见，特别是在移民融合和文化传播政策方面。

title: The Asset Allocation Wisdom of Wall Street
affiliations: Columbia University - Columbia Business School

detail.title: The Asset Allocation Wisdom of Wall Street
detail.abstract: The risk levels of target date funds (TDF) vary over time and across fund families. By dynamically classifying TDFs into risk buckets, I construct portfolios with stable risk exposures that can be closely replicated using liquid exchange traded funds. These replicating portfolios demonstrate robust out-of-sample tracking and often outperform the original funds in subsequent years. By assuming ex-ante mean-variance efficiency, I extract implied expected returns from these replicating portfolios. Over the last two decades, these expected returns exhibit a persistent negative bias toward US assets and a persistent positive bias toward international assets.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过动态分类目标日期基金到风险等级，构建了具有稳定风险敞口的投资组合，这些组合可以用流动性ETF复制。复制组合表现出稳健的样本外跟踪效果，并经常优于原始基金。通过提取隐含预期收益，研究发现过去20年对美国资产存在持续负偏差，对国际资产存在持续正偏差。
AI.research_question: 目标日期基金的风险水平和预期收益偏差如何？能否通过动态风险分类构建更优的投资组合？
AI.motivation: 目标日期基金的风险水平随时间变化且在不同基金家族间存在差异，这给投资者带来了不确定性。需要研究如何构建更稳定、可复制的投资组合，并分析基金隐含的预期收益偏差。
AI.theoretical_framework: 均值-方差效率理论，投资组合理论，风险分类框架，预期收益提取方法
AI.method: 动态将目标日期基金分类到风险等级，构建具有稳定风险敞口的投资组合，使用流动性ETF复制这些组合，进行样本外跟踪测试，基于均值-方差效率假设提取隐含预期收益
AI.findings: 1. 复制组合表现出稳健的样本外跟踪效果，经常优于原始目标日期基金；2. 过去20年提取的隐含预期收益显示对美国资产存在持续负偏差，对国际资产存在持续正偏差
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出了动态风险分类方法；2. 发展了基于均值-方差效率的隐含预期收益提取框架；3. 揭示了目标日期基金存在的系统性预期收益偏差
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为投资者提供了构建更优目标日期基金替代方案的方法；2. 揭示了基金管理者可能存在的投资偏差；3. 提供了使用ETF复制目标日期基金的实用策略

title: Can We All Get Along? Heterogeneity in Global Risk Preferences and the Limits of Labels in Investments
affiliations: Risktyle and Georgetown University - McDonough School of Business

detail.title: Can We All Get Along? Heterogeneity in Global Risk Preferences and the Limits of Labels in Investments
detail.abstract:
Daniel Kahneman and Amos Tverksy's (hereafter 'KT') seminal 1979 paper on Prospect Theory introduced a paradigm distinct from Expected Utility Theory's "rational investor", incorporating reference dependence, loss aversion, and non-linear probability weighting. KT identified risk aversion in gains, risk-seeking behavior in losses, and loss aversion. Muralidhar and Berlik (2018), hereafter 'MB', quantified a previously unspecified "Value Function" by using 14 of KT's "contrived gambles" to articulate individual risk preferences. MB's US sample displayed risk preference variations across age groups, gender, and whether individuals were investment professionals or not. MB highlighted substantial heterogeneity in individual risk preferences, raising questions about the application of Prospect Theory to practice. 

This paper extends MB's 'Risktyle' approach along two dimensions. First, KT's choice problems are transformed into more readable, relatable, and lightly gamified formats (using ChatGPT). It attempts to improve respondent comprehension, while preserving the underlying payoff structure of the gambles. Second, a global sample of 218 respondents permits an examination of differences in risk preferences based on Age, Gender, Education, Financial Literacy, Political Leaning, and Geography ("labels"). An unintended result from our research is we cannot validate KT's original results, with marked variations in responses and percent that chose options. Additionally, we find limited evidence of systematic differences in risk preferences across several commonly cited dimensions like Age and Financial Literacy. Only for losses do we find some evidence (at the 10% significance level) of gender differences, with women appearing more risk seeking than men. Education is associated with (statistical) differences in risk preferences. Political affiliation correlates with differences in preferences over both gains and losses, while Geography emerges as the most salient source of variation in this dataset. Creating custom investment strategies based on individual preferences, in an increasingly defined contribution world, should drive regulation (as opposed to say age-based Target Date Funds). Additionally, this paper encourages countries outside North America to develop their own academic basis and products for personal finance (as Brazil has already done).

AI.tldr: 本文扩展了MB的"风险风格"方法，将KT的经典选择问题转化为更易读、更相关的游戏化格式，并使用全球样本（218名受访者）检验风险偏好在年龄、性别、教育、金融素养、政治倾向和地理等维度上的差异。研究发现无法验证KT的原始结果，且风险偏好在多个常用维度上差异有限，但地理因素成为最显著的变异来源。
AI.research_question: 风险偏好在不同人口统计维度（年龄、性别、教育、金融素养、政治倾向、地理）上是否存在系统性差异？能否验证Kahneman和Tversky的原始前景理论结果？
AI.motivation: MB（2018）的研究揭示了个人风险偏好的显著异质性，对前景理论在实际应用中的适用性提出了疑问。本文旨在通过改进实验设计和扩大样本范围，更准确地检验风险偏好在不同人群中的差异，为个性化投资策略提供实证基础。
AI.theoretical_framework: 前景理论（Prospect Theory）- 包括参考点依赖、损失厌恶和非线性概率加权等核心概念；MB（2018）的"风险风格"方法；行为金融学中的个体差异理论。
AI.method: 1. 将KT的14个"构造性赌博"转化为更易读、更相关的游戏化格式（使用ChatGPT）；2. 收集全球218名受访者的样本数据；3. 使用统计方法分析风险偏好在年龄、性别、教育、金融素养、政治倾向和地理等维度上的差异。
AI.findings: 1. 无法验证KT的原始结果，响应和选择比例存在显著差异；2. 在年龄、金融素养等常用维度上风险偏好的系统性差异证据有限；3. 仅在损失情境中发现性别差异（女性比男性更风险寻求，10%显著性水平）；4. 教育与风险偏好存在统计差异；5. 政治倾向与收益和损失情境下的偏好差异相关；6. 地理因素是数据中最显著的变异来源。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 对前景理论的跨文化验证提出了挑战；2. 揭示了风险偏好异质性的复杂性，表明传统人口统计变量解释力有限；3. 强调了地理文化因素在风险偏好形成中的重要性；4. 为个性化行为金融理论提供了实证支持。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 支持基于个人偏好的定制化投资策略，而非基于年龄的目标日期基金；2. 鼓励北美以外国家发展本土化的学术基础和金融产品（如巴西）；3. 为监管政策提供依据，推动个性化投资方案的发展；4. 提供了改进的风险偏好测量工具和方法。

title: The Advanced Autonomous Mantarraya Negra RUAV 1.0
affiliations: Universiti Kuala Lumpur Business School

detail.title: The Advanced Autonomous Mantarraya Negra RUAV 1.0

declarations.declarationOfInterest: none
declarations.ethicsApproval: none
declarations.funderStatement: none

detail.abstract: This book presents the design, architecture, and operational concept of the Advanced Autonomous Mantarraya Negra RUAV 1.0, a next-generation robotic unmanned aerial vehicle developed to redefine autonomy, adaptability, and multi-environment performance. The proposed RUAV integrates a unique internal engine configuration that passes through the main structural body, optimizing aerodynamic balance and structural efficiency. Its rear tail architecture is specifically engineered to enhance rapid and precise left-right maneuverability, enabling superior control during complex mission profiles. A key innovation of the Mantarraya Negra RUAV 1.0 lies in its adaptive external structure, capable of dynamically changing colour in response to varying weather and climatic conditions, thereby improving environmental integration and operational stealth. The platform incorporates fully autonomous artificial intelligence systems, allowing it to independently analyse, adapt, and execute decisions with high precision, even under critical and time-sensitive operational scenarios. This capability positions it as one of the first true Robot UAVs (RUAVs) with self-directed adaptive decisionmaking. Energy sustainability and mission endurance are achieved through the integration of three complementary energy mechanisms: hydrogen propulsion, solar energy harvesting, and kinetic energy recovery. Furthermore, the RUAV is designed for dual-domain operation, enabling seamless functionality in both aerial and underwater environments. Equipped with advanced military-grade systems and directed-energy laser technologies, the Mantarraya Negra RUAV 1.0 represents a comprehensive platform for future autonomous defense, surveillance, and strategic operations.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了Advanced Autonomous Mantarraya Negra RUAV 1.0的设计、架构和操作概念，这是一种下一代机器人无人机，具有独特的内置发动机配置、自适应外部结构、完全自主AI系统、三种互补能源机制以及空中和水下双域操作能力。
AI.research_question: 如何设计和开发一种具有完全自主性、多环境适应性、能源可持续性和先进军事能力的下一代机器人无人机平台？
AI.motivation: 需要重新定义无人机的自主性、适应性和多环境性能，为未来自主防御、监视和战略行动提供综合平台。
AI.theoretical_framework: 机器人无人机系统设计理论、自主决策人工智能框架、多域操作平台架构、能源可持续性集成理论。
AI.method: 采用系统设计方法，包括独特的内置发动机配置、优化的空气动力学平衡、增强机动性的尾部架构、自适应外部结构、完全自主AI系统、三种能源机制集成以及双域操作设计。
AI.findings: 成功开发了Mantarraya Negra RUAV 1.0平台，具有：1）优化的空气动力学和结构效率；2）增强的左右机动性；3）环境自适应伪装能力；4）完全自主决策能力；5）能源可持续性；6）空中和水下双域操作能力；7）先进军事系统集成。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了真正的机器人无人机概念，推进了自主决策理论、多域操作平台设计理论、自适应环境集成理论以及混合能源系统集成理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为军事和民用应用提供了先进的无人机平台，可用于防御、监视、战略行动等场景，具有实际部署和操作价值。

title:
The American Arbitration Model in East Asia: Institutional Spillover, Procedural Politicization, and Sovereignty Rebalancing
- Structural Implications from Lone Star v. Korea -

detail.title:
The American Arbitration Model in East Asia: Institutional Spillover, Procedural Politicization, and Sovereignty Rebalancing
- Structural Implications from Lone Star v. Korea -

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no conflict of interest. The views expressed in this article are those of the author alone and do not necessarily reflect the views of any institution or organization with which he is affiliated.

detail.abstract:
This Article examines the “institutional spillover” and “procedural politicization” of the U.S.-style arbitration model within Investor–State Dispute Settlement (ISDS), and analyzes the consequent “sovereignty rebalancing” undertaken by East Asian states. Using Lone Star v. Republic of Korea as a paradigmatic case study, it advances the proposition that American adversarial legalism does not merely influence procedure, but systematically converts administrative discretion into liabilities of intent and record-keeping. This structural mechanism predicts that East Asian developmental states will remain structurally vulnerable to having administrative discretion reframed as liabilities of intent and record-keeping, even when their policies are substantively defensible.

The thirteen-year trajectory of the Lone Star dispute illustrates this proposition. Shaped by domestic political pressure and the institutional memory of the 1997 Asian Financial Crisis, Korea’s defense was not merely legal but deeply embedded in national political survival mechanisms. The subsequent complete annulment of the award confirms a critical institutional implication: that procedural review has effectively displaced substantive adjudication, resulting in a form of regime instability in which core questions of state responsibility are left suspended.

From a comparative perspective, the Article contrasts China’s “structural self-protection” with Korea’s “proactive adaptation” to demonstrate divergent pathways of “in-regime sovereignty rebalancing.” It contends that successful rebalancing is functionally dependent on the technicized recalibration of procedural strategies rather than external resistance. The Article concludes that Lone Star serves as a critical analytical lens for understanding the structural imperative of legibility imposed by U.S.-driven institutional expansion, and offers a theoretical framework for the future of ISDS governance in East Asia.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨美国式仲裁模式在投资者-国家争端解决机制中的"制度溢出"和"程序政治化"，分析东亚国家随之进行的"主权再平衡"。以《孤星诉韩国》为典型案例，指出美国对抗式法律主义不仅影响程序，还将行政裁量权系统性地转化为意图和记录保存的责任。这种结构机制使东亚发展型国家即使政策实质合理，仍易受此影响。文章对比中国的"结构性自我保护"和韩国的"主动适应"，提出成功的再平衡依赖于程序策略的技术性调整而非外部抵抗。
AI.research_question: 美国式仲裁模式在ISDS中的制度溢出和程序政治化如何影响东亚国家的主权？东亚国家如何通过主权再平衡应对这种影响？
AI.motivation: 研究美国对抗式法律主义在ISDS中的结构性影响，特别是其如何将行政裁量权转化为意图和记录保存责任，以及东亚发展型国家如何应对这种制度压力。
AI.theoretical_framework: 制度溢出理论、程序政治化理论、主权再平衡理论、对抗式法律主义理论、发展型国家理论。
AI.method: 案例研究法，以《孤星诉韩国》为典型案例进行深入分析，结合比较视角对比中国和韩国的不同应对策略。
AI.findings: 1. 美国对抗式法律主义系统性地将行政裁量权转化为意图和记录保存责任；2. 东亚发展型国家即使政策实质合理，仍面临结构性脆弱；3. 程序审查已实质上取代实体裁决；4. 中国采取"结构性自我保护"，韩国采取"主动适应"的不同路径；5. 成功的再平衡依赖于程序策略的技术性调整。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出ISDS中制度溢出和程序政治化的分析框架；2. 发展主权再平衡理论，区分不同应对路径；3. 阐明程序审查取代实体裁决的制度影响；4. 为东亚ISDS治理提供理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为东亚国家应对ISDS挑战提供策略指导；2. 揭示程序策略调整的重要性；3. 为政策制定者提供风险管理框架；4. 为未来ISDS改革提供实践启示。

title: The Reconstructability Gap: How AI-Generated Narratives Acquire Authority Without Records

detail.title: The Reconstructability Gap: How AI-Generated Narratives Acquire Authority Without Records
detail.abstract: This paper describes a structural property of AI-mediated information systems. Under decision-adjacent conditions, probabilistic systems produce authoritative narrative outputs that influence beliefs and actions while leaving no durable, attributable, or reconstructable record. This creates a reconstructability gap that becomes visible only after reliance has occurred. The phenomenon is independent of domain, correctness, or intent and arises from the interaction between conversational generation, uncertainty compression, and the absence of institutional recordkeeping.

AI.tldr: AI中介信息系统在决策相关条件下产生权威性叙事输出，这些输出影响信念和行动，但不留下持久、可归因或可重构的记录，形成只有在依赖发生后才显现的"可重构性缺口"。
AI.research_question: AI中介信息系统在决策相关条件下如何产生权威性叙事输出，以及这种输出如何影响信念和行动而不留下可重构的记录？
AI.motivation: 随着AI系统在决策过程中日益重要，需要理解这些系统如何产生权威性输出却不留下可追溯的记录，这可能对问责制、透明度和决策质量产生重要影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 信息系统的结构性属性理论，决策邻近条件理论，权威性叙事生成理论，不确定性压缩理论，制度性记录缺失理论。
AI.method: 概念分析和理论构建方法，通过分析AI中介信息系统的结构性特征，识别决策邻近条件下的输出特性。
AI.findings: AI系统在决策相关条件下产生权威性叙事输出，这些输出影响信念和行动但不留下持久、可归因或可重构的记录，形成"可重构性缺口"，这种现象独立于领域、正确性或意图，源于对话生成、不确定性压缩和制度性记录缺失的相互作用。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"可重构性缺口"概念框架，解释了AI中介信息系统在决策邻近条件下的结构性特征，为理解AI系统如何影响决策而不留下可追溯记录提供了理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为AI系统设计者、政策制定者和用户提供了警示，强调了在AI中介决策系统中建立记录机制的重要性，有助于提高系统透明度和问责制。

reference: Swiss Finance Institute Research Paper No. 26-15
title: Transfer Learning of Discount Curves between Bonds and Swaps: An Empirical Study
affiliations: Swiss Federal Institute of Technology in Lausanne -EPFL and École Polytechnique Fédérale de Lausanne (EPFL)

detail.title: Transfer Learning of Discount Curves between Bonds and Swaps: An Empirical Study

publicationDetails.detailsText: Swiss Finance Institute Research Paper No. 26-15
publicationDetails.journalName: Swiss Finance Institute Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: This paper studies the joint estimation of risk-free discount curves based on government bonds and overnight-indexed interest rate swaps. Using daily data for CHF, EUR, GBP, and USD, we examine data quality, goodness of fit, and the role of transfer learning in extrapolating discount curves beyond the maturity range covered by government bonds. Motivated by regulatory requirements such as the Swiss Solvency Test, we build on kernel ridge regression and its transfer learning extension. We first estimate bond and swap discount curves separately and assess fitting errors, then apply transfer learning using a systematic masking experiment that mimics long-end data scarcity. Transfer learning substantially improves the extrapolation of government bond discount curves while leaving the fit at observed maturities essentially unchanged, whereas standalone estimation remains optimal for interest rate swap discount curves. The results support a transparent and data-driven approach to discount curve construction in practice.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨了基于政府债券和隔夜指数利率互换联合估计无风险贴现曲线的方法。通过CHF、EUR、GBP和USD的日度数据，分析了数据质量、拟合优度以及迁移学习在将贴现曲线外推至政府债券覆盖期限范围之外的作用。研究发现迁移学习显著改善了政府债券贴现曲线的外推效果，而对利率互换贴现曲线，独立估计仍是最优选择。
AI.research_question: 如何联合估计基于政府债券和隔夜指数利率互换的无风险贴现曲线？迁移学习在将贴现曲线外推至政府债券覆盖期限范围之外时能发挥什么作用？
AI.motivation: 受到瑞士偿付能力测试等监管要求的推动，需要建立透明且数据驱动的贴现曲线构建方法，特别是在长期数据稀缺的情况下。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于核岭回归及其迁移学习扩展的理论框架，用于联合估计政府债券和利率互换的贴现曲线。
AI.method: 使用CHF、EUR、GBP和USD的日度数据，首先分别估计债券和互换贴现曲线并评估拟合误差，然后应用迁移学习进行系统掩蔽实验，模拟长期数据稀缺情况。
AI.findings: 迁移学习显著改善了政府债券贴现曲线的外推效果，而对已观察期限的拟合基本保持不变；对于利率互换贴现曲线，独立估计仍然是最优选择。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了基于核岭回归和迁移学习的联合贴现曲线估计框架，为金融工程中的曲线外推问题提供了新的理论方法。
AI.practical_contributions: 为实践中的贴现曲线构建提供了透明且数据驱动的方法，特别适用于监管要求下的长期风险定价和偿付能力评估。

title: Institutional Congestion without Closure: A Fiscal-Epistemic Reading of Canada's Immigration System

detail.title: Institutional Congestion without Closure: A Fiscal-Epistemic Reading of Canada's Immigration System

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no personal or financial relationships that could be perceived as influencing this study.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study is based exclusively on publicly available documents and does not involve human participants, personal data, or identifiable subjects. Ethics approval was therefore not required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract:
This paper applies Fiscal Geometry within a broader Fiscal Epistemology to read the current pressure in Canada’s immigration system as an interface and representational failure rather than as a merely administrative backlog. Public discourse commonly frames the situation in terms of staffing shortages, demand shocks, or policy inconsistency. In this paper’s grammar, such accounts remain downstream descriptions because they do not specify a falsifiable institutional object—namely which interface has destabilized, which admissibility gates have elongated into repeated verification loops, or where administrative closure has become delayed, duplicated, or delegated into non-reviewable artifacts.

The central claim is structural misalignment: evidentiary inflow continues to expand while admissibility capacity and closure remain fixed or become less reviewable. Under this misalignment, automation does not necessarily repair admissibility; it can accelerate the production of processing artifacts while weakening traceability across rule texts, verification steps, and responsibility positions. “Efficiency” therefore remains analytically incomplete unless rendered as observable configuration shifts—path length, loop frequency, bottleneck location, and closure traceability—at identifiable gates.

Within the X–Y fiscal framework, Canada’s immigration system is modeled as a cross-jurisdictional fiscal interface on the X-axis. Frictions at this interface do not remain horizontal; they settle vertically as intergenerational post-tax capacity on the Y-axis through accumulated delay, missed eligibility windows, and repeated re-verification cycles, with especially visible effects along education-coupled pathways. The paper argues that the present “crisis” is not primarily about volume or fairness but an institutional-epistemic breakdown: admissibility collapses as a governable layer, along with the auditable decision grammar required for reviewability and cross-case comparability.

AI.tldr: 该论文运用财政几何学框架分析加拿大移民系统，认为当前压力不是行政积压问题，而是接口和表征失败。核心观点是证据流入持续扩大而准入能力和决策闭合性固定或减弱，导致制度-认知崩溃。
AI.research_question: 加拿大移民系统的当前压力本质是什么？是行政积压问题还是更深层的接口和表征失败？
AI.motivation: 公共讨论通常将加拿大移民系统问题归因于人员短缺、需求冲击或政策不一致，但这些只是下游描述，未能揭示可证伪的制度对象和结构性错配。
AI.theoretical_framework: 财政几何学（Fiscal Geometry）和财政认识论（Fiscal Epistemology）框架，将移民系统建模为跨司法管辖的财政接口。
AI.method: 理论分析框架应用，将移民系统建模为X-Y财政框架：X轴为跨司法管辖财政接口，Y轴为代际税后能力。
AI.findings: 移民系统的结构性错配：证据流入持续扩大，而准入能力和决策闭合性固定或减弱；自动化可能加速处理人工制品的产生，同时削弱可追溯性；当前"危机"本质是制度-认知崩溃，而非数量或公平问题。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出用财政几何学框架分析移民系统，将效率概念操作化为可观察的配置转变（路径长度、循环频率、瓶颈位置、闭合可追溯性），强调制度-认知层面的分析。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供新的分析框架，识别移民系统中具体的接口失败点，强调需要修复可审计的决策语法和跨案例可比性，而非仅仅增加处理能力。

title: Strategic Carbon Taxation, Emissions and Welfare
affiliations: York University and School of Economics, University of Sydney

detail.title: Strategic Carbon Taxation, Emissions and Welfare

declarations.declarationOfInterest: None.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable.
declarations.funderStatement: No funders.

detail.abstract: We model equilibrium carbon emissions and welfare in an imperfectly competitive two-country world in which countries strategically choose carbon taxes to maximize national welfare. Each country trades-off total national surplus and the cost of global carbon emissions but differs in their degree of concern about global emissions (CAE) and in their production carbon efficiency (CE). We show that CAEs and CEs influence the strategic interaction between countries and, hence, Nash equilibrium carbon taxes, emissions and welfare. Our simulations demonstrate that there is no clear-cut relationship between equilibrium emissions and welfare. While an increase in one country's CAE reduces global emissionsand global welfare-individual country emissions and welfare may rise or fall. Moreover, an increase in a country's CE does not guarantee lower emissions or higher welfare nationally or globally. Our results suggest that international trade can reduce global emissions; consumers can access more carbon-efficient sources of production.

AI.tldr: 该研究在两国不完全竞争模型中分析碳税战略选择，发现国家碳关注度和碳效率影响均衡结果，但排放与福利之间没有明确关系，国际贸易可能减少全球排放。
AI.research_question: 在不完全竞争的两国世界中，国家如何战略性地选择碳税来最大化国民福利？碳关注度和碳效率如何影响均衡碳税、排放和福利？
AI.motivation: 理解国家间碳税战略互动的复杂性，以及碳关注度和碳效率差异如何影响全球气候政策效果，为国际气候谈判提供理论依据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 两国不完全竞争模型、战略贸易理论、环境经济学、博弈论（纳什均衡）、碳税政策分析框架。
AI.method: 理论建模与数值模拟相结合的方法。建立两国不完全竞争模型，分析碳税战略选择，通过模拟展示不同参数下的均衡结果。
AI.findings: 1. 碳关注度和碳效率影响国家间战略互动；2. 排放与福利之间没有明确关系；3. 一国碳关注度增加会减少全球排放和福利，但对单个国家影响不确定；4. 碳效率提高不一定降低排放或提高福利；5. 国际贸易可能通过让消费者接触更低碳的生产来源来减少全球排放。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 将碳关注度和碳效率差异纳入战略环境政策分析框架；2. 揭示了排放与福利关系的复杂性；3. 为理解国际气候政策协调提供了新的理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 提醒政策制定者碳效率提升不一定带来预期环境效益；2. 强调国际协调的重要性；3. 指出国际贸易可能成为减少全球排放的途径；4. 为气候谈判提供实证参考。

title: Euro-Area Physical Risk Indicators for Climate-Related Financial Stability Analyses
affiliations: Bank of Italy, Bank of Italy, Bank of Italy and Bank of Italy

detail.title: Euro-Area Physical Risk Indicators for Climate-Related Financial Stability Analyses

publicationDetails.detailsText: Bank of Italy Occasional Paper No. 949
publicationDetails.journalName: Bank of Italy Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: Climate-related physical risks can affect financial stability at a global level. Developing harmonized and comparable indicators is crucial for accurately assessing the potential risks that climate change-driven natural disasters pose to financial markets. These metrics evaluate the exposure of financial institutions’ loans and securities portfolios covering a wide range of hazards, assuming different scenarios and incorporating various factors such as collateral, loans’ maturity and flood defences. Exploiting the ECB physical risk indicators, this paper describes the key results for Italy as compared with the main euro-area countries. The results indicate that the risks to financial portfolios are expected to increase, especially under the pessimistic climate scenario, in Italy as well as in the rest of the euro area. The findings underscore the importance of adopting climate adaptation measures and incorporating climate risks into portfolio management, in order to reduce future losses and ensure the resilience of the financial system.

AI.tldr: 该研究利用ECB物理风险指标，评估气候相关自然灾害对欧元区（特别是意大利）金融机构贷款和证券组合的风险暴露。结果显示，在悲观气候情景下，金融组合风险将显著增加，强调需要采取气候适应措施并将气候风险纳入投资组合管理。
AI.research_question: 气候相关物理风险如何影响欧元区（特别是意大利）金融投资组合的稳定性？不同气候情景下这些风险如何演变？
AI.motivation: 气候变化的物理风险可能在全球层面威胁金融稳定，需要开发统一可比的风险指标来准确评估自然灾害对金融市场的潜在影响，为政策制定和风险管理提供依据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于气候风险金融传导理论，结合物理风险评估框架，考虑抵押品、贷款期限、防洪设施等多因素影响，构建金融机构投资组合的气候风险暴露模型。
AI.method: 利用欧洲央行（ECB）开发的物理风险指标，采用情景分析方法（包括悲观气候情景），比较意大利与主要欧元区国家的金融投资组合风险暴露。
AI.findings: 1. 金融投资组合风险预计将增加，特别是在悲观气候情景下；2. 意大利及整个欧元区都面临显著风险上升；3. 风险暴露评估需考虑抵押品、贷款期限、防洪设施等多种因素。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 验证了ECB物理风险指标在评估金融系统气候风险暴露方面的有效性；2. 提供了气候风险在不同国家间比较的实证证据；3. 丰富了气候风险金融传导机制的理论理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为金融机构提供气候风险管理的量化工具；2. 为监管机构制定气候风险监管政策提供依据；3. 强调采取气候适应措施的重要性；4. 推动将气候风险纳入投资组合管理实践。

detail.abstract: Local commercial real estate conditions are positively correlated with the health of regional banks (assets between $10 billion and $100 billion), as measured by the composite confidential supervisory rating. Among other variables, return on assets is positively correlated with our proxy of bank health, but size and capital ratio are negatively correlated. Among the different components of the rating, the management rating has the most influence on the composite rating.

AI.tldr: 地方商业地产状况与区域银行健康度正相关，资产回报率也与银行健康度正相关，但银行规模和资本比率与健康度负相关。在评级各组成部分中，管理评级对综合评级影响最大。
AI.research_question: 地方商业地产状况如何影响区域银行（资产100-1000亿美元）的健康度？哪些银行特征与银行健康度相关？银行监管评级各组成部分中哪个对综合评级影响最大？
AI.motivation: 了解区域银行健康度的决定因素对监管机构、投资者和银行管理者都很重要。地方经济环境特别是商业地产状况可能对区域银行有重要影响，但具体关系需要实证检验。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于银行风险管理理论、房地产金融理论和监管评级理论。假设地方经济条件影响银行资产质量，银行内部特征影响风险管理能力。
AI.method: 实证分析，使用回归模型检验地方商业地产状况与银行健康度的关系。银行健康度用综合保密监管评级衡量，控制银行规模、资本比率、资产回报率等变量。
AI.findings: 1. 地方商业地产状况与区域银行健康度正相关；2. 资产回报率与银行健康度正相关；3. 银行规模和资本比率与健康度负相关；4. 管理评级对综合评级影响最大。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 实证验证了地方经济环境对区域银行健康度的影响机制；2. 揭示了银行规模与健康度的负相关关系，挑战了"越大越安全"的传统观点；3. 强调了管理质量在银行监管评级中的核心作用。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为监管机构提供区域银行风险评估的参考指标；2. 帮助银行管理者关注地方商业地产风险；3. 为投资者评估银行健康度提供实证依据；4. 强调银行管理质量的重要性。

reference: NBER Working Paper No. w34720
title: Creating High-Opportunity Neighborhoods: Evidence from the HOPE VI Program
affiliations: Harvard University, Harvard University, U.S. Census Bureau, Harvard University - Department of Economics, Government of the United States of America - Bureau of the Census, Harvard University and Cornell University

detail.title: Creating High-Opportunity Neighborhoods: Evidence from the HOPE VI Program

publicationDetails.detailsText: []
NBER Working Paper No. w34720

detail.abstract:
We study whether low-economic-mobility neighborhoods can be transformed into high-mobility areas by analyzing the HOPE VI program, which invested $17 billion to revitalize 262 distressed public housing developments. We estimate the program’s impacts using a matched difference-in-differences design, comparing outcomes in revitalized developments to observably similar control developments using anonymized tax records. HOPE VI reduced neighborhood poverty rates by attracting higher-income families to revitalized neighborhoods, but had no causal impact on the earnings of adults living in public housing units. Children raised in revitalized public housing units earned more, were more likely to attend college, and were less likely to be incarcerated. Using a movers exposure design and sibling comparisons, we show that these improvements were driven by changes in neighborhoods’ causal effects on children’s outcomes. The improvements in neighborhood causal effects were driven in large part by changes in social interaction: HOPE VI increased interaction between public housing residents and peers in surrounding neighborhoods and increased earnings more for subgroups with higher-income peers. Many low-income families in the U.S. currently live in neighborhoods that are as socially isolated as the HOPE VI developments were prior to revitalization. We conclude that it is feasible to create high-opportunity neighborhoods and that connecting socially isolated areas to surrounding communities is a cost-effective approach to doing so.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: HOPE VI项目投资170亿美元改造262个贫困公共住房项目，研究发现：虽然未能提升原住成年人的收入，但显著改善了在改造社区长大的儿童的经济和教育成果，这主要源于社区社会互动的改善，特别是与周边高收入同龄人的接触增加。
AI.research_question: 低经济流动性社区能否通过公共住房改造项目（如HOPE VI）转变为高流动性社区？这种转变对居民特别是儿童的经济和教育成果有何影响？
AI.motivation: 美国许多低收入家庭生活在社会隔离严重的社区，这些社区缺乏经济流动性。HOPE VI项目作为大规模公共住房改造计划，为研究社区改造对居民社会经济成果的影响提供了独特机会。
AI.theoretical_framework: 邻里效应理论、社会互动理论、经济流动性理论、社区改造对儿童发展的影响机制
AI.method: 匹配双重差分设计（matched difference-in-differences），使用匿名税收记录数据，比较改造社区与相似控制社区的结果；移动者暴露设计和兄弟姐妹比较分析
AI.findings: 1. HOPE VI降低了社区贫困率（吸引高收入家庭迁入）但未提升原住成年人的收入；2. 在改造社区长大的儿童收入更高、上大学概率更高、入狱概率更低；3. 这些改善主要由邻里对儿童成果的因果效应变化驱动；4. 社会互动变化是关键机制：增加了公共住房居民与周边社区同龄人的互动，对高收入同龄人接触更多的亚群体改善更明显
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 验证了邻里效应对儿童发展的因果影响；2. 揭示了社会互动作为社区改造影响机制的重要性；3. 为经济流动性理论提供了实证支持，表明社区环境可改变
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 证明创建高机会社区是可行的；2. 将社会隔离区域与周边社区连接是成本有效的社区改造策略；3. 为美国类似社区改造项目提供政策依据；4. 强调社区改造应特别关注儿童发展和社会互动改善

detail.title: Agent-Based Modeling at Central Banks: Recent Developments and New Challenges

publicationDetails.detailsText: Bank of Italy Occasional Paper No. 956
publicationDetails.journalName: Bank of Italy Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: Over the past decade, agent-based models (ABMs) have been increasingly employed as analytical tools within economic policy institutions. This paper documents this trend by surveying the ABM-relevant research and policy outputs of central banks and other related economic policy institutions. We classify these studies and reports into three main categories: (i) applied research connected to the mandates of central banks; (ii) technical and methodological research supporting the advancement of ABMs; and (iii) examples of the integration of ABMs into policy work. Our findings indicate that ABMs have emerged as effective complementary tools for central banks in carrying out their responsibilities, especially after the extension of their mandates following the global financial crisis of 2007-09. While acknowledging that there remains room for improvement, we argue that integrating ABMs into the analytical frameworks of central banks can support more effective policy responses to both existing and emerging economic challenges, including financial innovation and climate change.

title: A Pragmatic Approach to Simplification: The Case of Banking Regulation in the EU
affiliations: Bank of Italy and Bank of Italy

detail.title: A Pragmatic Approach to Simplification: The Case of Banking Regulation in the EU

publicationDetails.detailsText: Bank of Italy Occasional Paper No. 955
publicationDetails.journalName: Bank of Italy Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: The debate on the level of complexity of EU financial regulation has gained momentum in recent months, with both policymakers and industry stakeholders highlighting the need for a simpler and more stable framework. This paper aims to contribute to this debate by making pragmatic suggestions with specific regard to prudential regulation in the EU, where we identify a number of initiatives that could be pursued in the short to medium term. In the short term, the paper proposes, among others: streamlining the mandates of the European Banking Authority (EBA) for developing implementing rules under the CRR3-CRD6 package; simplifying the market risk rules (Fundamental Review of the Trading book, FRTB), particularly in the area of internal models; reviewing due diligence and transparency provisions for some types of securitizations. In the medium term, we see scope for launching a broader discussion on reforming the EU’s legislative approach to make it more efficient, as well as for addressing fundamental issues in the prudential framework, such as the structure of capital requirements. The main message of our analysis is that the ambitious objective of establishing simpler and more stable rules in the financial sector is a unique opportunity at the current juncture for EU policymakers to improve the quality of banking regulation – making it easier for supervisors to enforce and for financial institutions to implement – without compromising the overarching objectives of avoiding deregulation and ensuring that the financial system remains highly resilient to potential shocks.

AI.tldr: 本文针对欧盟金融监管复杂性辩论，提出简化审慎监管的实用建议，包括短期措施（如简化EBA授权、市场风险规则等）和中长期改革（如立法方式改革、资本要求结构等），旨在实现更简单稳定的监管框架而不牺牲金融韧性。
AI.research_question: 如何在欧盟金融监管框架中实现更简单、更稳定的审慎监管，同时不损害金融体系的韧性和监管目标？
AI.motivation: 近年来欧盟金融监管复杂性辩论日益激烈，政策制定者和行业利益相关者都强调需要更简单、更稳定的监管框架。当前时机为欧盟政策制定者提供了改善银行监管质量的独特机会。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于审慎监管理论、监管效率理论和金融稳定框架，探讨监管复杂性与有效性之间的平衡，以及简化监管对执行和实施的影响。
AI.method: 政策分析研究，通过识别现有监管框架中的复杂性问题，提出具体的短期和中期改革建议，基于欧盟现行监管体系进行实用主义分析。
AI.findings: 短期可采取的措施包括：简化欧洲银行管理局在CRR3-CRD6下的授权、简化交易账簿基本审查（FRTB）的市场风险规则（特别是内部模型）、审查某些证券化类型的尽职调查和透明度规定。中期可启动更广泛的立法方式改革讨论，并解决资本要求结构等根本问题。
AI.theory_contributions: 为监管复杂性理论提供实证分析，提出在保持金融稳定目标的前提下简化监管框架的理论框架，探讨监管效率与监管目标之间的平衡机制。

title: How Prior Behavior Shapes Responses to Environmental Campaigns: Evidence from Pharmaceutical Recycling
affiliations: University of Lille

detail.title: How Prior Behavior Shapes Responses to Environmental Campaigns: Evidence from Pharmaceutical Recycling
detail.abstract: Information campaigns are widely used as non-price, information-based policy instruments to promote environmentally beneficial behavior, including participation in waste-to-energy systems. This paper examines how prior pro-environmental behavior conditions individual responses to a recycling policy in the context of pharmaceutical waste disposal in France, where unused medicines are collected and incinerated with energy recovery. Using original survey data linked to three poster campaigns conducted in the Paris metro between 2019 and 2020, we analyze attention to and evaluation of campaign messages. To address endogeneity in self-reported recycling behavior, we implement a two-stage least squares strategy exploiting variation in household purchasing responsibility and age. We find that individuals already engaged in the recycling of unused medicines are more likely to recall and positively evaluate campaign messages, while exposure alone has limited effects once behavioral selection is accounted for. These results suggest that information campaigns tend to reinforce existing behaviors and highlight the importance of accounting for behavioral heterogeneity when designing and evaluating information-based environmental policies.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨了信息宣传活动对法国药品废物回收行为的影响，发现已有回收习惯的人更容易关注和正面评价宣传信息，而单纯的信息暴露效果有限，说明信息宣传主要强化现有行为而非改变新行为。
AI.research_question: 先前已有的环保行为如何影响个体对药品废物回收政策信息宣传的反应？信息宣传活动是否主要强化已有行为而非改变新行为？

AI.theoretical_framework: 行为经济学中的行为异质性理论、信息处理的选择性注意理论、环保行为的习惯形成理论
AI.method: 使用2019-2020年巴黎地铁三次海报宣传活动的原始调查数据，采用两阶段最小二乘法（2SLS）解决自我报告回收行为的内生性问题，利用家庭购买责任和年龄的变异作为工具变量
AI.findings: 已有药品回收习惯的个体更可能回忆和正面评价宣传信息；一旦考虑行为选择因素，单纯的信息暴露效果有限；信息宣传活动主要强化现有行为而非改变新行为
AI.theory_contributions: 为信息宣传效果的行为异质性提供了实证证据；挑战了信息宣传普遍有效的假设；强调了在环境政策评估中考虑行为选择的重要性

title: Importance of Media Sovereignty, Stakeholding, and Narrative Setting for India
affiliations: Symbiosis School for Online and Distance Learning (SSODL), Pune, India

detail.title: Importance of Media Sovereignty, Stakeholding, and Narrative Setting for India

declarations.declarationOfInterest: NONE, IT IS A MASTERS DEGREE DISSERTATION
declarations.ethicsApproval: SURVEY WAS CONDUCTED WITH ANONYMITY. AI tools were used ethically for language refinement and structural organisation. All interpretations and arguments remain the author’s original intellectual work.
declarations.funderStatement: NONE

detail.abstract:
In an era characterised by information warfare, geopolitical competition, and algorithmically mediated perception, media sovereignty has emerged as a foundational component of national power. This study examines the importance of media sovereignty, domestic stakeholding, and narrative setting in India, situating these concepts within the intersecting domains of national security communication, post-colonial identity, and soft power projection.


Using a mixed-methods research design, the study integrates qualitative textual analysis of Indian cinema and news media framing with quantitative audience perception data. Two narrative domains form the empirical core of the research: (a) Indian cinema, with emphasis on representations of terrorism and national security before and after 2014, including depictions of the 26/11 Mumbai terror attacks and the post-2014 film Dhurandhar; and (b) comparative news media coverage of the 2025 Pahalgam terrorist attack and Operation Sindoor.


The findings reveal a discernible post-2014 shift toward evidence-based, India-centric narrative construction in cinema and domestic security reporting. However, this shift remains structurally constrained by foreign media stakeholding, international market dependencies, algorithmic visibility asymmetries, and global evaluative frameworks that mediate legitimacy. The study concludes that narrative sovereignty cannot function as an episodic communication strategy. It must instead be institutionalised as a civilisational capability, supported by archives, cinema, public broadcasting, and media literacy, enabling India to transition from reactive narrative defence to proactive global narrative setting.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨了印度在信息战时代的媒体主权、国内利益相关者和叙事设定，发现2014年后印度在电影和国内安全报道中出现了向基于证据、以印度为中心的叙事构建转变，但这种转变受到外国媒体持股、国际市场依赖等因素制约。
AI.research_question: 在信息战、地缘政治竞争和算法中介感知的时代，媒体主权、国内利益相关者和叙事设定在印度的重要性是什么？这些概念如何与国家安全传播、后殖民身份认同和软实力投射相交织？
AI.motivation: 在信息战、地缘政治竞争和算法中介感知的时代背景下，媒体主权已成为国家权力的基础组成部分。研究旨在探讨印度如何通过媒体主权、国内利益相关者和叙事设定来维护国家安全、塑造后殖民身份和投射软实力。
AI.theoretical_framework: 媒体主权理论、国家安全传播理论、后殖民身份理论、软实力投射理论、叙事建构理论
AI.method: 混合方法研究设计：1）定性文本分析（印度电影和新闻媒体框架分析）；2）定量受众感知数据。实证核心包括两个叙事领域：a) 印度电影（重点分析2014年前后恐怖主义和国家安全的表现，包括26/11孟买恐怖袭击和2014年后电影《Dhurandhar》）；b) 比较新闻媒体报道（2025年Pahalgam恐怖袭击和Operation Sindoor行动）
AI.findings: 研究发现2014年后印度在电影和国内安全报道中出现了向基于证据、以印度为中心的叙事构建的明显转变。然而，这种转变在结构上受到以下因素制约：外国媒体持股、国际市场的依赖性、算法可见性不对称以及调节合法性的全球评估框架。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）深化了媒体主权理论在信息战时代的应用；2）扩展了后殖民身份与国家安全传播的交叉研究；3）提出了叙事主权作为文明能力而非临时传播策略的理论框架；4）揭示了算法中介对叙事建构的影响机制
AI.practical_contributions: 1）为印度政策制定者提供了加强媒体主权的具体路径；2）建议将叙事主权制度化，通过档案、电影、公共广播和媒体素养建设支持；3）帮助印度从被动的叙事防御转向主动的全球叙事设定；4）为其他发展中国家应对信息战提供了参考框架

title: It's Not About Supply: Theoretical Alternatives to Supply-Side Housing Economics and Empirical Analysis in Burlington, VT

detail.title: It's Not About Supply: Theoretical Alternatives to Supply-Side Housing Economics and Empirical Analysis in Burlington, VT
detail.abstract: While housing prices increased dramatically in the years following the Covid-19 pandemic, academics, policy-makers, and media alike ascribe causality to lack of supply while suggesting increasing supply to lower prices. This paper argues that such an approach draws upon an economic theory of commodities that does not hold for housing due to its characteristic as a human need, individual investment, and connection to the inelastic supply of land. We argue that rising house prices are not a function of lack of supply, but rather increase in demand, namely from investors and individuals with large downpayments. The housing market is more complicated than theoretical commodity markets, and requires consideration beyond equilibrium analysis, including investor activity, environmental concerns, social equity, urban dynamics, and demographics, moving the housing conversation from economics to socio-politics. This paper builds a demand-based theoretical framing of housing inflation. We test our hypothesis using regression analysis, to find that investor activity in the market, coupled with increasing downpayments, are much stronger in explaining housing price increases than measures of supply. We believe the theoretical framing offers a lens by which academics and policymakers alike can address housing price increases beyond supply-side narratives.

AI.tldr: 该论文挑战了"住房价格上涨源于供应不足"的主流观点，提出住房价格上涨主要来自需求方因素，特别是投资者活动和首付增加，而非供应不足。作者认为住房市场比理论商品市场更复杂，需要超越均衡分析，考虑社会政治因素。
AI.research_question: 住房价格上涨的真正驱动因素是什么？是供应不足还是需求方因素（如投资者活动和首付增加）？
AI.motivation: 新冠疫情后住房价格急剧上涨，学术界、政策制定者和媒体普遍将原因归咎于供应不足，并建议增加供应来降低价格。作者认为这种基于商品经济学理论的方法不适用于住房市场，因为住房具有人类需求、个人投资和土地供应无弹性等特性。
AI.theoretical_framework:
1. 需求导向的住房通胀理论框架
2. 住房作为特殊商品的理论：具有人类需求属性、个人投资工具、与土地供应无弹性相关联
3. 超越传统商品市场理论的社会政治分析框架
AI.method: 回归分析：检验投资者活动和首付增加对住房价格的影响，并与供应指标进行比较
AI.findings: 投资者活动和首付增加对住房价格上涨的解释力远强于供应指标。住房市场比理论商品市场更复杂，需要综合考虑投资者活动、环境问题、社会公平、城市动态和人口结构等因素。
AI.theory_contributions:
1. 构建了基于需求的住房通胀理论框架
2. 挑战了传统商品经济学在住房市场的适用性
3. 将住房问题从单纯的经济学分析扩展到社会政治领域
4. 提供了超越供应侧叙事的分析视角
AI.practical_contributions:
1. 为政策制定者提供了新的政策视角：不应仅关注增加供应，而应关注需求管理
2. 帮助学术界和政策制定者超越供应侧叙事来应对住房价格上涨
3. 强调了考虑投资者活动、社会公平等非传统因素的重要性
4. 为住房政策制定提供了更全面的分析框架

title: Ireland Before and After the Crisis: Authoritative but Hazardous Structural Reforms in Financial Crisis Management
affiliations: University of Debrecen

detail.title: Ireland Before and After the Crisis: Authoritative but Hazardous Structural Reforms in Financial Crisis Management

publicationDetails.detailsText: Public Finance Quarterly | 2018/2

detail.abstract: Owing to the significant international exposure of its economy, Ireland was one of the countries suffering the greatest losses stemming from the 2007–2008 financial crisis. After a brief presentation of the nature of the subprime crisis, the study describes the economic conditions of the country before the crisis and the impact of the crisis on the Irish economy. This part of the study provides a detailed analysis of the changes triggered by the crisis in the national budget, in sovereign debt and in tax centralisation. The chapter to follow gives an insight into the economic cornerstones and instruments of the Irish contingency measures before presenting an overview of the results of the structural reforms. The study concludes that Ireland’s resolute efforts to restore the budget and to increase the flexibility of the economic structure played a key role in the success of crisis management and in conjunction, these measures resulted in regaining the confidence of the international capital market. In addition, it should not be overlooked that the country recognised the need for and did not hesitate to take recourse to external help in its crisis management. Finally, it is pointed out in the paper that today Ireland is in a position where the economy is well prepared to commence converging to the vanguard of European Union Member States. However, the Irish society will have to pay a steep price for the opportunity of this economic convergence in future, and should also reckon with a number of risk factors in this process.
