detail.title: AI in Executive Leadership

publicationDetails.detailsText: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.18197181

detail.abstract:
Artificial intelligence is increasingly shaping how senior leaders evaluate risk, allocate capital, design strategy, and govern organisational performance. As AI systems move beyond operational automation into predictive analytics, scenario simulation, and decision orchestration, executive responsibility now extends not only to business outcomes but also to the integrity, governance, and ethical implications of algorithmically informed decisions. This white paper examines how AI is transforming executive decision environments and proposes a leadership-centred framework for integrating AI into core governance and strategic processes.

The paper analyses four key executive decision domains where AI is having measurable impact: financial management, strategic planning, innovation and product development, and human capital leadership. It argues that effective AI adoption depends less on technical sophistication and more on organisational design, leadership literacy, and governance discipline. Without appropriate oversight structures, AI deployment risks amplifying bias, eroding accountability, and creating false confidence in automated recommendations.

Drawing on enterprise and public-sector practices, the paper outlines a practical executive roadmap for AI integration, including strategy formulation, tool and vendor selection, governance framework design, and change management. It further examines ethical and regulatory risks associated with AI-influenced decisions and highlights the role of senior leadership in maintaining transparency, proportionality, and institutional trust.

Finally, the paper considers emerging trends in intelligent enterprises and the evolving role of the C-suite as designers and stewards of decision systems rather than sole decision makers. It positions AI not as a substitute for executive judgement, but as an augmentation of leadership cognition in environments characterised by complexity, uncertainty, and rapid change. The paper is intended for senior executives, board members, policymakers, and management researchers concerned with responsible and effective leadership in AI-enabled organisations.

AI.tldr: 这篇白皮书探讨了AI如何改变高管决策环境，提出了一个以领导力为中心的框架，将AI整合到核心治理和战略流程中。论文分析了AI对财务、战略、创新和人力资本四个决策领域的影响，强调有效AI采用更依赖组织设计、领导力素养和治理纪律而非技术复杂性。论文为高管提供了AI整合的实用路线图，并讨论了AI决策的伦理和监管风险。
AI.research_question: AI如何改变高管决策环境？高管如何有效整合AI到核心治理和战略流程中？
AI.motivation: 随着AI系统从操作自动化扩展到预测分析、情景模拟和决策编排，高管责任不仅延伸到业务结果，还包括算法决策的完整性、治理和伦理影响。缺乏适当监督结构的AI部署可能放大偏见、削弱问责制，并产生对自动化建议的虚假信心。
AI.theoretical_framework: 领导力中心框架，AI作为领导力认知增强而非替代，决策系统设计理论，组织设计理论，治理框架理论
AI.method: 基于企业和公共部门实践的分析性研究，案例研究，框架开发，路线图制定
AI.findings: AI在四个关键高管决策领域产生可衡量影响：财务管理、战略规划、创新与产品开发、人力资本领导。有效AI采用更依赖组织设计、领导力素养和治理纪律而非技术复杂性。高管需要从单一决策者转变为决策系统的设计者和管家。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了领导力中心的AI整合框架，将AI定位为领导力认知增强而非替代，发展了决策系统设计理论，扩展了高管在AI时代的责任理论
AI.practical_contributions: 为高管提供了AI整合的实用路线图，包括战略制定、工具和供应商选择、治理框架设计和变革管理。帮助组织建立适当的监督结构，避免AI部署风险。为高管、董事会成员、政策制定者提供负责任和有效领导AI赋能组织的指导。

title: The Influence of Leadership Style on Project Team Performance
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: The Influence of Leadership Style on Project Team Performance
detail.abstract: Project team performance was examined as an effect of leadership styles in the IT, Construction and Consultancy sectors. A pragmatist mixed-methods approach was used to integrate quantitative and qualitative analysis to explore a greater wholeness of insight into effective leadership in a project-based organisation. Quantitative information was collected through fifty-one valid questionnaires' responses and was analysed using SPSS through descriptive statistics, correlation, and regression analysis. Results were derived that the transformational and democratic styles were most utilized by project managers and highly correlated with team performance for projects. The regression model established that leadership styles formed part of the most significant predictors of project success, accounting for some 63% of the variance in team performance. Seven semi-structured interviews were conducted and analysed against Braun and Clarke's thematic analysis framework. The analysis produced ten overarching themes that emerge to show adaptive, inclusive, and emotionally intelligent leadership. Adaptability, open communication, cultural awareness, and motivation were cited by the interviewees as essential factors that foster team cohesion and project success. They further observed that organisational culture and team diversity were moderators of leadership effectiveness, and therefore, such strategies must target the contextual environment of organisations and team compositions. This study endorses transformational and democratic leadership theories and confirms situational flexibility project management theory. Project leadership encompasses combining directive and participative behaviours, emotional intelligence, and data-driven tools, which the present study recommends that should be used in leadership development courses. The study provides valuable empirical data for project management and leadership because it can link leadership styles with team performance outcomes and illustrate how diversity and culture affect the effectiveness of leadership in the dynamic world of projects. The study also contributes to the contemporary debate on evidence-led and emotionally intelligent leadership as fundamentally critical paradigms for project leaders today. Keywords: Leadership styles, project management, transformational leadership, democratic leadership, team performance, organisational culture, mixed methods, emotional intelligence.

AI.tldr: 本研究采用混合方法探讨领导风格对项目团队绩效的影响，发现变革型和民主型领导风格最常用且与团队绩效高度相关，领导风格能解释约63%的团队绩效变异。研究强调适应性、包容性和情商在领导中的重要性。
AI.research_question: 领导风格如何影响IT、建筑和咨询行业的项目团队绩效？
AI.motivation: 探索项目型组织中有效领导力的完整图景，为项目管理和领导力发展提供实证依据，特别是在动态变化的项目环境中。
AI.theoretical_framework: 变革型领导理论、民主型领导理论、情境灵活性项目管理理论
AI.method: 采用实用主义混合方法：1）定量分析：51份有效问卷，使用SPSS进行描述性统计、相关性和回归分析；2）定性分析：7个半结构化访谈，采用Braun和Clarke的主题分析框架
AI.findings: 1）变革型和民主型领导风格最常用且与团队绩效高度相关；2）领导风格能解释约63%的团队绩效变异；3）适应性、包容性和情商是有效领导的关键；4）组织文化和团队多样性调节领导效果
AI.theory_contributions: 1）支持变革型和民主型领导理论；2）确认情境灵活性项目管理理论；3）为证据导向和情商领导力辩论提供实证支持
AI.practical_contributions: 1）为领导力发展课程提供建议：结合指导性和参与性行为、情商和数据驱动工具；2）强调领导策略需针对组织环境和团队构成；3）为项目管理者提供实用的领导力指导

title: General Optimal Stopping without Time Consistency
affiliations: University of Oxford - Mathematical Institute and Mathematical Institute, Oxford-Nie Financial Big Data Laboratory

detail.title: General Optimal Stopping without Time Consistency
detail.abstract: In this paper, we propose a new framework for solving a general dynamic optimal stopping problem without time consistency. A sophisticated solution is proposed and is well-defined for any time setting with general flows of objectives. A backward iteration is proposed to find the solution. The iteration works with an additional condition, which holds in interesting cases including the time inconsistency arising from non-exponential discounting. Even if the iteration does not work, the equilibrium solution can still be studied by a forward definition.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个解决一般动态最优停止问题的新框架，该框架不要求时间一致性，通过后向迭代或前向定义来寻找均衡解。
AI.research_question: 如何在没有时间一致性的情况下解决一般动态最优停止问题？
AI.motivation: 传统最优停止问题通常假设时间一致性，但在许多实际应用中（如非指数贴现）会出现时间不一致性，需要新的理论框架来处理这种情况。
AI.theoretical_framework: 动态最优停止理论、时间不一致性理论、均衡解概念、后向迭代和前向定义方法
AI.method: 提出了一个包含后向迭代和前向定义的新框架，后向迭代在满足附加条件时有效（包括非指数贴现情况），否则使用前向定义来研究均衡解。
AI.findings: 开发了一个适用于任何时间设置和一般目标流的解决方案框架，证明了后向迭代在有趣案例中的有效性，并提供了前向定义作为替代方法。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了动态最优停止理论，使其能够处理时间不一致性问题，为时间不一致性下的决策制定提供了新的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为金融、经济学和运筹学中涉及非指数贴现或其他时间不一致性问题的实际应用提供了实用的解决方案工具。

title: The Last Mile of Disinflation: Systemic Risk, Cost Channels, and Real-Time Inflation Forecasting in the UK, 2022-2024
affiliations: Independent Researcher

detail.title: The Last Mile of Disinflation: Systemic Risk, Cost Channels, and Real-Time Inflation Forecasting in the UK, 2022-2024
detail.abstract: The persistence of inflation during the post-2022 tightening cycle posed a fundamental challenge for standard forecasting models. This paper provides a real-time test of a risk-based cost channel derived from the Systemic Risk of Doing Business (SRDB) framework. I argue that rapid monetary tightening raises firms' financing costs and risk premia, creating an inflationary supply-side force that delays disinflation. Using a quasi-real-time forecasting exercise initialized at the UK inflation peak in 2022Q4, I compare SRDB-augmented models against adaptive and wage-augmented Phillips curve benchmarks through 2024Q1. The SRDB specification reduces forecast RMSE by 31.6 % (Diebold-Mariano test statistic = 2.34, p = 0.033), with gains concentrated in services inflation. A counterfactual decomposition shows the financial cost channel ac- counts for 42 % of this improvement. These results provide robust evidence that inflation persistence during the "last mile" reflects policy-induced cost pressures that standard demand-centric models systematically miss.

AI.tldr: 本文通过系统性风险商业框架(SRDB)的风险成本渠道，解释了2022年后紧缩周期中通胀持续的原因，发现货币政策紧缩通过提高企业融资成本和风险溢价，产生了延迟通缩的供给侧通胀压力。
AI.research_question: 为什么在2022年后的货币紧缩周期中，通胀表现出持续的"最后一英里"现象？风险成本渠道如何解释这种通胀持续性？
AI.motivation: 2022年后货币紧缩周期中通胀的持续性对标准预测模型构成了根本性挑战，传统需求中心模型无法解释通胀为何在紧缩政策下仍然持续。
AI.theoretical_framework: 系统性风险商业框架(SRDB)的风险成本渠道理论，认为货币政策紧缩会提高企业融资成本和风险溢价，形成供给侧的通胀压力。
AI.method: 采用准实时预测实验，以2022年第四季度英国通胀峰值为起点，比较SRDB增强模型与自适应和工资增强菲利普斯曲线基准模型，直至2024年第一季度。
AI.findings: SRDB模型将预测均方根误差降低了31.6%，改进主要集中在服务业通胀。反事实分解显示财务成本渠道解释了42%的改进。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了通胀"最后一英里"持续性的新解释框架，强调政策诱导的成本压力，挑战了传统的需求中心通胀模型。
AI.practical_contributions: 为央行和政策制定者提供了更准确的通胀预测工具，特别是在货币政策紧缩期间，有助于更好地理解通胀动态和制定相应政策。

title: Systemic Risk as a Transmission Mechanism: How Fiscal Imbalances Shape Inflation Dynamics
affiliations: Independent Researcher

detail.title: Systemic Risk as a Transmission Mechanism: How Fiscal Imbalances Shape Inflation Dynamics
detail.abstract: This paper studies a risk-based transmission mechanism linking fiscal and external imbalances to inflation dynamics. The mechanism operates through an economy-wide systemic risk state---capturing sovereign risk premia, policy uncertainty, and labor-market stress---that firms gradually incorporate into prices under nominal rigidities. Using quarterly Indian data (2004--2023), I construct a latent systemic risk index via principal components and estimate a Vector Error Correction Model (VECM) to characterize long-run comovement and short-run predictive dynamics among inflation, systemic risk, and fiscal/external balances. In the baseline specification, deficits predict the systemic risk factor; the risk factor predicts inflation at 4--6 quarter horizons; and the direct deficit--inflation predictive relationship attenuates once systemic risk is included, a pattern consistent with a risk mediation channel. Under a benchmark timing orthogonalization, systemic risk shocks account for about 28--35\% of medium-horizon inflation forecast error variance (8--12 quarters), exceeding the contribution of direct deficit shocks. In pseudo out-of-sample forecasting (from 2018Q1), risk-augmented models improve inflation forecasts relative to Phillips-curve and deficit-augmented benchmarks (about a 13\% RMSE reduction at four quarters in the baseline). The results provide evidence consistent with deficit-conditional inflation threshold findings: growth-consistent inflation may vary endogenously with the systemic risk environment shaped by fiscal and external positions.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨了财政和外部失衡通过系统性风险状态传导至通胀的机制。使用印度季度数据(2004-2023)，构建系统性风险指数，通过VECM模型发现：赤字预测系统性风险因子，风险因子在4-6个季度后预测通胀，系统性风险在赤字与通胀关系中起中介作用。
AI.research_question: 财政和外部失衡如何通过系统性风险状态传导至通胀动态？系统性风险在财政赤字与通胀关系中起什么作用？
AI.motivation: 传统通胀模型(如菲利普斯曲线)可能忽略了财政和外部失衡通过系统性风险渠道对通胀的影响。理解这一传导机制对新兴经济体(如印度)的货币政策制定有重要意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 风险传导机制理论：财政和外部失衡→系统性风险状态(主权风险溢价、政策不确定性、劳动力市场压力)→企业逐步将风险纳入定价→通胀动态。名义刚性下企业价格调整理论。
AI.method: 使用印度季度数据(2004-2023)；通过主成分分析构建潜在系统性风险指数；采用向量误差修正模型(VECM)分析长期协整关系和短期预测动态；进行伪样本外预测(从2018Q1开始)。
AI.findings: 1. 赤字预测系统性风险因子；2. 风险因子在4-6个季度后预测通胀；3. 加入系统性风险后，赤字与通胀的直接预测关系减弱，支持风险中介渠道；4. 系统性风险冲击解释28-35%的中期通胀预测误差方差；5. 风险增强模型比传统模型提高通胀预测精度(RMSE降低约13%)。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了财政/外部失衡通过系统性风险传导至通胀的新机制；为赤字条件性通胀阈值理论提供了实证支持；扩展了通胀动态理论框架，纳入系统性风险中介作用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为央行和政策制定者提供了新的通胀预测框架；表明控制财政和外部失衡对通胀管理的重要性；为新兴经济体通胀风险管理提供实证依据；支持风险增强型通胀预测模型的应用。

reference: Török, L. The Trend in Environmental Load in the European Union during the Period of 2012–2022. Energies 2024, 17, 3473. https:// doi.org/10.3390/en17143473
title: The Trend in Environmental Load in the European Union during the Period of 2012-2022

detail.title: The Trend in Environmental Load in the European Union during the Period of 2012-2022

publicationDetails.detailsText: Török, L. The Trend in Environmental Load in the European Union during the Period of 2012–2022. Energies 2024, 17, 3473. https:// doi.org/10.3390/en17143473

detail.abstract: The environmental burden is a global problem affecting the European Union. A comprehensive analysis of the environmental burden is essential for creating strategies supporting sustainable economic development. This study attempts to answer the question of why, despite the continuously decreasing energy consumption of the EU, the environmental burden of this region is not substantially decreasing. This study provides novel insights into this research area by integrating EU economic dynamics and environmental efficiency indicators. In this study, we used the IPAT method. Before the main analysis, the researcher conducted cross-sectional dependence, slope heterogeneity, and Westerlund cointegration tests using the primary data. Based on the results, the EU member states were classified into clusters, and a linear trend model analysis was carried out. The results show that the total environmental load of the EU did not decrease significantly between 2012 and 2022. The fact that the environmental burden remained at the same level is explained by the fact that there were 16 member countries whose total environmental load increased but whose economic output was lower during this time period. This was offset by 11 member countries with high economic outputs, whose total environmental load decreased. This study proved that GDP growth was the main driving force maintaining the total environmental load at the same level. The EU should encourage member states to continue to implement environmental protection rules to limit and eliminate costly environmental burdens on their societies and economies. This study can be helpful to researchers, political decision-makers, and experts working on environmental public policies for the EU.

AI.tldr: 尽管欧盟能源消耗持续下降，但环境负担并未显著减少，主要原因是GDP增长抵消了能效提升带来的环境改善效果。
AI.research_question: 为什么欧盟能源消耗持续下降，但该地区的环境负担却没有显著减少？
AI.motivation: 环境负担是全球性问题，对欧盟有重要影响。全面分析环境负担对制定可持续经济发展战略至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: IPAT方法（环境影响=人口×财富×技术），结合欧盟经济动态和环境效率指标。
AI.method: 使用IPAT方法，进行横截面依赖性、斜率异质性和Westerlund协整检验，然后对欧盟成员国进行聚类分析，并进行线性趋势模型分析。
AI.findings: 2012-2022年间欧盟总环境负荷未显著下降。16个成员国环境负荷增加但经济产出较低，而11个高经济产出成员国环境负荷减少，两者相互抵消。GDP增长是维持环境负荷不变的主要驱动力。
AI.theory_contributions: 整合经济动态和环境效率指标，为理解环境负担与经济发展关系提供新视角，验证了IPAT框架在欧盟情境下的适用性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为欧盟政策制定者提供实证依据，建议继续实施环境保护规则，限制和消除环境负担。对研究人员、决策者和环境公共政策专家具有参考价值。

title: The Political Economy of Progressive Era Child-Labor Regulation: Evidence from North Carolina
affiliations: University of North Carolina Wilmington

detail.title: The Political Economy of Progressive Era Child-Labor Regulation: Evidence from North Carolina
detail.abstract: In 1880, only seven states set a minimum age for factory employment. By 1910, all but four had a minimum age. In this paper, I use manufacturing and opinion survey data from North Carolina to understand the underlying political economy. First, I show that the use of child labor was tied to factory scale and the division of labor, but not new technologies such as electrification. Second, by estimating the relative labor productivities of children and men, I show that children were underpaid, helping explain manufacturer opposition to regulation. Third, I show that higher-income workers, rather than those directly competing with children, were more likely to support child labor regulation. Fourth, I find that the regulations on child labor, as enacted, had little effect on manufacturers, and that child labor was falling prior to enactment. Together, these results suggest that child labor regulation resulted from, rather than caused, the decline in child labor force participation.

AI.tldr: 本文使用北卡罗来纳州的制造业和民意调查数据，研究了19世纪末20世纪初童工法规的政治经济学。研究发现：童工使用与工厂规模和分工相关，而非新技术；童工被低估工资；高收入工人更支持童工法规；法规本身对制造商影响有限，且童工在法规出台前已在下降。结论表明童工法规是童工减少的结果而非原因。
AI.research_question: 19世纪末20世纪初美国童工法规背后的政治经济学机制是什么？童工法规是童工减少的原因还是结果？
AI.motivation: 1880年只有7个州设定了工厂就业最低年龄，到1910年几乎所有州都有了相关规定。这一快速政策变化背后的驱动因素尚不清楚，需要理解童工法规的政治经济学基础。
AI.theoretical_framework: 政治经济学理论、劳动经济学、制度变迁理论、利益集团理论
AI.method: 使用北卡罗来纳州的制造业数据和民意调查数据进行实证分析，包括童工使用模式分析、相对劳动生产率估计、民意支持度分析以及法规影响评估
AI.findings: 1) 童工使用与工厂规模和分工相关，与电气化等新技术无关；2) 童工被低估工资，解释了制造商反对监管的原因；3) 高收入工人比直接与童工竞争的工人更支持法规；4) 法规对制造商影响有限，童工在法规出台前已在下降
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 揭示了童工法规作为社会变迁结果而非原因的制度变迁模式；2) 阐明了不同社会群体在劳动法规中的利益分歧；3) 提供了历史制度变迁的实证证据
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 为理解当代劳动法规制定提供历史借鉴；2) 揭示了社会规范变化与法规制定的互动关系；3) 为政策制定者理解法规实际效果提供参考

reference: Sustainable Futures, volume 10, 2025[10.1016/j.sftr.2025.100996]
title: Structural Divergences in the European Economy: A Cluster Approach to Macroeconomic Performance (2013-2023)

detail.title: Structural Divergences in the European Economy: A Cluster Approach to Macroeconomic Performance (2013-2023)

publicationDetails.detailsText: Sustainable Futures, volume 10, 2025[10.1016/j.sftr.2025.100996]

detail.abstract: Economic output and its growth play a crucial role in the well-being of people in the European Union (EU) countries. This study aims to analyze the effects of relevant macroeconomic variables on the development of GDP in the EU and its member states over 2013-2023. The research uses a VAR model to examine the impact of inflation, unemployment rate, long-term interest rates, government balance, external balance, and investment rate on the change in GDP. One of the findings is that the sustainability of EU economic growth has been significantly affected by the interactions between macroeconomic variables, particularly interest rates, investment, and inflation, which are the imbalances that lead to the reversal of business cycles. At the level of individual Member States, high interest rates have reduced investment activity, particularly in Italy, Spain, and Greece. At the same time, export-oriented economies such as Germany and the Netherlands have maintained GDP growth by benefiting from their trade surpluses, but domestic demand has declined. The second finding is that EU member states can be classified into six clusters based on their economic performance and macroeconomic stability, which reflect the differences between advanced, innovation-orientated, catching-up, crisisresolving, and structurally challenged countries, and that macroeconomic indicators have a heterogeneous impact on growth. Growth has been ambivalent in the EU. While Western European countries have shown moderate growth rates while maintaining their stability and competitiveness, Central, Eastern European, and Southern European economies have struggled with higher growth volatility and structural challenges.

AI.tldr: 本研究使用VAR模型分析2013-2023年欧盟及其成员国宏观经济变量对GDP发展的影响，发现利率、投资和通胀的相互作用显著影响欧盟经济增长可持续性，成员国可分为六类经济表现集群，宏观经济指标对增长具有异质性影响。
AI.research_question: 宏观经济变量（通胀、失业率、长期利率、政府平衡、外部平衡、投资率）如何影响欧盟及其成员国2013-2023年期间的GDP发展？
AI.motivation: 经济产出及其增长对欧盟国家人民福祉至关重要，需要理解关键宏观经济变量如何影响欧盟经济增长，特别是考虑到成员国之间的经济差异和周期性波动。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于VAR（向量自回归）模型框架，分析宏观经济变量之间的动态相互作用；结合经济增长理论、商业周期理论和欧盟经济一体化理论。
AI.method: 使用VAR模型分析2013-2023年欧盟及其成员国面板数据，考察通胀、失业率、长期利率、政府平衡、外部平衡、投资率对GDP变化的影响。
AI.findings: 1. 利率、投资和通胀的相互作用显著影响欧盟经济增长可持续性，导致商业周期逆转；2. 高利率抑制投资（意大利、西班牙、希腊尤为明显）；3. 出口导向型经济体（德国、荷兰）通过贸易顺差维持增长但内需下降；4. 欧盟成员国可分为六类经济表现集群；5. 宏观经济指标对增长具有异质性影响；6. 西欧增长稳定，中东欧和南欧增长波动较大。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 扩展了VAR模型在欧盟宏观经济分析中的应用；2. 提出了欧盟成员国六分类框架；3. 揭示了宏观经济变量异质性影响机制；4. 丰富了欧盟经济增长可持续性理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为欧盟政策制定者提供差异化政策建议；2. 帮助成员国识别自身经济结构特征；3. 为投资者提供欧盟区域经济风险评估框架；4. 为欧盟经济治理改革提供实证依据。

reference: Technological and Economic Development of Economy, volume 29, issue 4, 2023[10.3846/tede.2023.18871]
title: The Impacts of Energy Supply and Environmental Taxation on Carbon Intensity
affiliations: University of Debrecen,  and University of Debrecen

detail.title: The Impacts of Energy Supply and Environmental Taxation on Carbon Intensity

publicationDetails.detailsText: Technological and Economic Development of Economy, volume 29, issue 4, 2023[10.3846/tede.2023.18871]

detail.abstract: Carbon dioxide (CO 2) is a significant source of Greenhouse Gas (GHG) emissions and plays a crucial role in climate change and global warming. This study aims to explain the effects of primary and renewable energy supplies and environmental taxation and to analyse how taxation can alter their direct effects on carbon intensity. The research was conducted using a generalized method of moments model that uses instrumental variables with two-stage (2SGMM) estimators to calculate the direct and moderating effects of environmental taxes on carbon intensity. This study confirms the EKC theorem, and results have shown that primary energy supply and environmental-related taxation positively contribute to carbon intensity. The second finding indicates that a major increase in the proportion of renewable energy will greatly slow the rate of carbon dioxide emissions. The study provides additional evidence concerning the moderating role of taxation in amplifying the impacts of primary and renewable energy supply. The empirical findings suggest that the taxation impact is more fiscal than an incentive. In addition to the current energy and economic crisis, considerable funding and fiscal policies are needed to achieve more sustainable development paths towards carbon neutrality and energy security.

AI.tldr: 该研究使用广义矩估计方法分析主要能源供应、可再生能源和环境税对碳强度的影响，验证环境库兹涅茨曲线，发现环境税更多是财政工具而非激励措施。
AI.research_question: 主要能源供应、可再生能源供应和环境税如何影响碳强度？环境税如何调节能源供应对碳强度的直接影响？
AI.motivation: 二氧化碳是温室气体排放的重要来源，对气候变化和全球变暖起关键作用。当前能源和经济危机下，需要更多资金和财政政策来实现碳中和与能源安全的可持续发展路径。
AI.theoretical_framework: 环境库兹涅茨曲线（EKC）理论，环境税作为调节变量的理论框架。
AI.method: 使用广义矩估计模型（GMM），采用两阶段（2SGMM）估计器计算环境税对碳强度的直接效应和调节效应。
AI.findings: 1. 验证了EKC定理；2. 主要能源供应和环境相关税收对碳强度有正向贡献；3. 可再生能源比例大幅增加会显著减缓二氧化碳排放率；4. 税收在放大主要能源和可再生能源供应影响方面起调节作用；5. 税收影响更多是财政性的而非激励性的。
AI.theory_contributions: 为环境库兹涅茨曲线理论提供了实证支持，深化了对环境税调节作用的理解，特别是税收作为财政工具而非激励措施的理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了实证依据：需要大量资金和财政政策支持可再生能源发展，实现碳中和与能源安全；环境税设计应更注重其财政功能而非激励效果。

reference: Competitio 2021. XX. évfolyam doi: 10.21845/comp/2021/1–2/3
title: Corporate Tax -A New Paradigm is Needed! -II. A New Global Value-Added Tax is Needed Instead of a Corporate Tax

detail.title: Corporate Tax -A New Paradigm is Needed! -II. A New Global Value-Added Tax is Needed Instead of a Corporate Tax

publicationDetails.detailsText: Competitio 2021. XX. évfolyam doi: 10.21845/comp/2021/1–2/3

detail.abstract: The corporate tax system is easy to manipulate in modern economies, with high explicit and implicit costs required for any such system to be maintained. Attempts to reform the corporate tax system have been unsuccessful, with aggressive tax planning and tax evasion gaining ground at the international level. The source of constant conflicts between national tax administrations and companies is also the corporate tax base and tax accounting. Therefore, based on a new paradigm, I have developed a new corporate value-added tax, based on corporate adjusted sales, for global introduction. Revenues from this tax would replace general government revenues lost due to the abolition of corporate tax. Based on the GDP of the Member States of the European Union, I calculated the rate of the new tax for all Member States. In this study, I present in detail the mechanism of operation of the new tax, then describe the advantages of the introduction of the new tax compared to the corporate tax. Finally, I will thoroughly present how the taxation of dividends from company owners/shareholders would change if the new tax I planned were introduced and operated. This new type of taxation of dividends would, in my view, contribute more fairly to burden-sharing.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于企业调整销售额的新型企业增值税，旨在替代现行企业税制。该税种通过计算欧盟成员国GDP来确定税率，并详细阐述了其运作机制、相对于企业税的优势，以及如何更公平地调整股息征税以实现税负分担。
AI.research_question: 如何设计一种新型的企业增值税来替代现行企业税制，以解决企业税基和税务会计引发的国际税收冲突，并实现更公平的税负分担？
AI.motivation: 现行企业税制在现代经济中容易被操纵，维持成本高昂，且改革尝试屡屡失败。国际层面上的激进税收筹划和逃税行为日益严重，国家税务机关与企业之间因企业税基和税务会计问题冲突不断。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于新范式（new paradigm）的企业增值税理论，以企业调整销售额为税基，替代传统企业税。该框架涉及税制设计、国际税收协调和税负公平分配等理论。
AI.method: 基于欧盟成员国GDP数据计算新税种的税率，详细设计新税的运作机制，并通过比较分析展示其相对于企业税的优势。同时，系统阐述新税制下股息征税的变化模式。
AI.findings: 1. 成功设计出基于企业调整销售额的新型增值税机制；2. 计算出适用于所有欧盟成员国的新税税率；3. 新税相比企业税具有明显优势；4. 新税制下的股息征税方式能更公平地实现税负分担。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出了基于新范式的企业增值税理论框架；2. 发展了以销售额为基础的替代性企业税制设计理论；3. 为国际税收协调和税制改革提供了新的理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为欧盟成员国提供了可操作的新型增值税实施方案；2. 为解决国际税收冲突和逃税问题提供了具体方案；3. 为企业所有者和股东提供了更公平的股息征税机制；4. 为政府提供了替代企业税的收入来源方案。

reference: Political Research Exchange, volume 7, issue 1, 2025[10.1080/2474736X.2025.2507633]
title: Economic Convergence of Central and Eastern European Countries in the European Union

detail.title: Economic Convergence of Central and Eastern European Countries in the European Union

publicationDetails.detailsText: Political Research Exchange, volume 7, issue 1, 2025[10.1080/2474736X.2025.2507633]

detail.abstract: Eight Central and Eastern European (CEE) countries joined the European Union in 2004, and three later joined, aiming to align with the EU’s average economic development. The main objective of this study is to assess the economic development status of CEE countries compared with the EU average and forecast their convergence by 2027. The study uses time-series analysis, normality tests, and convergence indices to determine the level of convergence achieved by CEE countries and various extrapolation methods to assess the level of convergence expected shortly. The results are ambivalent; in 2022, Lithuania, the Czech Republic, and Slovenia exceeded the EU average, while Croatia and Bulgaria lagged significantly behind. This study supports the neoclassical transition path theory, noting that in 2004, even less developed countries achieved the most dynamic growth by 2022. Despite the strong GDP correlation between EU and CEE countries, the drivers of GDP growth remain different. According to forecasting methods, Estonia will be next to reach an economic development level above the EU average. According to the results of extrapolation methods, Estonia may be followed by Poland, Romania and Slovakia in catching up with the EU.

AI.tldr: 本研究评估了中欧和东欧国家与欧盟平均经济水平的趋同情况，预测到2027年的发展前景。结果显示趋同情况不一：立陶宛、捷克和斯洛文尼亚已超过欧盟平均水平，而克罗地亚和保加利亚显著落后。研究支持新古典转型路径理论，并预测爱沙尼亚将是下一个超过欧盟平均水平的国家。
AI.research_question: 中欧和东欧国家与欧盟平均经济水平的趋同程度如何？到2027年这些国家能否实现经济趋同？
AI.motivation: 2004年八个中欧和东欧国家加入欧盟，随后又有三个国家加入，旨在实现与欧盟平均经济水平的趋同。需要评估这些国家的经济趋同现状并预测未来发展前景。
AI.theoretical_framework: 新古典转型路径理论（neoclassical transition path theory）
AI.method: 时间序列分析、正态性检验、趋同指数、多种外推方法
AI.findings: 1. 2022年立陶宛、捷克和斯洛文尼亚已超过欧盟平均水平，克罗地亚和保加利亚显著落后；2. 2004年较不发达国家到2022年实现了最动态的增长；3. 尽管欧盟与中欧东欧国家GDP相关性高，但增长驱动因素不同；4. 预测爱沙尼亚将是下一个超过欧盟平均水平的国家，随后可能是波兰、罗马尼亚和斯洛伐克。
AI.theory_contributions: 支持新古典转型路径理论，验证了转型经济体通过追赶效应实现快速增长的机制
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供趋同评估工具，帮助识别需要政策支持的国家，为欧盟区域发展政策提供实证依据

title: Intraday Price Asymmetry and Next-Day Intraday Returns in the S&P 500
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: Intraday Price Asymmetry and Next-Day Intraday Returns in the S&P 500

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no conflicts of interest.

detail.abstract: This paper examines the relationship between intraday price asymmetry and next-day intraday returns in U.S. equity markets. It introduces a simple, range-based measure of intraday asymmetry constructed from daily open, high, and low prices to capture directional imbalances in intraday price movements relative to the opening level. Using more than two decades of data for the SPDR S&P 500 ETF (SPY), the analysis documents a contrarian relationship between intraday asymmetry and subsequent intraday performance. Trading sessions characterized by negative intraday asymmetry are followed, on average, by stronger next-day intraday returns, while positive asymmetry is associated with weaker subsequent intraday performance, despite the long-run upward bias of equity markets. Conditional long and short exposures derived from the measure exhibit economically meaningful return patterns, with evidence of conditional return variation on the short side concentrated during periods of elevated volatility and market stress. The analysis is intentionally descriptive and does not rely on assumptions about order flow, trading volume, or specific microstructure mechanisms. The results are consistent with temporary price pressure and inventory-related dynamics rather than persistent intraday trends, highlighting information contained in the intraday price path that is not captured by standard return-based measures.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究了美国股市日内价格不对称性与次日日内收益率之间的关系，发现两者存在反向关系：负不对称性后通常有更强的次日收益，正不对称性后则收益较弱。
AI.research_question: 日内价格不对称性如何影响次日的日内收益率表现？
AI.motivation: 传统收益率指标未能捕捉日内价格路径中的信息，需要开发新的度量方法来理解市场动态和价格压力效应。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于价格压力和库存相关动态的理论框架，关注临时性价格压力而非持久趋势。
AI.method: 使用SPDR S&P 500 ETF超过20年的数据，构建基于日开盘、最高、最低价的简单范围度量来衡量日内不对称性。
AI.findings: 发现日内不对称性与后续日内表现存在反向关系；负不对称性后次日收益更强，正不对称性后收益较弱；在波动率高和市场压力时期，空头侧的条件收益变化更为明显。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了日内价格路径信息的新视角，支持临时价格压力理论而非持久趋势理论，为市场微观结构研究提供了新证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 开发了简单的日内不对称性度量方法，可用于交易策略构建；识别了市场压力时期的特定收益模式；为投资者提供了基于价格路径信息的决策工具。

reference: European Research Studies Journal Volume XXIV, Issue 3, 2021
title: Co-movement in Stock Indices and GDP During the COVID-19 Period in the Countries of the European Union

detail.title: Co-movement in Stock Indices and GDP During the COVID-19 Period in the Countries of the European Union

publicationDetails.detailsText: European Research Studies Journal Volume XXIV, Issue 3, 2021

detail.abstract: Purpose: Macroeconomic research rarely analyzes the short-run relationship between stock market indices and GDP. The study seeks to answer how close the two indicators are in the short term in times of crisis. Design/Methodology/Approach: The stock market crisis caused by the COVID-19 pandemic has also developed in the European Union member states. Following the low of the European stock market in March, there was a relatively rapid rebound. There was a decline in the third quarter and strong growth in the fourth. As a result of the fear caused by the epidemic, national economies were shut down to varying degrees by governments, leading to a decline in GDP as early as the first quarter. This decline continued in the second quarter, with a strong rebound in the third and a moderate rise in the fourth. The research methodology is correlation calculation and hierarchical cluster analysis. The research hypothesizes that in the short run, stock market indices moved along with GDP. The positive correlation between the two indicators can be assumed because investors' decisions were influenced by the decline in GDP due to COVID-19. The hypothesis was not met, only in four countries, the study confirmed the co-movement of indicators. Findings: The hypothesis of the research was not fulfilled, in the majority of the EU member states, the two indicators did not change together, they did not move in the same direction. The negative correlation coefficient for the Union as a whole (r =-0.16028) means that the indicators moved in the opposite direction. Of the 27 Member States, 23 were characterized by this opposite movement. Practical Implications: The study's empirical results draw the attention of investors, risk managers, and economic policymakers to the fact that short-term changes in GDP do not influence their decision-making. Short-term GDP data are fundamentally inadequate indicators. This means that these data cannot predict with significant accuracy either expected GDP, stock market performance, and many other macroeconomic indicators. Originality/value: The originality and value of the study are given by the fact that it examines a macroeconomic relationship that researchers rarely analyze. The study's empirical results can also be used by risk managers, investors, and economic policymakers.

AI.tldr: 该研究检验了欧盟成员国在COVID-19危机期间股票市场指数与GDP的短期关系，发现两者在大多数国家中呈负相关，而非预期的正相关，表明短期GDP数据对投资者决策影响有限。
AI.research_question: 在危机时期，股票市场指数与GDP在短期内有多密切的关系？
AI.motivation: 宏观经济研究很少分析股票市场指数与GDP的短期关系，特别是在危机时期。COVID-19大流行引发的股市危机为研究这一关系提供了独特机会。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于投资者决策受GDP变化影响的理论假设，预期股票市场指数与GDP在短期内会呈现正相关关系。
AI.method: 采用相关性计算和层次聚类分析，研究欧盟27个成员国在COVID-19危机期间股票市场指数与GDP的季度变化关系。
AI.findings: 研究假设未得到验证：在大多数欧盟成员国中，两个指标并未同向变动。欧盟整体呈现负相关（r=-0.16028），27个成员国中有23个呈现相反运动趋势，仅4个国家证实了指标的同向变动。
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战了传统认为股票市场与GDP在短期内存在正相关关系的理论假设，揭示了在危机时期两者可能呈现相反运动趋势的新发现。
AI.practical_contributions: 提醒投资者、风险经理和经济政策制定者，短期GDP变化不应过度影响决策，短期GDP数据作为预测指标的准确性有限，不能可靠预测股市表现和其他宏观经济指标。

title: The Temporal Conditions of Economic Rationality
affiliations: Newcastle University

detail.title: The Temporal Conditions of Economic Rationality

declarations.declarationOfInterest: no conflicts of interest
declarations.ethicsApproval: no ethical aproval required
declarations.funderStatement: no funding

detail.abstract: Economic theory is unavoidably temporal. Production unfolds over time, contracts mature, debts persist, expectations project forward, and economic reasoning is oriented toward future possibilities. While economic models routinely represent time through metric, numerical, or stochastic structures, they typically presuppose rather than analyse the conditions under which economic phenomena can be represented as temporally ordered objects of rational deliberation. This paper addresses that neglected methodological question through a Kantian transcendental analysis of economic temporality. Building on a formally explicit, axiomatic reconstruction of time as the pure form of inner sense, the paper investigates what must be presupposed for economic rationality to be intelligible at all for finite agents. Without introducing new temporal axioms beyond Kant or committing to any particular theory of rational choice, it establishes that economic deliberation requires: (i) a unified and strictly successive temporal order, (ii) the representation of economic agency as persisting across time, (iii) the synthesis of successive economic representations into enduring and re-identifiable economic objects, and (iv) the capacity to represent future economic possibilities as relevant to present judgment within a shared temporal horizon. These conditions are not empirical generalisations or normative ideals, but transcendental conditions of intelligibility for economic rationality itself. The paper further distinguishes between transcendental temporal ordering, which grounds the possibility of economic awareness and deliberation, and the empirical temporal frameworks employed in economic modelling for purposes of calculation, prediction, and institutional coordination. By articulating this distinction, the analysis clarifies how economic theory presupposes a non-metric, order-theoretic form of time without requiring any revision of standard modelling practices, thereby making explicit a foundational but previously unexamined assumption in economic methodology.

AI.tldr: 该论文通过康德先验分析探讨经济时间性的方法论基础，揭示了经济理性理解所需的四个先验条件，区分了先验时间排序与经验时间框架，阐明了经济理论中隐含的非度量时间形式。
AI.research_question: 经济理性理解需要哪些先验的时间性条件？经济理论如何预设时间作为经济现象可理解性的基础？
AI.motivation: 经济理论虽然经常使用时间概念，但通常预设而非分析时间作为经济现象可理解性的条件。现有经济模型关注时间的度量、数值或随机表示，但忽视了时间作为经济理性本身可能性的先验基础。
AI.theoretical_framework: 康德先验哲学，特别是时间作为内在感官的纯粹形式；先验分析方法；经济理性理论；时间哲学。
AI.method: 康德先验分析方法，基于时间作为内在感官纯粹形式的公理化重构，分析经济理性理解所需的必要条件。
AI.findings: 经济理性理解需要四个先验条件：(1)统一且严格连续的时间顺序；(2)经济主体在时间中持续存在的表征；(3)连续经济表征合成为持久且可重新识别的经济对象；(4)在共享时间视域中将未来经济可能性表征为与当前判断相关的能力。
AI.theory_contributions: 阐明了经济理性理解所需的先验时间条件；区分了先验时间排序（经济意识和审议的基础）与经验时间框架（经济建模中的计算、预测和制度协调工具）；揭示了经济理论中隐含的非度量、顺序理论的时间形式。
AI.practical_contributions: 澄清了经济方法论中基础但先前未被检验的假设；为经济模型的时间表示提供了哲学基础；表明标准建模实践无需修改，但需要认识到其隐含的时间预设；有助于理解经济理性在有限主体中的可能性条件。

title: A Shocking Reversal: Flipping Complements and Substitutes in Network Games
affiliations: and Columbia University, Graduate School of Arts and Sciences, Department of Economics

detail.title: A Shocking Reversal: Flipping Complements and Substitutes in Network Games
detail.abstract: In conventional network games, each player chooses one action that impacts all of her neighbors. We study players that select neighbor-specific efforts and face a convex total effort cost. Our main result highlights a striking reversal in comparative statics: When bilateral efforts are strategic complements (substitutes), shocks propagate through the network in a pattern befitting strategic substitutes (complements) in standard network games. This reversal, together with other fundamental changes in player behavior, suggests that retaining the single effort assumption when it is not appropriate may lead to poor policy recommendations.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究了网络博弈中玩家可以选择针对不同邻居的不同努力水平的情况，发现当双边努力是战略互补（替代）时，冲击在网络中的传播模式与传统网络博弈中的战略替代（互补）相反，这表明保留单一努力假设可能导致错误的政策建议。
AI.research_question: 当网络博弈中的玩家可以选择针对不同邻居的不同努力水平时，战略互动和冲击传播模式会发生什么变化？
AI.motivation: 传统网络博弈假设每个玩家选择单一行动影响所有邻居，但现实中许多情境（如社交网络中的互动、商业关系等）玩家可以对不同邻居采取不同努力水平，现有理论可能无法准确描述这些情境。
AI.theoretical_framework: 网络博弈理论、战略互补/替代理论、比较静态分析、凸成本函数
AI.method: 理论建模与分析，构建玩家选择邻居特定努力水平的网络博弈模型，使用凸总努力成本函数，进行数学推导和比较静态分析
AI.findings: 主要发现是战略互动模式的惊人逆转：当双边努力是战略互补时，冲击传播模式类似于传统网络博弈中的战略替代；当双边努力是战略替代时，传播模式类似于传统网络博弈中的战略互补。玩家行为也发生其他根本性变化。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了网络博弈理论框架，引入邻居特定努力选择，揭示了战略互动模式的逆转现象，为理解复杂网络互动提供了新的理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 政策制定者需要注意：在玩家可以对不同邻居采取不同努力水平的情境中，使用传统单一努力假设可能导致错误的政策建议，特别是在分析冲击传播和网络效应时。

reference: Pénzügyi Szemle = Public Finance Quarterly, volume 65, issue 3, 2020[10.35551/PFQ_2020_3_2]
title: Rise of Public Debt  in EU Countries Due  to the Coronavirus: Post-recovery Public Debt Rates along with Different Recession Scenarios

detail.title: Rise of Public Debt  in EU Countries Due  to the Coronavirus: Post-recovery Public Debt Rates along with Different Recession Scenarios

publicationDetails.detailsText: Pénzügyi Szemle = Public Finance Quarterly, volume 65, issue 3, 2020[10.35551/PFQ_2020_3_2]

detail.abstract: Economics is also expected to try to say something to the future in addition to exploring the facts of the past. It is not its primary task to make forecasts, but it cannot ignore it, especially during non-crisis periods. My study aims to use an econometric model to provide a forecast of the expected rates of increase in public debt in the Member States of the European Union caused by the coronavirus epidemic. I carry out the study assuming four different versions of the course of the crisis, and in the fifth scenario, I analyze the macroeconomic situation when the crisis ends. In any epidemic model, the expected increases in government debt resulting from the calculations are widely spread across countries. However, critical values are expected to be reached for Greece, Italy, and Spain.

AI.tldr: 该研究使用计量经济学模型预测欧盟成员国因新冠疫情导致的公共债务增长率，考虑了四种不同的危机发展情景和一种危机结束后的宏观经济情景。
AI.research_question: 新冠疫情将如何影响欧盟成员国的公共债务增长率？
AI.motivation: 经济学不仅需要探索过去的事实，也需要对未来有所启示。虽然预测不是经济学的主要任务，但在非危机时期尤其不能忽视预测的重要性。新冠疫情对各国经济产生了重大影响，需要评估其对公共债务的潜在影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 计量经济学模型、流行病经济学模型、公共债务理论
AI.method: 使用计量经济学模型进行预测分析，考虑四种不同的危机发展情景（不同疫情发展路径）和第五种危机结束后的宏观经济情景
AI.findings: 1. 在所有流行病模型中，各国政府债务预期增长幅度差异很大；2. 希腊、意大利和西班牙预计将达到临界值（债务水平可能面临风险）
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 将计量经济学模型应用于疫情背景下的公共债务预测；2. 提供了多情景分析方法来应对不确定性；3. 扩展了流行病经济学在公共财政领域的应用
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为欧盟成员国提供了具体的债务增长预测；2. 识别了高风险国家（希腊、意大利、西班牙）；3. 为政策制定者提供了应对疫情经济影响的决策参考；4. 建立了可应用于未来类似危机的分析框架

title: Beyond the Notch: Revenue Manipulation and Business Splitting under Simplified Tax System
affiliations: National Research University Higher School of Economics, NHH Norwegian School of Economics and National Research University Higher School of Economics (Moscow)

detail.title: Beyond the Notch: Revenue Manipulation and Business Splitting under Simplified Tax System

declarations.declarationOfInterest: none
declarations.ethicsApproval: none
declarations.funderStatement: none

detail.abstract: Simplified tax regimes with explicit eligibility thresholds are a common tool which reduces tax burden but distorts firms' behavior, creating local bunching just below the threshold. However, we show that when firms have access to business splitting their responses extend far beyond the local margin. Our model demonstrates that splitting reduces local bunching but amplifies distortions elsewhere in the distribution. Exploiting a reform in Russia's Simplified Tax System that significantly raised the revenue threshold, allowing us to use the post-reform distribution as a counterfactual, we detect an excess mass far below the threshold, providing the evidence that extensive-margin responses matter.

AI.tldr: 俄罗斯简化税制改革提高收入门槛后，企业通过业务拆分来避税，导致在远低于门槛的收入区间出现异常聚集，表明企业避税行为不仅限于门槛附近的局部调整，而是存在广泛的边际响应。
AI.research_question: 当企业可以通过业务拆分来应对简化税制中的收入门槛时，企业的避税行为会如何影响收入分布？这种响应是否仅限于门槛附近的局部聚集，还是会产生更广泛的分布扭曲？
AI.motivation: 简化税制虽然减轻了企业税负，但明确的收入门槛会扭曲企业行为，导致企业在门槛下方聚集。现有研究主要关注门槛附近的局部聚集现象，但忽略了企业可能通过业务拆分等方式进行更广泛的避税响应。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于企业避税行为的理论模型，特别关注企业通过业务拆分来应对税制门槛的策略选择。模型预测业务拆分会减少门槛附近的局部聚集，但会在收入分布的其他位置放大扭曲效应。
AI.method: 利用俄罗斯简化税制改革的自然实验，该改革显著提高了收入门槛。使用改革后的收入分布作为反事实基准，通过断点回归等方法检测收入分布中的异常聚集现象。
AI.findings: 研究发现，在远低于新门槛的收入区间存在显著的异常聚集，这为企业的广泛边际响应提供了证据。业务拆分减少了门槛附近的局部聚集，但在更低的收入区间产生了新的扭曲。
AI.theory_contributions: 理论贡献在于扩展了企业避税行为的分析框架，表明当企业可以采取业务拆分等策略时，税制扭曲效应会扩展到整个收入分布，而不仅仅是门槛附近的局部效应。
AI.practical_contributions: 实践意义在于提醒政策制定者，简化税制的设计需要考虑企业可能采取的复杂避税策略，特别是业务拆分等广泛边际响应，以避免产生意想不到的分布扭曲和税收损失。

title: MiCA and the Flawed Premise of Centralised Supervision: Operational Burden vs. Supervisory Consistency
affiliations: University of Malta - Department of Banking and Finance and GTG Advocates

detail.title: MiCA and the Flawed Premise of Centralised Supervision: Operational Burden vs. Supervisory Consistency
detail.abstract:
This paper critiques a leaked European Commission proposal to centralise the supervision of Crypto-Asset Service Providers (CASPs) under the European Securities and Markets Authority (ESMA). Moving away from the carefully balanced architecture of the Markets in Crypto-Assets Regulation (MiCA)—which empowers National Competent Authorities (NCAs) to manage their respective ecosystems—the proposal is framed as a technical adjustment but constitutes a radical constitutional shift. The analysis argues that this move fundamentally undermines the principle of subsidiarity, threatens the coherence of the Digital Operational Resilience Act (DORA), and risks stifling a nascent industry through excessive, centralized bureaucracy.

Building on previous research published in the ERA Forum, this contribution provides a rigorous counter argument supported by new operational evidence. The authors posit that the proposed centralisation is legally questionable and structurally incoherent, as it erodes national expertise and destabilizes the broader European supervisory ecosystem. Ultimately, the paper rejects the shift toward ESMA led oversight in favour of a reinforced model for supervisory convergence, advocating for a framework rooted in deeper cooperation between NCAs and ESMA to ensure the integrity of the Single Market without sacrificing local financial diversity.

AI.tldr: 本文批判欧盟委员会将加密资产服务提供商监管权集中到ESMA的提案，认为这破坏了辅助性原则，威胁DORA的连贯性，可能扼杀新兴行业，主张应加强NCAs与ESMA的合作而非集中监管。
AI.research_question: 欧盟委员会将加密资产服务提供商监管权集中到ESMA的提案是否合理？这种集中化监管对欧盟监管体系、辅助性原则和加密资产行业会产生什么影响？
AI.motivation: 欧盟委员会泄露的提案试图将CASPs的监管权从各国监管机构集中到ESMA，这被视为对MiCA监管架构的根本性改变，可能破坏欧盟监管体系的平衡和有效性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 辅助性原则、监管架构理论、集中化与分散化监管的权衡、欧盟单一市场完整性理论、金融监管协调理论。
AI.method: 法律分析、政策批判分析、基于先前研究的论证、新操作证据支持、监管架构比较分析。
AI.findings: 提案在法律上存在问题，结构上不连贯，破坏国家专业知识，扰乱欧盟监管生态系统，威胁DORA的连贯性，可能通过过度集中化官僚主义扼杀新兴加密资产行业。
AI.theory_contributions: 深化对欧盟金融监管架构中辅助性原则应用的理解，提出监管集中化与分散化的平衡理论，为加密资产监管提供理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供反对集中化监管的论据，提出加强NCAs与ESMA合作的替代方案，保护欧盟单一市场完整性同时维护地方金融多样性。

title: Should Brick-and-Mortar Retailers Always Counter Showrooming? The Role of In-Store Service
affiliations: Wuhan University, Wuhan University - School of Economics and Management and Independent

detail.title: Should Brick-and-Mortar Retailers Always Counter Showrooming? The Role of In-Store Service
detail.abstract: The utilization of in-store service has become a vital strategy for brick-and-mortar (B&M) retailers to compete against e-tailers and counter consumer showrooming behavior (CSB), but it faces a paradox: while enhancing in-store service aims to mitigate CSB, it may inadvertently intensify CSB due to freeriding by certain consumers. To address the issue, we incorporate in-store service into a game-theoreticmodel to explore the price competition between a B&M retailer and an e-tailer in the presence of CSB. Based on capturing the heterogeneity in consumer perceptions of product valuation and in-store service, we analyze the price and service strategies of the retailers in different time spans. Our results show that CSB may lead to profit declines for both B&M retailer and e-tailer. Furthermore, we demonstrate that the nondigital attributes of products are strongly tied to in-store service strategies aimed at alleviating CSB. Specifically, the B&M retailer selling low nondigital-attribute product should provide low-level in-store service to mitigate CSB, whereas those selling high nondigitalattribute product should provide high-level in-store service. Moreover, our results indicate that the B&M retailer does not always counter CSB due to in-store service cost. When the service cost or travel cost is low, the B&M retailer is more likely to embrace CSB. Interestingly, when CSB intensity is low, the B&M retailer is more willing to counter CSB. Finally, a counterintuitive but interesting result shows that the price matching strategy of the B&M retailer does not always guarantee a consistent improvement in its profit.

AI.tldr: 实体零售商通过提升店内服务来对抗消费者展厅行为，但这可能因搭便车行为而加剧展厅行为。研究发现产品非数字化属性影响服务策略：低非数字化属性产品应提供低水平服务，高非数字化属性产品应提供高水平服务。服务成本低时零售商更可能接受展厅行为，展厅强度低时更愿意对抗展厅行为。价格匹配策略并不总能提高利润。
AI.research_question: 实体零售商如何通过店内服务策略来有效应对消费者展厅行为？不同产品非数字化属性如何影响实体零售商的服务策略选择？
AI.motivation: 实体零售商通过提升店内服务来对抗电商竞争和消费者展厅行为，但存在悖论：提升服务可能反而加剧展厅行为，因为某些消费者会搭便车。需要研究如何平衡服务策略以有效应对展厅行为。
AI.theoretical_framework: 博弈论模型分析实体零售商与电商之间的价格竞争；消费者异质性理论（产品估值感知和店内服务感知的异质性）；展厅行为理论；搭便车行为理论。
AI.method: 基于消费者异质性（产品估值和店内服务感知）构建博弈论模型，分析实体零售商和电商在不同时间跨度下的价格和服务策略。
AI.findings: 1. 展厅行为可能导致实体零售商和电商利润下降；2. 产品非数字化属性与服务策略密切相关：低非数字化属性产品应提供低水平服务，高非数字化属性产品应提供高水平服务；3. 服务成本低时实体零售商更可能接受展厅行为；4. 展厅强度低时实体零售商更愿意对抗展厅行为；5. 价格匹配策略并不总能提高利润。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 揭示了实体零售商店内服务策略与展厅行为之间的复杂关系；2. 提出了产品非数字化属性作为调节店内服务策略有效性的关键因素；3. 扩展了展厅行为理论，考虑了服务成本和消费者异质性的影响；4. 挑战了价格匹配策略总能提高利润的传统观点。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为实体零售商提供了针对不同产品类型的差异化服务策略建议；2. 帮助零售商评估何时应该对抗展厅行为，何时应该接受展厅行为；3. 提醒零售商谨慎使用价格匹配策略；4. 为零售商优化店内服务投资决策提供指导。

title: Preserving the Rule of Law in the Interpretation and Application of Union Law by the Member States Through CJEU Jurisprudence: The Case of VAT

detail.title: Preserving the Rule of Law in the Interpretation and Application of Union Law by the Member States Through CJEU Jurisprudence: The Case of VAT

publicationDetails.detailsText: Tax, Public Finance, and the Rule of Law (Dominic de Cogan, Alexis Brassey and May Hen eds, Hart Publishing 2025), pp. 269-285

detail.abstract: While the European Union (EU) legal order provides a common legal framework for all 27 Member States, frictions may nevertheless arise in the transposition of secondary legislation into national legal systems and/or in the decentralised enforcement of EU law by national administrations and courts. Especially at a time of multiple crises and corresponding financial constraints on national budgets, the rule of law may be threatened in the implementation and application of EU law for a variety of reasons. Seen in this light, supranational and thus comparatively neutral institutions such as the Court of Justice of the European Union (CJEU) can fundamentally be assigned a particularly important role in safeguarding the full effectiveness and correct application of EU law in the Member States. However, its powers in this regard are equally limited, especially due to significant restrictions on access to the Court and relevant limitations on its scope of action. Beyond that, although this is often presented as a 'golden bullet', it seems questionable whether it is indeed sensible to seek salvation in CJEU jurisprudence for each case of problematic conduct from an EU-specific rule-of-law perspective. The aim of this chapter is thus to provide a comprehensive and critical analysis of the CJEU's role in upholding the rule of law in the interpretation and application of Union law by the Member States, using VAT law as a representative example.

AI.tldr: 本文批判性分析了欧盟法院在维护成员国适用欧盟法时法治原则方面的作用，以增值税法为例，探讨了欧盟法院在确保欧盟法有效实施中的局限性和挑战。
AI.research_question: 欧盟法院在维护成员国解释和适用欧盟法时的法治原则方面扮演何种角色？其作用存在哪些局限性？
AI.motivation: 欧盟二级立法在成员国转化和执行过程中可能出现摩擦，特别是在多重危机和财政约束背景下，法治原则在欧盟法实施中可能受到威胁。虽然欧盟法院作为超国家中立机构理论上应发挥重要作用，但其权力受到限制，且依赖欧盟法院解决所有法治问题是否合理值得质疑。
AI.theoretical_framework: 法治理论、欧盟法实施理论、司法审查理论、超国家机构作用理论
AI.method: 批判性分析、案例研究（以增值税法为代表）、文献分析
AI.findings: 欧盟法院在确保欧盟法有效实施中发挥重要作用，但其作用受到显著限制：1）法院准入限制；2）行动范围限制；3）依赖欧盟法院解决所有法治问题可能不切实际；4）以增值税法为例的具体实施挑战。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）深化了对超国家司法机构在维护法治中作用的理解；2）揭示了欧盟法院权力与限制之间的张力；3）为欧盟法实施理论提供了批判性视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 1）为政策制定者提供了关于欧盟法院作用的现实评估；2）指出了欧盟法实施机制需要改进的领域；3）为成员国实施欧盟法提供了实践指导。

title: Timing is Everything
affiliations: University of California, San Diego (UCSD), Hebrew University of Jerusalem - Department of Economics and University of California, San Diego (UCSD) - Department of Economics

detail.title: Timing is Everything

declarations.ethicsApproval: The views expressed in this article do not represent the Department of Defense (War) nor the United States Federal Government.

detail.abstract: Social scientists often estimate how actors respond to each-other. However, data is usually aggregated temporally, into days, weeks, or years, when response occurs at higher frequency. How does temporal aggregation affect standard regression estimates? We show that studying interactions aggregated (or disaggregated) into predetermined intervals, rather than the actual response, can distort estimates, generating attenuation, amplification and even reverse signs. We provide analytic derivations, simple examples, and empirical Monte Carlo simulations. We conclude by examining how temporal aggregation can distort our understanding of the Israel-Gaza conflict from 2007 to 2017.

AI.tldr: 时间聚合（将高频互动数据汇总到天、周、年等固定时间间隔）会扭曲标准回归估计，导致衰减、放大甚至符号反转，影响对行为者相互回应的理解。
AI.research_question: 时间聚合如何影响标准回归估计？
AI.motivation: 社会科学研究者经常估计行为者如何相互回应，但数据通常被时间聚合（汇总到天、周、年等固定间隔），而实际回应发生在更高频率。这种聚合可能扭曲估计结果。
AI.theoretical_framework: 时间序列分析、回归分析、时间聚合效应理论
AI.method: 分析推导、简单示例、经验蒙特卡洛模拟、实证案例研究（以色列-加沙冲突2007-2017）
AI.findings: 时间聚合会扭曲标准回归估计，产生衰减、放大甚至符号反转效应。研究预定时间间隔而非实际回应时间会导致估计偏差。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了时间聚合对回归估计的系统性影响，提供了分析框架来理解聚合如何导致估计偏差，包括衰减、放大和符号反转。
AI.practical_contributions: 提醒研究者注意时间聚合的潜在偏差，为实证研究设计提供指导，通过以色列-加沙冲突案例展示了聚合如何影响对冲突动态的理解。

title: Creditors' Incentives and ESG in Insolvency
affiliations: Heinrich-Heine-University Düsseldorf

detail.title: Creditors' Incentives and ESG in Insolvency

publicationDetails.detailsText: to be published in Anthony Casey and Thilo Kuntz (eds.), Insolvency Law and Environmental, Social and Corporate Governance, Oxford University Press (2026, forthcoming)

detail.abstract:
In light of the pervasive effects of climate and environmental change, the relationship of insolvency law and environmental protection and the question how climate-change mitigation should figure into insolvency regulation is gaining in importance-and concomitantly, creditors as major providers of financing and players wielding significant power (not only) in insolvency. Additionally, empirical work gives cause to believe that violations of environmental law on the part of 'brown' firms increase in the year before filing for insolvency. Against this background, the chapter makes two novel contributions:

First, it explains why creditors' incentives to support debtor-driven climate-change mitigation measures are limited. Second, building on this insight, it explores the possible effects of various proposals for insolvency reform and shows that they risk impeding creditors' incentives and reduce insolvency law's potential to help battle climate change. It is organized as follows:

Section II. explores the relationship of climate change and credit risk and why creditors have limited incentives to engage in mitigation activism. Due to limited upside potential and a better position of creditors in insolvency compared to shareholders, creditors' incentives to engage in climate-change mitigation and 'greening' business are smaller than those of equity owners. Building on this general framework, Section III. proceeds to analyze possibilities and limitations of insolvency reform, taking up proposals in recent insolvency scholarship. It first demonstrates why the idea of mandatory liquidation of insolvent carbon-intensive businesses is misguided. Second, it analyzes the potential of awarding environmental liabilities priority or non-dischargeability in insolvency and explores regulatory and policy hurdles. Third, the section turns against more far-reaching suggestions to appoint environmental trustees. Fourth, it justifies the orientation of insolvency law towards creditor value maximization in monetary terms. Section IV. concludes.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨破产法与环境保护的关系，分析债权人在气候变化减缓中的有限激励，并评估各种破产改革建议的潜在影响。
AI.research_question: 债权人在气候变化减缓中的激励为何有限？各种破产改革建议如何影响债权人的激励和破产法应对气候变化的潜力？
AI.motivation: 气候变化和环境变化的普遍影响日益凸显，破产法与环境保护的关系以及气候变化减缓在破产监管中的作用变得愈发重要。同时，实证研究表明，"棕色"企业在申请破产前一年违反环境法的行为会增加。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于气候变化与信用风险的关系理论，以及债权人与股东在破产中不同地位和激励结构的比较分析框架。
AI.method: 理论分析和法律政策分析，系统评估各种破产改革建议的潜在效果和局限性。
AI.findings: 1. 债权人支持债务人驱动的气候变化减缓措施的激励有限，因为上行潜力有限且在破产中相比股东处于更有利地位；2. 强制清算碳密集型企业的建议存在误导性；3. 给予环境债务优先权或不可免责性面临监管和政策障碍；4. 任命环境受托人的建议过于激进；5. 破产法应坚持以货币价值最大化为导向。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 首次系统分析债权人在气候变化减缓中的有限激励机制；2. 构建了气候变化与信用风险关系的理论框架；3. 为破产法与环境保护的交叉研究提供了新的理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者提供了破产改革建议的全面评估；2. 指出了现有改革建议可能削弱债权人激励的风险；3. 为平衡环境保护与破产法效率提供了实践指导；4. 帮助企业理解破产环境下的气候变化应对策略。

title: Uncertainty Analysis of Artificial Neural Network (ANN) And Support Vector Machine (SVM) Models in Predicting Monthly River Flow (Case Study: Ghezelozan River)
affiliations: Independent and

detail.title: Uncertainty Analysis of Artificial Neural Network (ANN) And Support Vector Machine (SVM) Models in Predicting Monthly River Flow (Case Study: Ghezelozan River)

publicationDetails.detailsText: Mohammadi, M., & Allahverdipour, P. (2024). Uncertainty analysis of artificial neural network (ANN) and support vector machine (SVM) models in predicting monthly river flow (Case study: Ghezelozan River). Water and Soil Management and Modeling, 4(2), 311-326. DOI: 10.22098/mmws.2023.12702.1267

detail.abstract: Introduction River flow forecasting has been one of the important challenges of water resources management in recent decades, so many researchers have proposed different methods to improve the performance of forecasting models. In the last decade, artificial intelligence methods have been most widely used in the simulation of various processes, including hydrological processes, due to their flexibility and high accuracy in modeling. However, the results of these methods have always been associated with uncertainty due to several factors such as structure, algorithm, input data, and the type of method chosen for data calibration. One of the methods that can somewhat solve this problem is the uncertainty analysis of the predictions made by these models. Materials and Methods In this study, the uncertainty of the results of artificial neural network (ANN) and support vector machine (SVM) models in predicting the monthly flow of the river has been evaluated. In this research, the time series of the monthly flow of the Ghezelozan River using the data of the Bianlu-Yasaul Stream gauging station in 39 years from 1976 to 2014 was used, where 75% and 25% of the data was used for training and testing the models, respectively. In these models, to estimate the monthly flow of the Ghezelozan River, six different input combinations including the flow of one, two, and three months before and the number of months of the flow were used. Then, the accuracy and performance of the models were compared using the coefficient of determination (R) and root mean square of errors (RMSE). Finally, the uncertainty of the results of ANN and SVM models in predicting the monthly flow of the river was evaluated by the Monte-Carlo method using dfactor and 95PPU values. Results and Discussion The evaluation of the performance of the ANN model shows that the best performance is related to the combination where the flow of the previous two months and the number of the month of the flow are the inputs of the model so that R and RMSE indexes were obtained as 0.757 and 9.45, respectively. In the SVM model for the monthly river flow series, the best performance is related to the combination where the flow of one, two, and three months ago and the number of months of the flow were the inputs of the model, and the R and RMSE indexes for this input pattern were 0.729 and 10.946, respectively. After studying the uncertainty of the models, the results showed that the ANN model has more uncertainty in the output values compared to the SVM model, and this is while the d-factor of the ANN model, both in the training and test phase, it was more than the SVM model. The comparison of the uncertainty analysis of the results of the ANN and SVM models showed that the SVM model with d-factor and 95PPU values equal to 0.155 and 17.241, respectively, compared to the ANN model with d-factor and 95PPU values equal to 0.993 and 85.470, respectively, has less uncertainty in the output values. So the number of observation data placed in the 95% confidence range (95PPU) of the ANN model compared to the SVM model has increased significantly in both the training and testing phases. Also, the results showed that both models have more uncertainty in the months with a large volume of water, which can be due to the complexity of the process and the involvement of uncertain factors in these months, as well as the effect of factors that are not considered in the structure of predictive models. Conclusion The results of ANN and SVM models in predicting the monthly flow of the Ghezelozan River showed that although the ANN model with R-value equal to 0.757 and RMSE value equal to 9.45 has a good performance compared to the SVM model with R-value equal to 0.729 and RMSE value equal to 10.946 in predicting the river flow, the results of this model are associated with high uncertainty. The comparison of the uncertainty analysis of the results of ANN and SVM models by Monte-Carlo method showed that the SVM model with dfactor and 95PPU values equal to 0.155 and 17.241, respectively, compared to the ANN model with d-factor and 95PPU values equal to 0.993 and 85.470, respectively, has less uncertainty in predicting the monthly flow of the Ghezelozan River and it is better than ANN model. According to the results of this research, taking into account the fact that advanced artificial intelligence models also have uncertainty, it is necessary to apply these methods in the fields of risk management and future planning to obtain the best performance.

AI.tldr: 本研究评估了人工神经网络（ANN）和支持向量机（SVM）在预测Ghezelozan河月流量时的性能与不确定性。ANN在预测精度上略优于SVM，但SVM的不确定性显著低于ANN。研究表明，尽管AI模型精度高，但其结果仍存在不确定性，应在风险管理和规划中考虑这种不确定性。
AI.research_question: 人工神经网络（ANN）和支持向量机（SVM）在预测河流月流量时的性能比较如何？这两种模型预测结果的不确定性有何差异？
AI.motivation: 河流流量预测是水资源管理的重要挑战，人工智能方法因其灵活性和高精度被广泛应用。然而，这些方法的结果常因模型结构、算法、输入数据等因素存在不确定性，需要通过不确定性分析来解决这一问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于人工智能的水文预测理论，包括人工神经网络和支持向量机模型；不确定性分析理论，特别是蒙特卡洛方法在模型不确定性评估中的应用。
AI.method: 使用Ghezelozan河39年（1976-2014）的月流量时间序列数据，75%用于训练，25%用于测试。构建6种不同的输入组合（包括前1、2、3个月的流量和月份数）。使用决定系数（R）和均方根误差（RMSE）评估模型性能，采用蒙特卡洛方法通过d-factor和95PPU值评估模型不确定性。
AI.findings: 1. ANN模型最佳性能：前两个月流量+月份数作为输入，R=0.757，RMSE=9.45；2. SVM模型最佳性能：前三个月流量+月份数作为输入，R=0.729，RMSE=10.946；3. SVM模型不确定性显著低于ANN：SVM的d-factor=0.155，95PPU=17.241；ANN的d-factor=0.993，95PPU=85.470；4. 两种模型在水量大的月份不确定性更高。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 系统比较了ANN和SVM在河流流量预测中的性能差异；2. 量化了两种模型预测结果的不确定性程度；3. 揭示了AI水文预测模型中精度与不确定性的权衡关系；4. 为水文预测模型选择提供了理论依据。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为水资源管理者提供了模型选择指导：虽然ANN精度略高，但SVM不确定性更低，更适合风险敏感的应用场景；2. 强调了在AI水文预测中考虑不确定性的重要性；3. 提供了具体的模型评估指标和方法；4. 为类似河流的流量预测提供了可参考的模型配置方案。

publicationDetails.detailsText: Poljoprivredna tehnika, volume 50, issue 4, 2025[10.5937/POLJTEH2504001L]

detail.abstract: Cereals are the world's largest crops and the key source of staple food for millions of people globally. In this study, we analyse the trends in the production and growth of the most important and widely grown types of cereals cultivated as grain globally: 1) maize (corn), 2) wheat, 3) rice; 4) barley; 5) sorghum; 6) oats; 7) millet; 8) rye. The dataset on the produced cereals was collected from the Food and Agriculture Organization (FAO). Methods include the analysis of geospatial and economic data on the agricultural production of cereals for the period 1993-2023 and relevant literature review. The results revealed major trends in the agriculture production harvest of cereals at the global scale: the increase in production and yield quantities was noted for 4 crop types: maize, rice, wheat, millet. In contrast, barley, sorghum, oats and rye shown decrease in harvest in recent 30 years. The study contributes to the analysis of food security and crop availability for sustainable agricultural development.

AI.tldr: 该研究分析了1993-2023年间全球八大主要谷物（玉米、小麦、水稻、大麦、高粱、燕麦、小米、黑麦）的生产趋势，发现玉米、水稻、小麦和小米产量增加，而大麦、高粱、燕麦和黑麦产量下降。
AI.research_question: 1993-2023年间全球主要谷物的生产和增长趋势如何？
AI.motivation: 谷物是全球最大的作物，是数百万人主食的关键来源，了解其生产趋势对粮食安全和可持续农业发展至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 农业经济学、粮食安全理论、可持续农业发展理论
AI.method: 收集联合国粮农组织（FAO）数据，分析1993-2023年间的地理空间和经济数据，并进行相关文献综述
AI.findings: 玉米、水稻、小麦和小米四种作物的产量和单产增加；大麦、高粱、燕麦和黑麦在过去30年中产量下降
AI.theory_contributions: 为全球谷物生产趋势分析提供了实证数据支持，丰富了粮食安全研究的理论基础
AI.practical_contributions: 为农业政策制定者提供决策参考，帮助识别需要关注的作物类型，促进可持续农业发展

detail.abstract: This research presented work on the actualisation of the existing landscape maps in the protected regions of Italy in northern, central and southern areas. The research aimed at evaluation of how land cover types change across Italy and what factors induce their changes: geology, climate change, natural hazards, anthropogenic activities (wood logging), and changes in forest dynamics (reforestation and deforestation). The methodology includes both the GIS-based analysis of the regional setting (climate and hydrology, topographic-geologic structure of the terrain) and fieldwork activities during the in-situ campaign (summer periods 2024 and 2025). Processing fieldwork data, aerial GEE images and maps, and integrating them into cartographic project through QGIS mapping enabled to extract valuable environmental information regarding land cover types in 3 different regions of Italy for analysis of landscape variability.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过GIS分析和实地考察，评估了意大利北部、中部和南部保护区内土地覆盖类型的变化及其驱动因素（地质、气候变化、自然灾害、人为活动和森林动态）。
AI.research_question: 意大利保护区内土地覆盖类型如何变化？哪些因素（地质、气候变化、自然灾害、人为活动、森林动态）驱动这些变化？
AI.motivation: 需要更新意大利保护区的现有景观地图，了解土地覆盖变化及其驱动因素，为保护区管理和环境保护提供科学依据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 景观生态学、土地覆盖变化理论、环境驱动因素理论（地质、气候、人为活动等对土地覆盖的影响）。
AI.method: 结合GIS分析（区域气候水文、地形地质结构）和实地考察（2024-2025年夏季），处理实地数据、航空GEE图像和地图，通过QGIS制图整合分析。
AI.findings: 研究提取了意大利三个不同区域土地覆盖类型的宝贵环境信息，分析了景观变异性，揭示了不同驱动因素对土地覆盖变化的影响。
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了对地中海地区保护区土地覆盖变化驱动机制的理解，为景观变化理论提供了意大利保护区的实证案例。
AI.practical_contributions: 为意大利保护区管理提供了更新的景观地图和科学依据，有助于制定更有效的环境保护和土地管理政策。

title: A Regime-Aware Market Capitalization Rotation Strategy Using Hybrid Asset Allocation Momentum

detail.title: A Regime-Aware Market Capitalization Rotation Strategy Using Hybrid Asset Allocation Momentum

declarations.ethicsApproval: NA
declarations.funderStatement: NA

detail.abstract: This study evaluates whether a regime-aware momentum framework inspired by the Hybrid Asset Allocation (HAA) methodology can improve risk-adjusted performance when applied to U.S. equity market-capitalization segments. Using exchange-traded funds representing large-, mid-, and small-capitalization equities, the strategy dynamically allocates to the strongest market-cap segment during favorable risk regimes and shifts to defensive Treasury bills during unfavorable regimes as identiFied by an inFlation-protected bond canary. Performance is compared against buy-and-hold exposure to the total U.S. equity market. Results show that the HAA market-cap rotation strategy achieves higher compound returns, lower volatility, substantially reduced drawdowns, and superior risk-adjusted performance relative to the benchmark.

AI.tldr: 该研究评估了基于混合资产配置方法的制度感知动量框架在美国股市市值板块中的应用效果。策略在有利风险制度下动态配置到最强的市值板块，在不利制度下转向防御性国债，相比全市场买入持有策略获得了更高的复合收益、更低波动性、显著减少的回撤和更优的风险调整后表现。
AI.research_question: 基于混合资产配置方法的制度感知动量框架能否改善美国股市不同市值板块的风险调整后表现？
AI.motivation: 传统买入持有策略在市场波动时面临较大风险，需要更智能的动态资产配置方法来提高风险调整后收益，特别是在不同市场制度下优化市值板块配置。
AI.theoretical_framework: 混合资产配置理论、制度感知投资框架、动量策略、风险制度识别理论
AI.method: 使用代表大、中、小市值股票的ETF，通过通胀保值债券作为预警指标识别风险制度，在有利制度下配置到最强的市值板块，在不利制度下转向国债，并与全美股市买入持有基准进行比较
AI.findings: HAA市值轮动策略相比基准实现了更高的复合收益、更低的波动性、显著减少的回撤和更优的风险调整后表现
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了混合资产配置理论在市值板块轮动中的应用，验证了制度感知动量框架的有效性，为动态资产配置提供了新的理论支持
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资者提供了实用的市值板块轮动策略，通过制度识别机制改善风险调整后收益，可用于实际投资组合管理

detail.abstract: Drawing on my experience as a former Trump White House lawyer responsible for judicial nominations during the initial two years of President Trump’s first term, this essay will address three dimensions of the judicial nominations landscape at the start of his second term: (1) federal judicial selection in recent years; (2) the claims about what judicial selection will purportedly look like during President Trump’s second term; and (3) as someone with some visibility into the current White House Counsel’s Office’s process, what I anticipate judicial selection will actually look like during President Trump’s second term.

AI.tldr: 本文基于作者作为前特朗普政府白宫律师的经验，分析特朗普第二任期司法提名前景，包括近年联邦司法选拔情况、外界预期与实际预测。

detail.abstract: This study aims at using advanced GeoAI tools for monitoring landscapes in Italy using machine learning (ML) methods for remote sensing (RS) data processing. Changes in land cover types were identified using AI-processed satellite images. The methodology is based on the four ML algorithms of Python library Scikit-Learn embedded in the GRASS GIS: SupportVectorMachine (SVM), Decision Tree Classifier (DTC), RandomForest (RF) and Multilayer Perceptron Classifier (MLPC) of Artificial Neural Network (ANN). The multispectral satellite Landsat imagery was processed and analysed for changes in categories. The workflow of image processing includes classification for automatic detection of land categories. The presented maps demonstrated spatio-temporal vegetation dynamics and changes in land cover types detected using times series of the RS data. The topology of patches was detected by ML considering differences among spectral reflectance of pixels. ML algorithms recognised. Streamlined workflow through integration of RS and ML algorithms for model training, prediction and classification in GRASS GIS environment. This study has shown the advantages of AI methods for automation of RS data processing.

AI.tldr: 本研究使用GeoAI工具和机器学习方法处理遥感数据，监测意大利景观变化。通过集成Scikit-Learn的四种ML算法（SVM、DTC、RF、MLPC）到GRASS GIS中，处理Landsat多光谱影像，自动检测土地覆盖类型变化，展示植被动态和斑块拓扑结构。
AI.research_question: 如何利用先进的GeoAI工具和机器学习方法处理遥感数据，有效监测意大利景观的土地覆盖类型变化？
AI.motivation: 传统遥感数据处理方法效率较低，需要自动化工具来提高景观监测的准确性和效率。AI方法在遥感数据处理中的优势尚未充分探索。

AI.method: 使用GRASS GIS集成的Scikit-Learn四种机器学习算法（SVM、决策树、随机森林、多层感知器神经网络），处理Landsat多光谱卫星影像，通过分类工作流程自动检测土地类别变化。
AI.findings: 成功展示了时空植被动态和土地覆盖类型变化；ML算法能够识别斑块拓扑结构；集成RS和ML的工作流程提高了数据处理自动化水平。
AI.theory_contributions: 验证了多种机器学习算法在遥感景观监测中的适用性；提出了GIS与ML集成的工作流程框架；丰富了GeoAI在环境监测领域的理论应用。
